AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Two Cognito identity pools with unauthenticated identities enabled for testing.
  One pool backs a Lambda-oriented unauthenticated role (also usable as a Lambda
  execution role); the other backs a Step Functions-oriented unauthenticated role
  (also assumable by the Step Functions service). Fully self-contained single stack.

Resources:

  LambdaTestIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lambda-test'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true

  SfnTestIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sfn-test'
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true

  LambdaTestUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Unauthenticated role for the Lambda test identity pool; also usable as a Lambda execution role.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CognitoUnauthenticatedFederation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref LambdaTestIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated
          - Sid: LambdaServiceAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaTestUnauthInlinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeAnyLambdaFunction
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - lambda:InvokeAsync
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBDataPlaneAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
              # NOTE: This policy grants SES send permissions but does not create or
              # verify an SES sender identity. SES identity verification is out of
              # scope for this template; the identity/* resource scope keeps the role
              # usable once an identity is verified in the account.
              - Sid: SesSendEmail
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/*'

  SfnTestUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Unauthenticated role for the Step Functions test identity pool; also assumable by the Step Functions service.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CognitoUnauthenticatedFederation
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref SfnTestIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated
          - Sid: StepFunctionsServiceAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SfnTestUnauthInlinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeAnyLambdaFunction
                Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*'

  LambdaTestPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref LambdaTestIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt LambdaTestUnauthRole.Arn

  SfnTestPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref SfnTestIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt SfnTestUnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:

  LambdaTestIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Identity pool ID for the Lambda-based test scenario.
    Value: !Ref LambdaTestIdentityPool

  SfnTestIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Identity pool ID for the Step Functions-based test scenario.
    Value: !Ref SfnTestIdentityPool

  LambdaTestUnauthRoleArn:
    Description: Unauthenticated role ARN for the Lambda-based test identity pool.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaTestUnauthRole.Arn

  SfnTestUnauthRoleArn:
    Description: Unauthenticated role ARN for the Step Functions-based test identity pool.
    Value: !GetAtt SfnTestUnauthRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  PCI compliance remediation prerequisites: an IAM role (pciautomationassumerole-<region>)
  trusted by SSM, EC2, and Events, plus four SSM Automation documents for Config
  remediation: restrict default SG traffic, delete unused SGs, release unassociated
  EIPs, set ASG health check to ELB/300s. NOTE: Document 4 execution requires
  autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup, intentionally not in the EC2-only role policy;
  extend the policy before running it. The invoking principal (e.g., Config remediation
  caller) must hold iam:PassRole on the PCI role because documents use document-level
  assumeRole.

Resources:
  PciAutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'pciautomationassumerole-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: >
        Assumed by SSM Automation, EC2, and Events to perform PCI compliance
        remediation actions (security group cleanup and Elastic IP release).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSsmEc2AndEventsToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub 'pciautomation-ec2-remediation-${AWS::Region}'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: MinimumEc2RemediationActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource: '*'

  PciRestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: pci-restrict-default-security-group-traffic
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Revokes all ingress and egress rules on the VPC default security group(s).
          If SecurityGroupId is not provided, all security groups named "default"
          (optionally filtered by VpcId) are enumerated and fully restricted.
        assumeRole: '{{ AssumeRoleArn }}'
        parameters:
          AssumeRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the PCI automation role assumed by SSM Automation for the remediation.
            default: 'arn:aws:iam::{{global:ACCOUNT_ID}}:role/pciautomationassumerole-{{global:REGION}}'
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: Optional specific default security group ID to restrict. If empty, all default security groups are restricted.
            default: ''
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: Optional VPC ID used to scope the default security group lookup when SecurityGroupId is empty.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def _revoke(ec2, group_id, permissions, egress):
                    if not permissions:
                        return
                    if egress:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=permissions)
                    else:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=permissions)


                def script_handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    group_id = events.get('SecurityGroupId') or ''
                    vpc_id = events.get('VpcId') or ''

                    if group_id:
                        groups = ec2.describe_security_groups(
                            GroupIds=[group_id])['SecurityGroups']
                    else:
                        filters = [{'Name': 'group-name', 'Values': ['default']}]
                        if vpc_id:
                            filters.append({'Name': 'vpc-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]})
                        groups = ec2.describe_security_groups(
                            Filters=filters)['SecurityGroups']

                    restricted = []
                    for group in groups:
                        gid = group['GroupId']
                        _revoke(ec2, gid, group.get('IpPermissions', []), False)
                        _revoke(ec2, gid, group.get('IpPermissionsEgress', []), True)
                        restricted.append(gid)

                    return {'RestrictedSecurityGroups': restricted}

  PciDeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: pci-delete-unused-security-groups
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Deletes security groups that are not attached to any network interface
          (ENI) and are not referenced by any other security group's rules.
          Default security groups are always skipped.
        assumeRole: '{{ AssumeRoleArn }}'
        parameters:
          AssumeRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the PCI automation role assumed by SSM Automation for the remediation.
            default: 'arn:aws:iam::{{global:ACCOUNT_ID}}:role/pciautomationassumerole-{{global:REGION}}'
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteUnusedSecurityGroups
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload: {}
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def script_handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    security_groups = ec2.describe_security_groups()['SecurityGroups']

                    attached_group_ids = set()
                    paginator = ec2.get_paginator('describe_network_interfaces')
                    for page in paginator.paginate():
                        for eni in page.get('NetworkInterfaces', []):
                            for group in eni.get('Groups', []):
                                attached_group_ids.add(group['GroupId'])

                    referenced_group_ids = set()
                    for sg in security_groups:
                        permissions = (
                            sg.get('IpPermissions', [])
                            + sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                        )
                        for permission in permissions:
                            for ref in permission.get('UserIdGroupPairs', []):
                                referenced_group_ids.add(ref['GroupId'])

                    deleted = []
                    skipped = []
                    for sg in security_groups:
                        gid = sg['GroupId']
                        name = sg['GroupName']
                        if name == 'default':
                            skipped.append(
                                {'GroupId': gid, 'Reason': 'default security group'})
                            continue
                        if gid in attached_group_ids:
                            skipped.append(
                                {'GroupId': gid, 'Reason': 'attached to an ENI'})
                            continue
                        if gid in referenced_group_ids:
                            skipped.append(
                                {'GroupId': gid,
                                 'Reason': 'referenced by another security group'})
                            continue
                        ec2.delete_security_group(GroupId=gid)
                        deleted.append(gid)

                    return {'DeletedSecurityGroups': deleted, 'Skipped': skipped}

  PciReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: pci-release-unassociated-elastic-ips
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Releases unassociated Elastic IP addresses using their AllocationId.
          Addresses with an AssociationId or InstanceId are never released.
          If AllocationId is provided, only that address is evaluated.
        assumeRole: '{{ AssumeRoleArn }}'
        parameters:
          AssumeRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the PCI automation role assumed by SSM Automation for the remediation.
            default: 'arn:aws:iam::{{global:ACCOUNT_ID}}:role/pciautomationassumerole-{{global:REGION}}'
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: Optional specific EIP AllocationId (eipalloc-*) to evaluate and release if unassociated. If empty, all unassociated EIPs are released.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIps
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def script_handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    target_allocation_id = events.get('AllocationId') or ''
                    addresses = ec2.describe_addresses().get('Addresses', [])

                    released = []
                    skipped = []
                    for address in addresses:
                        allocation_id = address.get('AllocationId')
                        if target_allocation_id and allocation_id != target_allocation_id:
                            continue
                        if address.get('AssociationId') or address.get('InstanceId'):
                            skipped.append({
                                'AllocationId': allocation_id,
                                'Reason': 'associated with an instance or ENI'})
                            continue
                        if allocation_id:
                            ec2.release_address(AllocationId=allocation_id)
                            released.append(allocation_id)
                        elif address.get('PublicIp'):
                            ec2.release_address(PublicIp=address['PublicIp'])
                            released.append(address['PublicIp'])

                    return {'ReleasedAddresses': released, 'Skipped': skipped}

  PciUpdateAsgHealthCheckDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: pci-update-asg-health-check-elb
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Updates the target Auto Scaling Group's HealthCheckType to ELB with a
          HealthCheckGracePeriod of 300 seconds.
          NOTE: Executing this document requires the autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
          permission, which is not granted by the EC2-only inline policy on the
          PCI automation role. Extend the role policy before running this remediation.
        assumeRole: '{{ AssumeRoleArn }}'
        parameters:
          AssumeRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the PCI automation role assumed by SSM Automation for the remediation.
            default: 'arn:aws:iam::{{global:ACCOUNT_ID}}:role/pciautomationassumerole-{{global:REGION}}'
          AutoScalingGroupName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the Auto Scaling Group to update.
            allowedPattern: '^[\x20-\x7E]+$'
            minChars: 1
            maxChars: 255
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAutoScalingGroupHealthCheck
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                AutoScalingGroupName: '{{ AutoScalingGroupName }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def script_handler(events, context):
                    autoscaling = boto3.client('autoscaling')

                    asg_name = events['AutoScalingGroupName']
                    autoscaling.update_auto_scaling_group(
                        AutoScalingGroupName=asg_name,
                        HealthCheckType='ELB',
                        HealthCheckGracePeriod=300)

                    return {
                        'AutoScalingGroupName': asg_name,
                        'HealthCheckType': 'ELB',
                        'HealthCheckGracePeriod': 300
                    }

Outputs:
  PciAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the PCI automation assume role to pass to Config remediation configurations.
    Value: !GetAtt PciAutomationAssumeRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PciAutomationRoleArn'
  PciAutomationRoleName:
    Description: Name of the PCI automation assume role.
    Value: !Ref PciAutomationAssumeRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PciAutomationRoleName'
  RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the Automation document that restricts default security group traffic.
    Value: !Ref PciRestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocument'
  DeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the Automation document that deletes unused security groups.
    Value: !Ref PciDeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDocument'
  ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpsDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the Automation document that releases unassociated Elastic IPs.
    Value: !Ref PciReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpsDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIpsDocument'
  UpdateAsgHealthCheckDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the Automation document that updates ASG health check to ELB with a 300 second grace period.
    Value: !Ref PciUpdateAsgHealthCheckDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UpdateAsgHealthCheckDocument'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Mirrors three existing CodeCommit repositories (card-service, rule-service,
  ecs-pipeline) from the current region to a target replica region using a
  CodeBuild project triggered by EventBridge rules on pushes to the 'mainline' branch.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    Description: Target region to which the source repositories will be mirrored.

Resources:
  CodeBuildMirrorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mirror-build-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mirror-build-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CodeBuildLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/codebuild/*'
              - Sid: CodeCommitSourceAndReplicaAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPull
                  - codecommit:GitPush
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'

  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mirror-events-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mirror-events-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartMirrorBuild
                Effect: Allow
                Action: codebuild:StartBuild
                Resource: !GetAtt MirrorProject.Arn

  MirrorProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mirror-project'
      Description: Mirrors card-service, rule-service, and ecs-pipeline to the target replica region.
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildMirrorRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Secure S3 infrastructure for testing: primary bucket with AES256 encryption,
  versioning, public access blocked, TLS-only policy, and same-region replication;
  a dedicated access log bucket; a replica bucket; and an IAM role with the
  required S3 replication permissions. All three bucket policies permit the
  S3 log delivery service and deny non-secure transport.

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: testanu
    Description: Application name used to construct deterministic bucket and role names.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$'
    ConstraintDescription: AppName must be lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens (e.g. testanu).

Resources:
  PrimaryBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
            BucketKeyEnabled: false
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref LogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: access-logs/
      ReplicationConfiguration:
        Role: !GetAtt ReplicationRole.Arn
        Rules:
          - Id: FullBucketReplication
            Status: Enabled
            Priority: 1
            DeleteMarkerReplication:
              Status: Enabled
            Filter:
              Prefix: ''
            Destination:
              Bucket: !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn

  ReplicaBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
            BucketKeyEnabled: false
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  LogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${AppName}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
            BucketKeyEnabled: false
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  ReplicationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AppName}-replication-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AppName}-replication-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SourceBucketLevelPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetReplicationConfiguration'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}'
              - Sid: SourceObjectLevelPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersionForReplication'
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersionAcl'
                  - 's3:GetObjectVersionTagging'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}/*'
              - Sid: DestinationBucketLevelPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ReplicateObject'
                  - 's3:ReplicateDelete'
                  - 's3:ReplicateTags'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}'
              - Sid: DestinationObjectLevelPermissions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:ReplicateObject'
                  - 's3:ReplicateDelete'
                  - 's3:ReplicateTags'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}/*'

  PrimaryBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PrimaryBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDeliveryFromPrimary
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}/access-logs/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}'
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'

  ReplicaBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ReplicaBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDeliveryFromReplica
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}/access-logs/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}'
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'

  LogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'
          - Sid: AllowS3LogDeliveryFromPrimary
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: 's3:PutObject'
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}/access-logs/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AppName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}'
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'

Outputs:
  PrimaryBucketName:
    Description: Name of the primary S3 bucket.
    Value: !Ref PrimaryBucket
  PrimaryBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the primary S3 bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt PrimaryBucket.Arn
  ReplicaBucketName:
    Description: Name of the same-region replica S3 bucket.
    Value: !Ref ReplicaBucket
  ReplicaBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the same-region replica S3 bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
  LogBucketName:
    Description: Name of the access log S3 bucket.
    Value: !Ref LogBucket
  ReplicationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used for S3 replication.
    Value: !GetAtt ReplicationRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >
  Route53 hosted zone and DNS records for the Ear Hustle production
  environment (Squarespace, G Suite email, ZenDesk, Campaign Monitor,
  Supercast). DNS-only: the ACM certificate for the feeds subdomain is
  intentionally deferred to a follow-up stack after NS delegation.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: earhustlesq.com
    Description: Root domain for the hosted zone (dot-less; the template appends the trailing dot).
  OldSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: mail.earhustlesq.com.
    Description: >
      Legacy subdomain that also receives G Suite MX records. Must be a
      fully-qualified domain name ending with a trailing dot (Route53
      rejects malformed names, e.g. a double dot).
  SquarespaceIP1:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.185.159.144
  SquarespaceIP2:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.185.159.145
  SquarespaceIP3:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.49.23.144
  SquarespaceIP4:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.49.23.145
  SquarespaceVerifyTXT:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      Squarespace domain verification code published as a TXT record at the
      apex (CNAME is not permitted at the apex in Route53). PLACEHOLDER
      default — replace with the code Squarespace issues, and confirm the
      record type/name matches what Squarespace actually provides.
  GoogleSiteVerification:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      Google site verification token. PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the
      real token obtained from Google Search Console / Google Workspace
      before production use.
  ZoomVerification:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      Zoom domain verification token. PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the
      real token obtained from Zoom before production use.
  ATProtoVerification:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      ATProto (Bluesky) domain verification token. PLACEHOLDER default —
      replace with the real token obtained from Bluesky before production use.
  SPFRecord:
    Type: String
    Default: v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:mail.zendesk.com include:cmail1.com ~all
  DMARCValue:
    Type: String
    Default: v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@earhustlesq.com; pct=100
  ZendeskVerificationTXT:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      ZenDesk account verification TXT token. PLACEHOLDER default — replace
      with the real token obtained from ZenDesk before production use.
  ZendeskValidationCNAME:
    Type: String
    Default: support.zendesk.com.
    Description: >
      ZenDesk domain validation target hostname (fully-qualified, trailing
      dot required by Route53). Must be an external ZenDesk hostname, never
      the record name itself (a self-referential target creates a CNAME loop
      that Route53 rejects).
  CampaignMonitorSPFValue:
    Type: String
    Default: v=spf2.0/pra include:cmail1.com ~all
  GoogleDKIMPart1:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      Google Workspace DKIM public key, first quoted fragment (must be <=255
      characters). PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the first fragment of
      the key generated in the Google Workspace admin console.
  GoogleDKIMPart2:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      Google Workspace DKIM public key, second quoted fragment (must be
      <=255 characters). PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the second
      fragment of the real key; if the key fits in a single fragment, the
      first fragment must be re-split so that both fragments are non-empty
      (Route53 does not accept empty TXT character-strings).
  SupercastDKIMTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-CNAME-TARGET.example.com.
    Description: >
      Supercast DKIM target hostname. PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the
      real target provided by Supercast before production use. Real values
      must be fully-qualified hostnames ending with a dot.
  SupercastReturnPathTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-CNAME-TARGET.example.com.
    Description: >
      Supercast return-path CNAME target. PLACEHOLDER default — replace with
      the real target provided by Supercast before production use. Real
      values must be fully-qualified hostnames ending with a dot.
  ZenDeskDKIMTarget1:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-CNAME-TARGET.example.com.
    Description: >
      ZenDesk DKIM CNAME target 1. PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the
      real target obtained from ZenDesk before production use. Real values
      must be fully-qualified hostnames ending with a dot.
  ZenDeskDKIMTarget2:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-CNAME-TARGET.example.com.
    Description: >
      ZenDesk DKIM CNAME target 2. PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the
      real target obtained from ZenDesk before production use. Real values
      must be fully-qualified hostnames ending with a dot.
  CampaignMonitorDKIMTarget1:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-CNAME-TARGET.example.com.
    Description: >
      Campaign Monitor DKIM CNAME target 1. PLACEHOLDER default — replace
      with the real target obtained from Campaign Monitor before production
      use. Real values must be fully-qualified hostnames ending with a dot.
  CampaignMonitorDKIMTarget2:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-CNAME-TARGET.example.com.
    Description: >
      Campaign Monitor DKIM CNAME target 2. PLACEHOLDER default — replace

  CampaignMonitorMXHost:
    Type: String

        - '5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '10 alt3.aspmx.l.google.com.'

  ApexARecord:

  ZenDeskValidationCNAME:

  ZenDeskDKIMRecord1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:

      Name: !Sub 'zendesk1._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZenDeskDKIMTarget1

  ZenDeskDKIMRecord2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

  CampaignMonitorDKIMRecord1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Aurora Global Database failover automation - SSM role, Lambda role, SSM Automation document, and TriggerFailover Lambda.

Resources:

  SsmAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: AuroraGlobalDbFailoverSsmRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AuroraFailoverSsmPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RdsGlobalCluster
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rds:DescribeGlobalClusters
                  - rds:FailoverGlobalCluster
                  - rds:ModifyGlobalCluster
                  - rds:DescribeDBClusters
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ArcRoutingControl
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:GetRoutingControlState
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:UpdateRoutingControlState
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:UpdateRoutingControlStates
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeCluster
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:ListRoutingControls
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SecretsManager
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aurora-global-failover-*'
              - Sid: SsmAutomation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource: '*'

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: AuroraGlobalDbFailoverLambdaRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TriggerFailoverSsmPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SsmStartAndMonitor
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassSsmAutomationRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn

  FailoverSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: aurora-global-failover-writer-endpoint
      Description: Updated at runtime by the Aurora Global Database failover SSM automation with the new writer endpoint.
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"writerEndpoint": "not-set"}'
        GenerateStringKey: nonce
        PasswordLength: 16

  AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
      DocumentType: Automation
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Determines the active region via ARC routing controls, performs Aurora Global Database failover, then flips ARC routing control states and updates the writer endpoint secret.
        assumeRole: '{{ SsmAutomationRoleArn }}'
        parameters:
          PrimaryRegion:
            type: String
            default: us-east-1
            description: Primary region of the Aurora global database.
          SecondaryRegion:
            type: String
            default: us-west-2
            description: Secondary region of the Aurora global database.
          RoutingControlArnPrimary:
            type: String
            default: ''
            description: ARN of the ARC routing control representing the primary region.
          RoutingControlArnSecondary:
            type: String
            default: ''
            description: ARN of the ARC routing control representing the secondary region.
          GlobalClusterIdentifier:
            type: String
            description: Identifier of the Aurora global database cluster.
          SecretArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret to update with the new writer endpoint.
          SsmAutomationRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by this automation.
        mainSteps:
          - name: DetermineActiveRegion
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
                RoutingControlArnPrimary: '{{ RoutingControlArnPrimary }}'
                RoutingControlArnSecondary: '{{ RoutingControlArnSecondary }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(event, context):
                    primary = event['PrimaryRegion']
                    secondary = event['SecondaryRegion']
                    routing_controls = {
                        primary: event['RoutingControlArnPrimary'],
                        secondary: event['RoutingControlArnSecondary'],
                    }

                    active_region = None
                    for region, rc_arn in routing_controls.items():
                        if not rc_arn:
                            continue
                        client = boto3.client('route53-recovery-cluster', region_name=region)
                        state = client.get_routing_control_state(
                            RoutingControlArn=rc_arn
                        )['RoutingControlState']
                        if state == 'On':
                            active_region = region
                            break

                    if active_region is None:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            'No routing control found in On state; cannot determine active region.'
                        )

                    failover_region = secondary if active_region == primary else primary
                    return {
                        'ActiveRegion': active_region,
                        'FailoverRegion': failover_region,
                        'ActiveRoutingControlArn': routing_controls[active_region],
                        'FailoverRoutingControlArn': routing_controls[failover_region],
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: ActiveRegion
                Selector: $.ActiveRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: FailoverRegion
                Selector: $.FailoverRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: ActiveRoutingControlArn
                Selector: $.ActiveRoutingControlArn
                Type: String
              - Name: FailoverRoutingControlArn
                Selector: $.FailoverRoutingControlArn
                Type: String
            nextStep: PerformGlobalFailover

          - name: PerformGlobalFailover
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 3600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
                ActiveRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.ActiveRegion }}'
                FailoverRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.FailoverRegion }}'
                GlobalClusterIdentifier: '{{ GlobalClusterIdentifier }}'
              Script: |-
                import time
                import boto3

                def handler(event, context):
                    failover_region = event['FailoverRegion']
                    client = boto3.client('rds', region_name=failover_region)

                    clusters = client.describe_global_clusters(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=event['GlobalClusterIdentifier']
                    )['GlobalClusters']

                    target_cluster_id = None
                    for gc in clusters:
                        for member in gc.get('GlobalClusterMembers', []):
                            if failover_region in member.get('DBClusterArn', ''):
                                target_cluster_id = member['DBClusterArn'].split(':')[-1]
                                break
                        if target_cluster_id:
                            break

                    if not target_cluster_id:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            f'No regional cluster for {failover_region} found in global cluster '
                            f'{event["GlobalClusterIdentifier"]}.'
                        )

                    response = client.failover_global_cluster(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=event['GlobalClusterIdentifier'],
                        TargetDbClusterIdentifier=target_cluster_id,
                        AllowDataLoss=False
                    )

                    waiter_state = 'pending'
                    deadline = time.time() + 1800
                    while time.time() < deadline:
                        gcs = client.describe_global_clusters(
                            GlobalClusterIdentifier=event['GlobalClusterIdentifier']
                        )['GlobalClusters']
                        statuses = []
                        for gc in gcs:
                            for member in gc.get('GlobalClusterMembers', []):
                                statuses.append(member.get('GlobalWriteForwardingStatus', ''))
                        if all(s in ('', 'available', 'optimizing') for s in statuses):
                            waiter_state = 'available'
                            break
                        time.sleep(30)

                    return {
                        'FailoverRegion': failover_region,
                        'TargetDbClusterIdentifier': target_cluster_id,
                        'FinalState': waiter_state
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: FailoverRegion
                Selector: $.FailoverRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: TargetDbClusterIdentifier
                Selector: $.TargetDbClusterIdentifier
                Type: String
            nextStep: FlipRoutingControlsAndUpdateSecret

          - name: FlipRoutingControlsAndUpdateSecret
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
                ActiveRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.ActiveRegion }}'
                FailoverRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.FailoverRegion }}'
                ActiveRoutingControlArn: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.ActiveRoutingControlArn }}'
                FailoverRoutingControlArn: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.FailoverRoutingControlArn }}'
                FailoverRegionClusterId: '{{ PerformGlobalFailover.TargetDbClusterIdentifier }}'
                SecretArn: '{{ SecretArn }}'
              Script: |-
                import time
                import boto3

                def handler(event, context):
                    active_rc = event['ActiveRoutingControlArn']
                    failover_rc = event['FailoverRoutingControlArn']

                    if active_rc and failover_rc:
                        rc_client = boto3.client(
                            'route53-recovery-cluster',
                            region_name=event['FailoverRegion']
                        )
                        rc_client.update_routing_control_state(
                            RoutingControlArn=active_rc,
                            RoutingControlState='Off'
                        )
                        rc_client.update_routing_control_state(
                            RoutingControlArn=failover_rc,
                            RoutingControlState='On'
                        )

                    rds = boto3.client('rds', region_name=event['FailoverRegion'])
                    writer_endpoint = None
                    deadline = time.time() + 900
                    while time.time() < deadline:
                        resp = rds.describe_db_clusters(
                            DBClusterIdentifier=event['FailoverRegionClusterId']
                        )
                        cluster = resp['DBClusters'][0]
                        writer_endpoint = cluster.get('Endpoint')
                        if writer_endpoint:
                            break
                        time.sleep(15)

                    if not writer_endpoint:
                        raise RuntimeError('Timed out waiting for writer endpoint after failover.')

                    secrets = boto3.client(
                        'secretsmanager',
                        region_name=event['FailoverRegion']
                    )
                    secrets.put_secret_value(
                        SecretId=event['SecretArn'],
                        SecretString='{{"writerEndpoint": "{}"}}'.format(writer_endpoint)
                    )

                    return {
                        'NewActiveRegion': event['FailoverRegion'],
                        'WriterEndpoint': writer_endpoint
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: NewActiveRegion
                Selector: $.NewActiveRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: WriterEndpoint
                Selector: $.WriterEndpoint
                Type: String

  TriggerFailover:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: TriggerFailover
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SSM_AUTOMATION_ROLE_ARN: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
          SSM_DOCUMENT_NAME: !Ref AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          SSM_DOCUMENT_NAME = os.environ['SSM_DOCUMENT_NAME']
          SSM_AUTOMATION_ROLE_ARN = os.environ['SSM_AUTOMATION_ROLE_ARN']

          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              params = body.get('parameters', {})

              document_params = {
                  'PrimaryRegion': [params.get('PrimaryRegion', 'us-east-1')],
                  'SecondaryRegion': [params.get('SecondaryRegion', 'us-west-2')],
                  'RoutingControlArnPrimary': [params.get('RoutingControlArnPrimary', '')],
                  'RoutingControlArnSecondary': [params.get('RoutingControlArnSecondary', '')],
                  'GlobalClusterIdentifier': [params['GlobalClusterIdentifier']],
                  'SecretArn': [params['SecretArn']],
                  'SsmAutomationRoleArn': [SSM_AUTOMATION_ROLE_ARN],
              }

              response = ssm.start_automation_execution(
                  DocumentName=SSM_DOCUMENT_NAME,
                  Parameters=document_params,
                  Mode='Auto'
              )

              execution_id = response['AutomationExecutionId']

              return {
                  'statusCode': 200,
                  'body': json.dumps({
                      'message': 'SSM automation execution started.',
                      'automationExecutionId': execution_id,
                      'documentName': SSM_DOCUMENT_NAME
                  })
              }

Outputs:
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the TriggerFailover Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt TriggerFailover.Arn
  SsmDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the SSM Automation document.
    Value: !Ref AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
  SsmAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by the SSM automation.
    Value: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn
  LambdaExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates a single-shard KMS-encrypted Kinesis data stream with 24-hour
  retention and a Cognito identity pool that allows unauthenticated
  identities to publish records to the stream for testing purposes.

Resources:
  KinesisStreamKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowKinesisServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'kinesis.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowKinesisServiceGrantManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'kinesis.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  KinesisStream:
    Type: AWS::Kinesis::Stream
    Properties:
      Name: my-stream-kinesis
      ShardCount: 1
      RetentionPeriodHours: 24
      StreamModeDetails:
        StreamMode: PROVISIONED
      StreamEncryption:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KeyId: !GetAtt KinesisStreamKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: unauthenticated-test-ingest

  CognitoIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: my-stream-kinesis-test-pool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true

  CognitoUnauthRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud': !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                'cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr': unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KinesisStreamPutAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                Resource: !GetAtt KinesisStream.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt KinesisStreamKey.Arn

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt CognitoUnauthRole.Arn

Outputs:
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: Cognito identity pool ID to use for unauthenticated test clients
    Value: !Ref CognitoIdentityPool
  KinesisStreamName:
    Description: Name of the Kinesis data stream
    Value: !Ref KinesisStream
  KinesisStreamArn:
    Description: ARN of the Kinesis data stream
    Value: !GetAtt KinesisStream.Arn

Description: >
  Self-contained template deploying an App Runner service for a multi-tenant
  QuickSight dashboard application. Creates an ECR repository, a task role
  with QuickSight and Directory Service permissions, and the App Runner
  service. TWO-PHASE PATTERN (CloudFormation cannot build images): Phase 1
  sources a public placeholder image (ECR Public) with auto-deployments off
  and NO custom health check (App Runner defaults are used so the placeholder
  can stabilize; the /status health check is restored in Phase 2). Phase 2
  (stack update): build and push the real image to the created repository
  with an immutable versioned tag, then stack-update the source to the
  private ECR repository (ImageIdentifier set to the repository URI with the
  chosen tag), ADD HealthCheckConfiguration (Path /status, Protocol HTTP,
  Port 8080), enable auto-deployments, add AuthenticationConfiguration, and
  create the AppRunnerAccessRole (ECR access role) in the same update since
  it is only required for private ECR pulls.

Parameters:
  DummyEmailPlaceholder:
    Type: String
    Default: dummy-email@example.com
    Description: Dummy email placeholder used for tenant user registration.

  AdminUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: qs-admin
    Description: Admin user name for the QuickSight integration.

  QuickSightTemplateId:
    Type: String
    Default: template-12345678
  QuickSightDataSetId:
    Type: String
    Default: dataset-12345678
  QuickSightDataSourceId:
    Type: String
    Default: datasource-12345678
  DatabaseId:
    Type: String
    Default: database-12345678
  TableId:
    Type: String
    Default: table-12345678
  FilterColumnId:
    Type: String
    Default: filter-column-12345678

Resources:
  EcrRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: quicksight-dashboard-app
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE

  AppRunnerTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: tasks.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightTenantProvisioning
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:CreateNamespace
                  - quicksight:DeleteNamespace
                  - quicksight:DescribeNamespace
                  - quicksight:ListNamespaces
                  - quicksight:RegisterUser
                  - quicksight:DescribeUser
                  - quicksight:DeleteUser
                  - quicksight:ListUsers
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSet
                  - quicksight:DeleteDataSet
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:UpdateDataSet
                  - quicksight:ListDataSets
                  - quicksight:DescribeTemplate
                  - quicksight:ListTemplates
                  - quicksight:CreateTemplate
                  - quicksight:CreateDashboard
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboard
                  - quicksight:ListDashboards
                  - quicksight:GenerateEmbedUrlForRegisteredUser
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSource
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:DeleteDataSource
                  - quicksight:PassDataSet
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ds:DescribeDirectories
                  - ds:DescribeTrusts
                  - ds:ListAuthorizedApplications
                Resource: '*'

  AppRunnerService:
    Type: AWS::AppRunner::Service
    Properties:
      InstanceConfiguration:
        Cpu: '1 vCPU'
        Memory: 2 GB
        InstanceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppRunnerTaskRole.Arn
      SourceConfiguration:
        AutoDeploymentsEnabled: false
        ImageRepository:
          ImageIdentifier: public.ecr.aws/aws-containers/hello-app-runner:latest
          ImageRepositoryType: ECR_PUBLIC
          ImageConfiguration:
            Port: '8080'
            RuntimeEnvironmentVariables:
              - Name: ALLOW_IP_RANGE
                Value: 0.0.0.0/0
              - Name: AWS_REGION
                Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              - Name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
                Value: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              - Name: DUMMY_EMAIL_PLACEHOLDER
                Value: !Ref DummyEmailPlaceholder
              - Name: ADMIN_USER_NAME
                Value: !Ref AdminUserName
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_TEMPLATE_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightTemplateId
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_DATASET_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDataSetId
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_DATASOURCE_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDataSourceId
              - Name: DATABASE_ID
                Value: !Ref DatabaseId
              - Name: TABLE_ID
                Value: !Ref TableId
              - Name: FILTER_COLUMN_ID
                Value: !Ref FilterColumnId

Outputs:
  EcrImageUri:
    Description: >
      Private ECR repository URI — the target for pushing the real application
      image with an immutable versioned tag. After pushing, stack-update the
      App Runner source to this repository (type ECR, auto-deployments on,
      add HealthCheckConfiguration with Path /status, Protocol HTTP, Port
      8080) and add the ECR access role (trust: build.apprunner.amazonaws.com;
      ECR GetAuthorizationToken, BatchGetImage, GetDownloadUrlForLayer and
      describe actions on this repository) in AuthenticationConfiguration.
    Value: !GetAtt EcrRepository.RepositoryUri

  AppRunnerServiceUrl:
    Description: >
      Public URL of the App Runner service. NOTE: currently serves the public
      placeholder image with auto-deployments disabled; automatic deployments
      and the /status health check activate only after the Phase 2 stack
      update switches the source to the private ECR repository.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AppRunnerService.ServiceUrl}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CIS-aligned VPC Flow Logs (REJECT) SSM Automation with direct and
  Change-Manager-approved remediation documents.

Resources:

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 400

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                Resource: '*'

  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SsmAutomationFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:ListDocumentVersions
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: '*'

  EnableFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn: AutomationExecutionRole
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: JSON
      Name: !Sub 'enable-vpc-flow-logs-${AWS::StackName}'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture on the specified VPC.
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: 'The ID of the VPC to enable flow logs on.'
          FlowLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: 'IAM role ARN that flow logs will assume to deliver logs.'
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: 'CloudWatch Logs log group for flow log delivery.'
        mainSteps:
          - name: VerifyVpcExists
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: 'Confirm the target VPC exists before enabling flow logs.'
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeVpcs
              VpcIds:
                - '{{ VpcId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: VpcId
                Selector: '$.Vpcs[0].VpcId'
          - name: EnableVpcFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: 'Create flow logs for the VPC capturing REJECT traffic.'
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: CreateFlowLogs
              ResourceIds:
                - '{{ VpcId }}'
              ResourceType: VPC
              TrafficType: REJECT
              LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
              LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
              DeliverLogsPermissionArn: '{{ FlowLogsRoleArn }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: FlowLogIds
                Selector: '$.FlowLogs[0].FlowLogId'
          - name: VerifyFlowLogCreated
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            description: 'Verify the flow log exists on the VPC and captures REJECT traffic.'
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeFlowLogs
              PropertySelector: 'FlowLogs[0].TrafficType'
              DesiredValues:
                - REJECT
              Filters:
                - Name: resource-id
                  Values:
                    - '{{ VpcId }}'
        outputs:
          - Name: CreatedFlowLogIds
            Value: '{{ EnableVpcFlowLogs.FlowLogIds }}'
            Type: StringList
          - Name: VerifiedVpcId
            Value: '{{ VerifyVpcExists.VpcId }}'
            Type: String

  ChangeApprovedFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn: EnableFlowLogsDocument
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: JSON
      Name: !Sub 'enable-vpc-flow-logs-change-approved-${AWS::StackName}'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Routes VPC flow log enablement through a formal approval gate (SSM Change Manager-compatible approval workflow) before executing remediation.'
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: 'The ID of the VPC to enable flow logs on.'
          ApproverSnsTopicArn:
            type: String
            description: 'SNS topic ARN used to notify approvers for the change request.'
          FlowLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: 'IAM role ARN that flow logs will assume (supplied at execution time).'
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: 'Flow log CloudWatch Logs log group name (supplied at execution time).'
          DirectDocumentName:
            type: String
            description: 'Name of the direct flow-log enablement automation document to execute upon approval (supplied at execution time).'
          DirectFlowLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: 'IAM role ARN passed to the direct automation (supplied at execution time).'
          DirectLogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: 'Log group name passed to the direct automation (supplied at execution time).'
        mainSteps:
          - name: ValidateChangeRequest
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: 'Record and validate the change request by confirming the target VPC exists (SSM Change Manager change template integration point).'
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeVpcs
              VpcIds:
                - '{{ VpcId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: VpcState
                Selector: '$.Vpcs[0].State'
          - name: ConfirmVpcAvailable
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            description: 'Confirm the target VPC is available before requesting approval.'
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeVpcs
              PropertySelector: 'Vpcs[0].State'
              DesiredValues:
                - available
              VpcIds:
                - '{{ VpcId }}'
          - name: WaitForApproval
            action: aws:approve
            description: 'Formal change approval gate - all real-world remediation requires approver sign-off.'
            timeoutSeconds: 86400
            inputs:
              Message: 'Change request: enable VPC Flow Logs (REJECT) on VPC {{ VpcId }} for CIS compliance remediation.'
              MinRequiredApprovals: 1
              Approvers:
                - '{{ ApproverSnsTopicArn }}'
          - name: ExecuteRemediation
            action: aws:executeAutomation
            description: 'Upon approval, run the direct flow-log enablement automation.'
            timeoutSeconds: 3600
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              DocumentName: '{{ DirectDocumentName }}'
              RunCommandParameters:
                DocumentParameters:
                  VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                  FlowLogsRoleArn: '{{ DirectFlowLogsRoleArn }}'
                  LogGroupName: '{{ DirectLogGroupName }}'
        outputs:
          - Name: RemediationAutomationExecutionId
            Value: '{{ ExecuteRemediation.AutomationExecutionId }}'
            Type: String

Outputs:
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group for VPC flow logs.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
  FlowLogsLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the flow logs log group.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
  FlowLogsRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role assumed by VPC Flow Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
  AutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: SSM Automation execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
  DirectRemediationDocumentName:
    Description: Direct flow log enablement automation document.
    Value: !Ref EnableFlowLogsDocument
  ChangeApprovedRemediationDocumentName:
    Description: Change-manager-approved flow log enablement automation document.
