final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Image Builder pipeline producing a CIS-hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 AMI with Elastic Beanstalk pre-configuration, daily builds, vulnerability scanning, multi-account distribution and 6-month lifecycle deletion.
  PREREQUISITE (manual, pre-deployment): the CIS Level 1 image is a marketplace product. In the target region, first subscribe to the CIS image product in AWS Marketplace, then obtain the exact parent image ARN verbatim via:
  aws imagebuilder list-images --owner aws --filters name=name,values=cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi
  (try --owner amazon or the marketplace subscription check if not returned). Paste the returned ARN into the ParentImageArn parameter. Do NOT guess, wildcard, or assemble version strings — copy the ARN field verbatim from the API output. The ARN is region-scoped to the deployment region.'

Parameters:
  ParentImageArn:
    Type: String
    Description: Verbatim ARN of the CIS-hardened AL2023 ARM64 parent image, copied exactly from `aws imagebuilder list-images` output in the target region (region-scoped; requires marketplace subscription)
    Default: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws:imagebuilder:[a-z0-9-]+:aws:image/[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Organization ID to share launch permissions with (o-xxxxxxxxxx)
    Default: o-dummyorganization
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Dev deployment AWS account ID
    Default: '111111111111'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Prod deployment AWS account ID
    Default: '222222222222'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
  PipelineServiceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: ImageBuilderPipelineServiceRole
  InstanceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: ImageBuilderInstanceRole

Resources:
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref InstanceRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref InstanceRoleName
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderPipelineServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref PipelineServiceRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderPipelinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/imagebuilder/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponent
                  - imagebuilder:GetImageRecipe
                  - imagebuilder:GetInfrastructureConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:GetDistributionConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:ListComponents
                  - imagebuilder:ListImageRecipes
                  - imagebuilder:ListDistributionConfigurations
                  - imagebuilder:ListInfrastructureConfigurations
                  - imagebuilder:CreateImage
                  - imagebuilder:TagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceRole.Arn

  BeanstalkPreConfigComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: eb-preconfigure-al2023-arm
      Platform: Linux
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: Pre-configures the CIS-hardened AL2023 ARM64 image for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility
      Data: |
        name: ElasticBeanstalkPreConfiguration
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: CreateEBUsersAndDirectories
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk/deploy /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks /opt/elasticbeanstalk/config
                      useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /sbin/nologin webapp || true
                      usermod -a -G wheel webapp || true
                      mkdir -p /var/log/eb-engine /var/app/current /var/app/staging /var/app/ondemand /var/app/support/logs
                      chown -R webapp:webapp /var/app /opt/elasticbeanstalk
              - name: InstallEBPrerequisites
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dnf install -y cloud-init jq unzip curl openssl
                      systemctl enable cloud-init || true
              - name: ConfigureCloudInitHooks
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      cat > /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/90-eb-bootstrap.cfg <<'EOF'
                      cloud_final_modules:
                        - scripts-user
                        - [scripts-user, always]
                      EOF
                      chmod 755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: cis-al2023-arm-eb-recipe
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: CIS Level 1 hardened AL2023 ARM64 with Elastic Beanstalk pre-configuration
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageArn
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt BeanstalkPreConfigComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: cis-al2023-arm-infra
      Description: ARM build infrastructure for CIS hardened image pipeline
      InstanceTypes:
        - m6g.xlarge
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: cis-al2023-arm-distribution
      Description: Distribute AMI to current region shared with org and dev/prod accounts
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'cis-al2023-arm-eb-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: CIS L1 hardened AL2023 ARM64 Elastic Beanstalk-ready AMI
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId
            TargetAccountIds:
              - !Ref DevAccountId
              - !Ref ProdAccountId

  DailyBuildScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: cis-al2023-arm-daily-build
      ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 6 * * ? *)'
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: ImageBuilderPipelineTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt ImagePipeline.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToImageBuilderRole.Arn

  EventBridgeToImageBuilderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartImagePipelineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: imagebuilder:StartImagePipelineExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt ImagePipeline.Arn

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: cis-al2023-arm-pipeline
      Description: Daily scheduled pipeline for CIS hardened AL2023 ARM64 EB-ready AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 720

  ImageLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: cis-al2023-arm-ami-expiry
      Description: Automatically delete AMIs older than 6 months
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicyExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Name
            SemanticVersion: '1.0.0'
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DELETE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 180
            Unit: DAYS

  LifecyclePolicyExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LifecycleAmiDeletion
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless Maths MCP (Model Context Protocol) server with API Gateway, Lambda, and Cognito authentication for testing purposes.

Parameters:
  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Stage name for the API Gateway deployment.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-users
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: maths-mcp-client
    Description: Name of the Cognito app client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-maths-mcp-api'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  McpAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mcp-authorizer'
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization

  McpResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: mcp

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  McpLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 512
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          CORS_HEADERS = {
              'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type,Authorization,X-Amz-Date,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'GET,POST,OPTIONS',
          }

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              http_method = event.get('httpMethod', '')
              path = event.get('path', '/')
              if http_method == 'GET' and path == '/':
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': CORS_HEADERS,
                      'body': json.dumps({'status': 'healthy', 'service': 'maths-mcp-server'}),
                  }
              if http_method == 'POST' and path == '/mcp':
                  try:
                      body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  except json.JSONDecodeError:
                      body = {}
                  return {
                      'statusCode': 200,
                      'headers': CORS_HEADERS,
                      'body': json.dumps({'status': 'received', 'request': body}),
                  }
              return {
                  'statusCode': 404,
                  'headers': CORS_HEADERS,
                  'body': json.dumps({'message': 'Not Found'}),
              }

  RootGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${McpLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  McpPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref McpAuthorizer
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${McpLambdaFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  McpOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref McpResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: 200
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,Authorization,X-Amz-Date,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,OPTIONS'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true

  LambdaApiGatewayPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref McpLambdaFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/*'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - RootGetMethod
      - McpPostMethod
      - McpOptionsMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      StageName: !Ref DeploymentStage
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment

Outputs:
  ApiBaseUrl:
    Description: Regional API base URL for the Maths MCP server.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}'
  HealthCheckUrl:
    Description: Publicly accessible health check endpoint (GET /).
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}/'
  McpEndpointUrl:
    Description: Protected MCP endpoint (POST /mcp) secured by the Cognito authorizer.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${DeploymentStage}/mcp'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito app client.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

Description: >
  Fargate ECS task definition referencing an ECR image via a dynamically
  constructed URI, with a task role, a separate execution role for ECR pulls,
  and a pre-provisioned CloudWatch Logs log group.

Resources:
  SampleContainerRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: sample-container-repo
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true

  ContainerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /ecs/sample-container-repo
      RetentionInDays: 30

  ECSTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ECSTaskExecutionPullAndLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EcrGetAuthorizationToken
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrImagePull
                Effect: Allow

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >
  Serverless REST API via API Gateway that accepts email submissions (POST)
  and sends them through Amazon SES via a Lambda proxy integration.
  Secured with an API key and usage plan (throttling + quota).
  Request bodies are validated against a JSON schema by API Gateway.
  PREREQUISITE: SES sender identities (the "from" address and any "to"
  addresses in sandbox mode) must be verified out-of-band in SES.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$'
    Description: API Gateway deployment stage name.
  ApiKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: email-apikey
    Description: Name of the API key used to secure the API.

Resources:
  ApiRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: email-submission-api
      Description: REST API for submitting emails via SES
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  EmailModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiRestApi
      ContentType: application/json
      Name: EmailSubmissionModel
      Schema:
        $schema: 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#'
        title: EmailSubmission
        type: object
        properties:
          to:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          from:
            type: string
          cc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          bcc:
            type: array
            items:
              type: string
          subject:
            type: string
          html:
            type: string
          text:
            type: string
        required:
          - to
          - from
          - html
          - text

  RequestValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiRestApi
      Name: email-body-validator
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: true

  EmailSenderLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SesSendEmailPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'ses:SendEmail'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/*'

  EmailSenderLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'email-submission-sender-${AWS::Region}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 15
      Role: !GetAtt EmailSenderLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          ses = boto3.client('ses')

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return _resp(400, {'message': 'Invalid JSON body'})

              required = ['to', 'from', 'html', 'text']
              missing = [f for f in required if f not in body]
              if missing:
                  return _resp(400, {'message': 'Missing required fields: ' + ', '.join(missing)})

              if not isinstance(body['to'], list) or not body['to']:
                  return _resp(400, {'message': '"to" must be a non-empty array of addresses'})

              kwargs = {
                  'Source': body['from'],
                  'Destination': {'ToAddresses': body['to']},
                  'Message': {
                      'Subject': {'Data': body.get('subject', '')},
                      'Body': {
                          'Html': {'Data': body['html']},
                          'Text': {'Data': body['text']}
                      }
                  }
              }
              if body.get('cc'):
                  kwargs['Destination']['CcAddresses'] = body['cc']
              if body.get('bcc'):
                  kwargs['Destination']['BccAddresses'] = body['bcc']

              try:
                  ses.send_email(**kwargs)
              except ClientError as e:
                  code = e.response['Error']['Code']
                  if code in ('MessageRejected', 'ValidationError'):
                      return _resp(400, {'message': 'Email rejected by SES: ' + str(e)})
                  return _resp(500, {'message': 'Internal error sending email'})

              return _resp(200, {'message': 'Email submitted successfully'})

          def _resp(status, payload):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status,
                  'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                  'body': json.dumps(payload)
              }

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref EmailSenderLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ApiRestApi}/*/*/'

  PostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    DependsOn:
      - EmailSenderLambda
      - LambdaInvokePermission
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiRestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt ApiRestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: POST
      ApiKeyRequired: true
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref RequestValidator
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref EmailModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${EmailSenderLambda.Arn}/invocations'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: 200
        - StatusCode: 400
        - StatusCode: 500

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - PostMethod
      - EmailModel
      - RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiRestApi

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ApiRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      Description: Email submission API stage

  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::ApiKey
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiKeyName
      Enabled: true

  UsagePlan:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlan
    DependsOn: ApiStage
    Properties:
      UsagePlanName: email-api-usage-plan
      Description: Usage plan with throttling and quota for email submission API
      ApiStages:
        - ApiId: !Ref ApiRestApi
          Stage: !Ref StageName
      Throttle:
        RateLimit: 500
        BurstLimit: 1000
      Quota:
        Limit: 10000
        Period: MONTH

  UsagePlanKey:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::UsagePlanKey
    Properties:
      KeyId: !Ref ApiKey
      KeyType: API_KEY
      UsagePlanId: !Ref UsagePlan

Outputs:
  ApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL for the email submission POST endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${ApiRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'
  ApiKeyId:
    Description: API key ID (use with x-api-key header)
    Value: !Ref ApiKey
  StageName:
    Description: Deployed stage name
    Value: !Ref StageName

Description: >-
  Reusable module (deployable standalone or embedded as a nested stack via
  AWS::CloudFormation::Stack) that provisions an SNS topic encrypted with a
  customer-managed KMS key (created in this template with automatic key
  rotation) and subscribes optional endpoints (email, SQS, Lambda, HTTPS) to
  it. The SNS topic and its CMK are provisioned by this template; the four
  endpoint identifiers remain caller-supplied inputs, each gated by a sentinel
  default so the corresponding subscription is created only when the caller
  supplies a real endpoint value. Every created subscription exposes its ARN as
  a stack output, and an unconditional TopicArn output lets consumers retrieve
  the provisioned topic.

Parameters:
  EmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: example@example.com
    Description: >-

      subscription. Email endpoints require owner confirmation before delivery;
      until the recipient confirms, the returned subscription ARN remains in
      pending-confirmation state.

    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:sqs:placeholder:placeholder:SENTINEL

      (Optional) ARN of an externally owned SQS queue to subscribe. The sentinel
      default disables the subscription. NOTE: The referenced queue must have a
      queue policy granting sns.amazonaws.com SendMessage permission scoped to

      template.
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Type: String
    Default: arn:aws:lambda:placeholder:placeholder:function:SENTINEL

  HttpsEndpointUrl:

  HttpsSubscription:

    Properties:

      Endpoint: !Ref HttpsEndpointUrl
      TopicArn: !Ref Topic

          maxDelayTarget: 60
          numRetries: 20
          numMinDelayRetries: 0
          numMaxDelayRetries: 0
          numNoDelayRetries: 0

Outputs:

      ARN of the SNS topic provisioned by this template, encrypted with the

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  EC2 Image Builder pipeline that builds a bastion-style Amazon Linux 2023 AMI
  with SSM Agent, MongoDB 8.0 tools (mongodb-database-tools, mongosh), Python 3
  with Synapse client, and the .NET SDK. Creates a self-contained VPC with a
  private build subnet and NAT Gateway for internet access, IAM roles for both
  the build instance and the Image Builder service, and optionally distributes
  the AMI to an AWS Organization.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedPattern: ^[-_A-Za-z0-9]+$
    Description: Environment tag applied to all resources.
  AmiNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: bastion-al2023
    AllowedPattern: ^[-_A-Za-z0-9]+$
    Description: Prefix for the name of the built AMI.
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: ^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$
    Description: Semantic version of the Image Builder image recipe.
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1024
    Description: Size (GiB) of the AMI's EBS root volume.
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^(o-[a-z0-9]{10,32})?$
    Description: >
      Optional AWS Organization ID (o-xxxxxxxxxx). When supplied, the built AMI
      is shared with all accounts in that organization.

Conditions:
  HasOrganizationId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationId, '']]
  NoOrganizationId: !Equals [!Ref OrganizationId, '']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-imagebuilder-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-imagebuilder-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-imagebuilder-public'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-imagebuilder-private'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-imagebuilder-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatElasticIp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VpcGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-imagebuilder-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatElasticIp.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-imagebuilder-nat'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-imagebuilder-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  BuildInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Build/test instance security group - no inbound access, default outbound via NAT
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-imagebuilder-build-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Environment}-imagebuilder-instance-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilderECRContainerBuilds'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-imagebuilder-instance-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceRole

  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Environment}-imagebuilder-service-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderServicePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/imagebuilder/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:existingObjectTag/imagebuilder: true
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:StartInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt InstanceRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ec2.amazonaws.com
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-imagebuilder-service-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Builder Components
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SsmAgentComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-install-ssm-agent'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Installs and updates the latest SSM Agent on Amazon Linux 2023.
      Data: |
        name: InstallLatestSsmAgent
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallSsmAgent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dnf -y update amazon-ssm-agent || dnf -y install amazon-ssm-agent
                      systemctl enable amazon-ssm-agent
                      amazon-ssm-agent -version

  MongoDbComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-install-mongodb-tools'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.1
      Description: Adds the MongoDB 8.0 yum repository and installs mongodb-database-tools and mongosh.
      Data: |
        name: InstallMongoDbTools
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: AddMongoDbRepo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      printf '%s\n' \
                        '[mongodb-org-8.0]' \
                        'name=MongoDB Repository' \
                        'baseurl=https://repo.mongodb.org/yum/amazon/2023/mongodb-org/8.0/x86_64/' \
                        'gpgcheck=1' \
                        'enabled=1' \
                        'gpgkey=https://pgp.mongodb.com/server-8.0.asc' \
                        > /etc/yum.repos.d/mongodb-org-8.0.repo
                      dnf clean all
                      dnf -y makecache
              - name: InstallMongoDbTools
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dnf -y install mongodb-database-tools mongodb-mongosh
                      mongosh --version

  SynapseComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-install-python-synapse'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.1
      Description: Installs Python 3, pip, and the Synapse Python client library.
      Data: |
        name: InstallPythonSynapse
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallPythonSynapse
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dnf -y install python3 python3-pip
                      pip3 install --no-cache-dir synapseclient
                      python3 -c "import synapseclient; print(synapseclient.__version__)"

  DotNetComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-install-dotnet-sdk'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Installs the .NET SDK required to run a GitHub Actions self-hosted runner.
      Data: |
        name: InstallDotNetSdk
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallDotNetSdk
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dnf -y install dotnet-sdk-8.0
                      dotnet --version

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image Recipe, Infrastructure, Distribution, Pipeline
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-bastion-al2023-recipe'
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Bastion AL2023 image with SSM Agent, MongoDB tools, Synapse, and .NET SDK.
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64}}'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SsmAgentComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt MongoDbComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SynapseComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt DotNetComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Name: !Sub '${Environment}-bastion-al2023-recipe'

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-bastion-infra-config'
      Description: Infrastructure configuration for the bastion AMI build.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref InstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - t3.medium
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt BuildInstanceSecurityGroup.GroupId
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Name: !Sub '${Environment}-bastion-infra-config'

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Condition: HasOrganizationId
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-bastion-distribution'
      Description: Distributes the bastion AMI to the AWS Organization.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AmiNamePrefix}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: Bastion Amazon Linux 2023 AMI with MongoDB tools, Synapse, and .NET SDK.
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Name: !Sub '${Environment}-bastion-distribution'

  DistributionConfigurationNoOrg:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Condition: NoOrganizationId
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-bastion-distribution-no-org'
      Description: Distributes the bastion AMI without organization sharing.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AmiNamePrefix}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: Bastion Amazon Linux 2023 AMI with MongoDB tools, Synapse, and .NET SDK.
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Name: !Sub '${Environment}-bastion-distribution-no-org'

  BastionImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${Environment}-bastion-al2023-pipeline'
      Description: !Sub 'Asynchronous pipeline building the ${AmiNamePrefix} AMI (recipe version ${ImageVersion}).'
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !If
        - HasOrganizationId
        - !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
        - !GetAtt DistributionConfigurationNoOrg.Arn
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AmiNamePrefix}-${ImageVersion}'
        Environment: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder pipeline. Trigger a build via StartImagePipelineExecution; the AMI ID appears in the Image Builder console (or `aws imagebuilder list-images`) once the first build completes.
    Value: !Ref BastionImagePipeline
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the image recipe used by the pipeline.
    Value: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC created for the build.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: Private subnet used by the build/test instance.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Plot Palette DynamoDB stack.
  Creates four DynamoDB tables (Jobs, Queue, Templates, CostTracking) with
  on-demand billing, customer-managed KMS server-side encryption, and
  point-in-time recovery. Table names follow the pattern
  plot-palette-<TableName>-<Environment>.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - development
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Deployment environment used in table names (plot-palette-<TableName>-<Environment>).

Resources:
  # Single customer-managed KMS key used for server-side encryption of all
  # four DynamoDB tables. Retained so table data remains decryptable across
  # stack lifecycle events. Key rotation is enabled.
  # NOTE: the DynamoDB service principal is the global constant
  # dynamodb.amazonaws.com (DynamoDB does not publish regional principals).
  # Regional scoping is applied via the kms:ViaService condition instead.
  PlotPaletteDynamoDbKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Plot Palette DynamoDB server-side encryption key (${EnvironmentName})'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBToUseTheKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 'dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  # Jobs table
  # ASSUMPTION: all key/GSI attribute types are String (S); the original
  # request did not specify types. If the application writes numeric values
  # for created_at (or any other key/GSI attribute), change AttributeType
  # to N. A mismatch between AttributeType and actual item data causes
  # runtime write failures (not deployment failures).
  PlotPaletteJobsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-Jobs-${EnvironmentName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: user_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: created_at
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: user-id-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: user_id
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: created_at
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt PlotPaletteDynamoDbKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: plot-palette

  # Queue table (no GSIs)
  PlotPaletteQueueTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-Queue-${EnvironmentName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: status
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: job_id_timestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: status
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: job_id_timestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt PlotPaletteDynamoDbKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: plot-palette

  # Templates table
  # ASSUMPTION: version is String (S). If the application writes numeric
  # version values, change AttributeType to N (runtime write failures would
  # otherwise occur; this is not a deployment-time failure).
  PlotPaletteTemplatesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-Templates-${EnvironmentName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: template_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: version
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: user_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: template_id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: version
          KeyType: RANGE
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: user-id-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: user_id
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt PlotPaletteDynamoDbKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: plot-palette

  # CostTracking table with TTL enabled on the ttl attribute.
  # ttl is a TTL-only attribute and is intentionally NOT listed in
  # AttributeDefinitions (only key/GSI key attributes belong there).
  PlotPaletteCostTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'plot-palette-CostTracking-${EnvironmentName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: timestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: job_id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: timestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt PlotPaletteDynamoDbKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: plot-palette

Outputs:
  JobsTableName:
    Description: Physical name of the Plot Palette Jobs table.
    Value: !Ref PlotPaletteJobsTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-JobsTableName'

  JobsTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the Plot Palette Jobs table.
    Value: !GetAtt PlotPaletteJobsTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-JobsTableArn'

  QueueTableName:
    Description: Physical name of the Plot Palette Queue table.
    Value: !Ref PlotPaletteQueueTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-QueueTableName'

  QueueTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the Plot Palette Queue table.
    Value: !GetAtt PlotPaletteQueueTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-QueueTableArn'

  TemplatesTableName:
    Description: Physical name of the Plot Palette Templates table.
    Value: !Ref PlotPaletteTemplatesTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TemplatesTableName'

  TemplatesTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the Plot Palette Templates table.
    Value: !GetAtt PlotPaletteTemplatesTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TemplatesTableArn'

  CostTrackingTableName:
    Description: Physical name of the Plot Palette CostTracking table.
    Value: !Ref PlotPaletteCostTrackingTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CostTrackingTableName'

  CostTrackingTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the Plot Palette CostTracking table.
    Value: !GetAtt PlotPaletteCostTrackingTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CostTrackingTableArn'

  UserIdIndexName:
    Description: Name of the user-id-index GSI shared by the Jobs and Templates tables.
    Value: user-id-index
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserIdIndexName'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained AWS AppSync GraphQL API "WS-API" with API_KEY authentication,
  designed for real-time WebSocket communication via subscriptions and
  mutations. Includes a NONE data source ("pubsub") and a UNIT resolver for
  the publish2channel mutation that passes arguments directly as the payload,
  plus a default API key. No external infrastructure is referenced.

Resources:
  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: WS-API
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      # No additional authentication providers (IAM, Cognito, OIDC, Lambda).

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Channel {
          name: String!
          data: AWSJSON!
        }

        type Query {
          getChannel: Channel
        }

        type Mutation {
          publish2channel(name: String!, data: AWSJSON!): Channel
        }

        type Subscription {
          subscribe2channel(name: String!): Channel
            @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["publish2channel"])
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
          subscription: Subscription
        }

  PubSubDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: pubsub
      Type: NONE
      # A NONE data source requires no IAM service role and no external resources.

  # NOTE: No resolver is defined for the getChannel query (not requested).
  # getChannel will return null until a resolver is added for it.
  Publish2ChannelResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: publish2channel
      # FIX: !Ref on AWS::AppSync::DataSource resolves to the data source ARN
      # (arn:aws:appsync:<region>:<account>:apis/<apiid>/datasources/pubsub),
      # whose ':' and '/' characters fail AppSync's DataSourceName pattern
      # validation ("name contains an invalid character"). DataSourceName must
      # be the plain identifier assigned to PubSubDataSource above, so the
      # literal name "pubsub" is used here. It is a name defined within this
      # template, not an external/account-specific resource ID.
      DataSourceName: pubsub
      Kind: UNIT
      RequestMappingTemplate: |-
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": $util.toJson($ctx.args)
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |-
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  ApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      # Expires intentionally omitted so no hardcoded timestamp is baked in;
      # the service default expiration applies.
      # WARNING: AppSync API keys expire and must be rotated. For production
      # workloads, prefer Cognito/OIDC/Lambda auth over API keys.

Outputs:
  GraphQLUrl:
    Description: GraphQL endpoint URL for the WS-API AppSync API
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  ApiKey:
    Description: Default AppSync API key (expires; rotate for continued use)
    Value: !GetAtt ApiKey.ApiKey
  ApiId:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API ID
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
  Region:
    Description: AWS Region in which the WS-API AppSync API is deployed
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates six monthly COST budgets for security-relevant services (AWS Config,
  Amazon CloudWatch + CloudWatch Events, Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector,
  AWS Security Hub, and S3-based security logging), each alerting at 80% and
  100% of actual monthly spend to a dedicated SNS topic. All budgets are
  protected from deletion or replacement during stack updates.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Linked Account Scoping (deploy-time inputs — required, no defaults)
        Parameters:
          - CloudWatchLinkedAccountIds
          - SecurityLoggingLinkedAccountId
    ParameterLabels:
      CloudWatchLinkedAccountIds:
        default: 'CloudWatch/Events Budget — Two Linked Member Account IDs (comma-separated, 12 digits each)'
      SecurityLoggingLinkedAccountId:
        default: 'S3 Security Logging Budget — Linked Member Account ID (12 digits)'

Parameters:
  CloudWatchLinkedAccountIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: >-
      Exactly two linked member account IDs (supplied as two comma-separated
      12-digit values, e.g. 111111111111,222222222222) whose combined Amazon
      CloudWatch and Amazon CloudWatch Events costs are tracked by the
      CloudWatch budget.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Each value must be a 12-digit AWS account ID.
  SecurityLoggingLinkedAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      The linked member account ID whose Amazon S3 security logging costs are
      tracked by the S3 security logging budget. Supplied at deployment time.
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: The account ID must be exactly 12 digits.
    MinLength: 12
    MaxLength: 12

Resources:
  BudgetAlertsTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key encrypting the security cost budget alerts SNS topic.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccountFullControl
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'

  BudgetAlertsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: security-cost-budget-alerts
      DisplayName: SecurityCostBudgetAlerts
      KmsMasterKeyId: !GetAtt BudgetAlertsTopicKey.Arn

  BudgetAlertsTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  SageMaker notebook instance for RAPIDS AI development with VPC, subnet,
  security group, IAM role, and lifecycle configuration installing a RAPIDS
  conda environment, registering a Jupyter kernel, and cloning
  rapidsai/notebooks. All GPU notebook quotas are 0 in this account — verify
  quota Value >= 1 (or file increase L-7A27E6EE for ml.p3.2xlarge) before
  deploying GPU types. ml.m5.xlarge is a CPU-only interim fallback that
  cannot run CUDA workloads.

Parameters:
  NotebookInstanceType:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Notebook instance type. GPU types require the account quota
      (Value >= 1) to be verified or approved first — all GPU quotas are
      currently 0. ml.m5.xlarge is a CPU-only, documented-deviation fallback
      that cannot run RAPIDS CUDA workloads.
    Default: ml.p3.2xlarge
    AllowedValues:
      - ml.p3.2xlarge
      - ml.g4dn.xlarge
      - ml.g5.xlarge
      - ml.m5.xlarge
    ConstraintDescription: Must be one of the allowed notebook instance types.

Resources:
  NotebookVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai-notebook-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: rapidsai-dev

  NotebookSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref NotebookVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs:
            Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai-notebook-subnet
        - Key: Environment
          Value: rapidsai-dev

  NotebookSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for RAPIDS SageMaker notebook instance (no inbound; access via SageMaker HTTPS endpoint)
      VpcId: !Ref NotebookVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai-notebook-sg
        - Key: Environment
          Value: rapidsai-dev

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: rapidsai-notebook-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: rapidsai-lifecycle-config-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:DescribeNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:CreateNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:DeleteNotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: rapidsai-dev

  RapidsLifecycleConfig:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstanceLifecycleConfig
    Properties:
      OnCreate:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            set -u
            sudo -u ec2-user -H bash <<'EOS'
            set -e
            source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh || source /home/ec2-user/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
            if ! conda env list | grep -q "^rapids "; then
              conda create -y -n rapids -c rapidsai -c nvidia -c conda-forge rapids cuda-version=12.0 python=3.10
            fi
            conda activate rapids
            python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids --display-name "RAPIDS AI (Python 3, CUDA 12)"
            EOS
            mkdir -p /home/ec2-user/SageMaker
            if [ ! -d /home/ec2-user/SageMaker/notebooks ]; then
              sudo -u ec2-user -H git clone https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks /home/ec2-user/SageMaker/notebooks || true
            fi
            exit 0
      OnStart:
        - Content: !Base64 |
            set -u
            sudo -u ec2-user -H bash <<'EOS'
            set -e
            source /home/ec2-user/anaconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh || source /home/ec2-user/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
            if conda env list | grep -q "^rapids "; then
              conda activate rapids
              jupyter kernelspec list 2>/dev/null | grep -q "^rapids " || \
                python -m ipykernel install --user --name rapids --display-name "RAPIDS AI (Python 3, CUDA 12)" || true
            fi
            EOS
            exit 0

  RapidsNotebookInstance:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      NotebookInstanceName: rapidsai
      InstanceType: !Ref NotebookInstanceType
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
      SubnetId: !Ref NotebookSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref NotebookSecurityGroup
      VolumeSizeInGB: 50
      DefaultCodeRepository: https://github.com/rapidsai/notebooks
      LifecycleConfigName: !Select
        - 1
        - !Split ['/', !Ref RapidsLifecycleConfig]
      RootAccess: Disabled
      DirectInternetAccess: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: rapidsai
        - Key: Environment
          Value: rapidsai-dev

Outputs:
  NotebookInstanceArn:
    Description: ARN of the RAPIDS SageMaker notebook instance
    Value: !Sub 'arn:aws:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:notebook-instance/rapidsai'
  NotebookInstanceName:
    Description: Name of the RAPIDS SageMaker notebook instance
    Value: !Ref RapidsNotebookInstance
  LifecycleConfigArn:
    Description: ARN of the notebook instance lifecycle configuration
    Value: !Ref RapidsLifecycleConfig
  LifecycleConfigName:
    Description: Name of the notebook instance lifecycle configuration
    Value: !Select
      - 1
      - !Split ['/', !Ref RapidsLifecycleConfig]
  SubnetId:
    Description: Subnet hosting the notebook instance
    Value: !Ref NotebookSubnet
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group attached to the notebook instance
    Value: !Ref NotebookSecurityGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  SLO monitoring dashboard and alarms for the FSxN S3AP event-driven pipeline.
  Creates four SLO CloudWatch alarms and one CloudWatch dashboard only when
  EnableSLOMonitoring is "true". An always-created SSM parameter records the
  deployment configuration so the stack is never empty. All metrics are custom
  metrics emitted at runtime by the pipeline and canary; no infrastructure
  resources are required.

Parameters:
  EnableSLOMonitoring:
    Type: String
    Description: Set to "true" to deploy the SLO alarms and dashboard.
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"

  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix used to construct all alarm, dashboard, and config parameter names.
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    AllowedPattern: "^(?!aws)[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Prefix may contain only alphanumerics and hyphens and must not begin with "aws".

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Description: Namespace for the S3AP pipeline SLO metrics.
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns

  CanaryNamespace:
    Type: String
    Description: Namespace for the synthetic canary metrics.
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary

  EventIngestionLatencyThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: P99 event ingestion latency SLO threshold in seconds.
    Default: 5

  ProcessingSuccessRateThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: Processing success rate SLO threshold in percent.
    Default: 99.5

  FPolicyReconnectTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: FPolicy reconnect time SLO threshold in seconds.
    Default: 30

  ReplayCompletionTimeThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Description: Replay completion time SLO threshold in seconds.
    Default: 300

  AlarmNotificationTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Optional pre-existing SNS topic ARN to receive alarm notifications.
      Leave empty to disable alarm action forwarding.
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^arn:aws[a-z-]*:sns:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:.+$"

Conditions:
  DeploySLOMonitoring: !Equals [!Ref EnableSLOMonitoring, "true"]
  HasNotificationTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopicArn, ""]]

Resources:
  SloMonitoringConfig:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-monitoring-config"
      Type: String
      Description: Deployment configuration record for the FSxN S3AP SLO monitoring stack.
      Value: !Sub |
        {
          "EnableSLOMonitoring": "${EnableSLOMonitoring}",
          "MetricNamespace": "${MetricNamespace}",
          "CanaryNamespace": "${CanaryNamespace}",
          "DashboardName": "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard"
        }

  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: DeploySLOMonitoring
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-slo-event-ingestion-latency"
      AlarmDescription: !Sub "P99 event ingestion latency exceeded ${EventIngestionLatencyThreshold} seconds over three consecutive 5-minute periods."
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency
      ExtendedStatistic: p99
      Threshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If [HasNotificationTopic, [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      OKActions: !If [HasNotificationTopic, [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopicArn], !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-service Cognito user pool for testing JWT authentication flows with an
  AgentCore Gateway and MCP server. Includes a hosted UI domain, an "api"
  resource server with "mcp" and "gateway" custom scopes, one public web
  client (authorization code + PKCE with USER_PASSWORD_AUTH and USER_SRP_AUTH),
  and two machine-to-machine client-credentials clients (one scoped to
  api/gateway, one scoped to api/mcp). Everything is self-contained; no
  external SES, SSM, Secrets Manager, or network resources are required.

Parameters:
  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Allowed callback URLs for the public web client (comma-delimited).
    Default: "http://localhost:3000/callback"
  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Allowed logout URLs for the public web client (comma-delimited).
    Default: "http://localhost:3000/"

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub 'agentcore-auth-test-${AWS::Region}'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailSubject: 'Your AgentCore authentication test account verification code'
        EmailMessage: 'Your verification code is {####}. Enter this code on the signup page to confirm your account with no admin intervention.'
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  ApiResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: api
      Name: AgentCoreApi
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: mcp
          ScopeDescription: Access scope for MCP server authentication.
        - ScopeName: gateway
          ScopeDescription: Access scope for AgentCore Gateway authentication.

  HostedUiDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub 'agentcore-test-${AWS::AccountId}'

  PublicWebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ApiResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: public-web-client
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - api/mcp
        - api/gateway
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  GatewayM2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ApiResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: agentcore-gateway-m2m-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - api/gateway
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  McpM2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ApiResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: agentcore-mcp-m2m-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - api/mcp
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito user pool (used as the audience/issuer identifier for JWT validation).
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito user pool (reference this in AgentCore Gateway and MCP server auth configuration).
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  IssuerUrl:
    Description: JWT issuer / provider URL for the user pool.
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}'
  HostedUiUrl:
    Description: Hosted UI domain URL for self-service signup and login pages.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${HostedUiDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  PublicWebClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the public web client (authorization code + PKCE, USER_PASSWORD_AUTH, USER_SRP_AUTH).
    Value: !Ref PublicWebClient
  GatewayM2MClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the gateway M2M client (client credentials, api/gateway scope). Has a generated secret.
    Value: !Ref GatewayM2MClient
  McpM2MClientId:
    Description: Client ID of the MCP server M2M client (client credentials, api/mcp scope). Has a generated secret.
    Value: !Ref McpM2MClient
  ClientSecretsRetrievalNote:
    Description: >-
      Client secrets are deliberately not exposed in CloudFormation Outputs to
      avoid plaintext secret exposure. Retrieve each M2M client secret after
      deployment with: aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool-client --user-pool-id
      <UserPoolId> --client-id <ClientId> --query UserPoolClient.ClientSecret
      --output text
    Value: "Client secrets are not included in these Outputs; fetch them post-deployment via cognito-idp describe-user-pool-client."
