AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained greenfield stack: Cognito User Pool with a machine-to-machine
  client-credentials app client and a custom resource server scope, a
  customer-managed KMS key with rotation, and a Cognito-authorized API Gateway
  REST API proxying to a public sample backend, deployed to a prod stage with
  INFO logging and full data tracing.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyServerlessLandUserPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool.
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyWebClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine app client.
  AppClientCallbackURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com/callback
    Description: Allowed OAuth callback URL for the app client.
  AppClientLogoutURL:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com/logout
    Description: Allowed OAuth logout URL for the app client.

Resources:

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub
        - "myserverlessland-${StackUuid}"
        - StackUuid: !Select
            - 2
            - !Split
              - "/"
              - !Ref "AWS::StackId"

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: petstore-api.example.com
      Name: Petstore API Resource Server
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: domestic.read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to domestic pet data

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      GenerateSecret: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Ref AppClientCallbackURL
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Ref AppClientLogoutURL

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Enabled: true
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountRootFullKmsAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeDataKeysAndDecrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/serverless-land-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: MyServerlessLandApi
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoUserPoolAuthorizer
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  DomesticResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: domestic

  DomesticPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref DomesticResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref ApiAuthorizer
      AuthorizationScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      Integration:
        Type: HTTP_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        Uri: https://httpbin.org/post

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: DomesticPostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn: ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: prod
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: "/*"
          HttpMethod: "*"
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: true
          MetricsEnabled: true

Outputs:
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool.
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: Base URL of the prod stage of the REST API.
    Value: !Sub "https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod"
  AppClientId:
    Description: ID of the machine-to-machine app client.
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key.
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth token endpoint of the user pool domain.
    Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth/token"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained AWS Backup infrastructure. Creates a customer-managed KMS key
  with rotation, three encrypted backup vaults, three tag-based backup plans
  (daily/weekly/monthly at 05:00 UTC), an AWS Backup service role, tag-based
  backup selections, and Service Catalog TagOptions for the backup tag values.

Resources:

  BackupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Description: Customer-managed CMK used by all AWS Backup vaults in this stack
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAWSBackupServiceUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:backup:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BackupServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForBackup'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForRestores'
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  BackupVaultDaily:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn
      BackupVaultTags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Schedule: daily

  BackupVaultWeekly:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-weekly-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn
      BackupVaultTags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Schedule: weekly

  BackupVaultMonthly:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-vault'
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn
      BackupVaultTags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Schedule: monthly

  BackupPlanDaily:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-plan'
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: DailyBackupAt0500UTC
            TargetBackupVault: !GetAtt BackupVaultDaily.BackupVaultName
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 * * ? *)'
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 360
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 14
      BackupPlanTags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Schedule: daily

  BackupPlanWeekly:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-weekly-plan'
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: WeeklyBackupSundayAt0500UTC
            TargetBackupVault: !GetAtt BackupVaultWeekly.BackupVaultName
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 ? * SUN *)'
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 360
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 56
      BackupPlanTags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Schedule: weekly

  BackupPlanMonthly:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-plan'
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: MonthlyBackupFirstDayAt0500UTC
            TargetBackupVault: !GetAtt BackupVaultMonthly.BackupVaultName
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 1 * ? *)'
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 360
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: 365
      BackupPlanTags:
        StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        Schedule: monthly

  BackupSelectionDaily:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !GetAtt BackupPlanDaily.BackupPlanId
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-daily-selection'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        Resources: []
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: daily

  BackupSelectionWeekly:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !GetAtt BackupPlanWeekly.BackupPlanId
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-weekly-selection'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        Resources: []
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: weekly

  BackupSelectionMonthly:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !GetAtt BackupPlanMonthly.BackupPlanId
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monthly-selection'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        Resources: []
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: backup
            ConditionValue: monthly

  TagOptionDaily:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: daily
      Active: true

  TagOptionWeekly:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: weekly
      Active: true

  TagOptionMonthly:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: backup
      Value: monthly
      Active: true

Outputs:

  DailyBackupPlanId:
    Description: Backup plan ID for the daily schedule
    Value: !GetAtt BackupPlanDaily.BackupPlanId

  DailyBackupPlanArn:
    Description: Backup plan ARN for the daily schedule
    Value: !Sub 'arn:aws:backup:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:backup-plan:${BackupPlanDaily.BackupPlanId}'

  WeeklyBackupPlanId:
    Description: Backup plan ID for the weekly schedule
    Value: !GetAtt BackupPlanWeekly.BackupPlanId

  WeeklyBackupPlanArn:
    Description: Backup plan ARN for the weekly schedule
    Value: !Sub 'arn:aws:backup:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:backup-plan:${BackupPlanWeekly.BackupPlanId}'

  MonthlyBackupPlanId:
    Description: Backup plan ID for the monthly schedule
    Value: !GetAtt BackupPlanMonthly.BackupPlanId

  MonthlyBackupPlanArn:
    Description: Backup plan ARN for the monthly schedule
    Value: !Sub 'arn:aws:backup:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:backup-plan:${BackupPlanMonthly.BackupPlanId}'

  DailyBackupVaultName:
    Description: Name of the daily backup vault
    Value: !GetAtt BackupVaultDaily.BackupVaultName

  DailyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: ARN of the daily backup vault
    Value: !GetAtt BackupVaultDaily.BackupVaultArn

  WeeklyBackupVaultName:
    Description: Name of the weekly backup vault
    Value: !GetAtt BackupVaultWeekly.BackupVaultName

  WeeklyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: ARN of the weekly backup vault
    Value: !GetAtt BackupVaultWeekly.BackupVaultArn

  MonthlyBackupVaultName:
    Description: Name of the monthly backup vault
    Value: !GetAtt BackupVaultMonthly.BackupVaultName

  MonthlyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: ARN of the monthly backup vault
    Value: !GetAtt BackupVaultMonthly.BackupVaultArn

  BackupServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the AWS Backup service role
    Value: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn

  BackupKmsKeyId:
    Description: ID of the customer-managed KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.KeyId

  BackupKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn

  TagOptionDailyId:
    Description: TagOption ID for backup=daily
    Value: !GetAtt TagOptionDaily.Id

  TagOptionWeeklyId:
    Description: TagOption ID for backup=weekly
    Value: !GetAtt TagOptionWeekly.Id

  TagOptionMonthlyId:
    Description: TagOption ID for backup=monthly
    Value: !GetAtt TagOptionMonthly.Id

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained public hosted zone and DNS record sets for podcastgarage.org
  (Squarespace website, Google Workspace mail/DKIM/DMARC, ZenDesk, and
  Campaign Monitor). Creates the hosted zone and all record sets within
  the same stack.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: podcastgarage.org.
    Description: Public domain for the hosted zone (include trailing dot).
  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: google-site-verification=REPLACE-WITH-GOOGLE-TOKEN
    Description: Google site verification token (public value).
  SquarespaceIP1:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.185.159.144
  SquarespaceIP2:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.185.159.145
  SquarespaceIP3:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.185.159.146
  SquarespaceIP4:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.49.23.144
  DmarcRuaMailbox:
    Type: String
    Default: dmarc-reports@podcastgarage.org
  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: zendeskverification-REPLACE-ME
    Description: ZenDesk verification token (public value).
  ZendeskVerificationTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: support.podcastgarage.org.
    Description: ZenDesk domain verification target hostname.
  GoogleWorkspaceDkimKey:
    Type: String
    Default: v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=REPLACE-WITH-GOOGLE-WORKSPACE-DKIM-PUBLIC-KEY
    Description: Google Workspace DKIM public key string.
  CampaignMonitorDkimKey:
    Type: String
    Default: v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=REPLACE-WITH-CAMPAIGN-MONITOR-DKIM-PUBLIC-KEY
    Description: Campaign Monitor DKIM public key string.
  PrinterIpAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 192.168.1.50
    Description: >-
      Private RFC1918 IP of the office printer. Note: this is a PUBLIC hosted
      zone, so publishing this private IP is intentional per requirements.

Resources:
  PublicHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Public hosted zone for podcastgarage.org created by CloudFormation

  ApexTxtSpfAndGoogleVerification:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: SPF policy and Google site verification at apex
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all"'
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'

  ApexARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: A
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: Squarespace website hosting IPs
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SquarespaceIP1
        - !Ref SquarespaceIP2
        - !Ref SquarespaceIP3
        - !Ref SquarespaceIP4

  WwwCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: Squarespace CNAME target for www
      ResourceRecords:
        - ext-cust.squarespace.com.

  ApexMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: G Suite mail delivery MX records
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '10 alt3.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '10 alt4.aspmx.l.google.com.'

  DmarcTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: DMARC policy for G Suite reporting
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:${DmarcRuaMailbox}"'

  PrinterARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'printer.${DomainName}'
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      Comment: >-
        Office printer private IP. This is a public hosted zone; publishing a
        private RFC1918 address here is intentional per requirements.
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PrinterIpAddress

  ZendeskVerificationCname:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${ZendeskVerificationToken}.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: ZenDesk verification token CNAME
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskVerificationTarget

  ZendeskMailCname:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zenmail.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: ZenDesk mail routing CNAME
      ResourceRecords:
        - mail.zendesk.com.

  ZendeskDkim1Cname:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk1._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: ZenDesk DKIM selector 1
      ResourceRecords:
        - zendesk1._domainkey.zendesk.com.

  ZendeskDkim2Cname:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk2._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: ZenDesk DKIM selector 2
      ResourceRecords:
        - zendesk2._domainkey.zendesk.com.

  GoogleWorkspaceDkimTxt:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'google._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: Google Workspace DKIM signing key
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleWorkspaceDkimKey}"'

  CampaignMonitorDkimTxt:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cm1._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: Campaign Monitor DKIM key
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${CampaignMonitorDkimKey}"'

  CampaignMonitorBounceCname:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cmmail.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: Campaign Monitor bounce/tracking CNAME
      ResourceRecords:
        - createsend.com.

  NewslettersSpfTxt:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'newsletters.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: SPF policy for Campaign Monitor subdomain
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.createsend.com ~all"'

  NewslettersMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PublicHostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'newsletters.${DomainName}'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      Comment: Campaign Monitor reply/mail handling MX
      ResourceRecords:
        - '10 mx.createsend.com.'

Outputs:
  HostedZoneId:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  IAM-only template for an e-commerce serverless architecture. Creates three
  execution roles with customer-managed policies: an SQS-consumer Lambda role,
  a DynamoDB stream-processor Lambda role, and an API Gateway role for SQS
  integration. The SQS queue (POC-Queue-{env}), DynamoDB table
  (ecommerce-orders-{env}), and SNS topic (POC-Topic-{env}) are created by
  companion stacks and are referenced here only by name-derived ARNs.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment suffix used in all IAM names and policy ARNs.

Resources:

  LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-lambda-basic-execution-${Environment}'
      Description: >-
        Basic Lambda execution policy granting CloudWatch Logs write actions
        only. Attached to both Lambda execution roles.
      Roles:
        - !Ref SqsConsumerRole
        - !Ref StreamProcessorRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'

  SqsConsumerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'ecommerce-sqs-consumer-role-${Environment}'
      Description: !Sub >-
        Execution role for the Lambda function that consumes messages from
        POC-Queue-${Environment} and writes orders to
        ecommerce-orders-${Environment}.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600

  SqsConsumerAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-sqs-consumer-access-${Environment}'
      Description: >-
        Least-privilege SQS consume and DynamoDB write permissions for the
        SQS-consumer Lambda function.
      Roles:
        - !Ref SqsConsumerRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}'

  StreamProcessorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'ecommerce-stream-processor-role-${Environment}'
      Description: !Sub >-
        Execution role for the Lambda function that reads the DynamoDB stream
        of ecommerce-orders-${Environment} and publishes notifications to
        POC-Topic-${Environment}.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600

  StreamProcessorAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-stream-processor-access-${Environment}'
      Description: >-
        DynamoDB Streams read and SNS publish permissions for the
        stream-processor Lambda function.
      Roles:
        - !Ref StreamProcessorRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:GetRecords
              - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
              - dynamodb:ListStreams
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}/stream/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Topic-${Environment}'

  ApiGatewaySqsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'ecommerce-apigw-sqs-role-${Environment}'
      Description: !Sub >-
        Execution role assumed by API Gateway's AWS-service proxy for direct
        SQS SendMessage integration with POC-Queue-${Environment}.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600

  ApiGatewaySqsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-apigw-sqs-access-${Environment}'
      Description: !Sub >-
        Grants API Gateway permission to send messages to
        POC-Queue-${Environment} via the AWS-service proxy integration.
      Roles:
        - !Ref ApiGatewaySqsRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:SendMessage
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}'

Outputs:
  SqsConsumerRoleArn:
    Description: >-
      ARN of the SQS-consumer Lambda execution role, for use in companion
      stacks (Lambda function role configuration).
    Value: !GetAtt SqsConsumerRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SqsConsumerRoleArn'

  StreamProcessorRoleArn:
    Description: >-
      ARN of the stream-processor Lambda execution role, for use in companion
      stacks (event source mapping and Lambda function role configuration).
    Value: !GetAtt StreamProcessorRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StreamProcessorRoleArn'

  ApiGatewaySqsRoleArn:
    Description: >-
      ARN of the API Gateway role for SQS integration, for use in companion
      stacks (integration credentials / iamRoleArn).
    Value: !GetAtt ApiGatewaySqsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApiGatewaySqsRoleArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Network-only template: VPC with one public subnet and one private subnet
  (neither assigns public IPs on launch). The public subnet is public by virtue
  of its 0.0.0.0/0 internet-gateway route and hosts the NAT gateway, which binds
  its Elastic IP directly (independent of subnet auto-assign). Private subnet
  resources reach the internet through the NAT gateway for outbound-connectivity
  testing in a greenfield account. Any instance later launched in the public
  subnet that requires a public IP must opt in explicitly at launch time (e.g.
  per-network-interface AssociatePublicIpAddress or a launch-template setting).

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet (must sit inside the VPC CIDR).
  PrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.32.0/21
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet (must sit inside the VPC CIDR and not overlap the public subnet).

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: '${AWS::StackName}-VPC'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: '${AWS::StackName}-IGW'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      InternetGatewayId:
        Ref: InternetGateway

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: '${AWS::StackName}-NAT-EIP'

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet'

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      CidrBlock:
        Ref: PrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetId:
        Ref: PublicSubnet
      AllocationId:
        Fn::GetAtt:
          - NatEIP
          - AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: '${AWS::StackName}-NATGateway'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: '${AWS::StackName}-PublicRouteTable'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId:
        Ref: InternetGateway

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId:
        Ref: VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value:
            Fn::Sub: '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable'

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId:
        Ref: NatGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId:
        Ref: PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PublicRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId:
        Ref: PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId:
        Ref: PrivateRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value:
      Ref: VPC
  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the public subnet (hosts the NAT gateway; no subnet-default public IP).
    Value:
      Ref: PublicSubnet
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the private subnet.
    Value:
      Ref: PrivateSubnet
  NatGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway.
    Value:
      Ref: NatGateway
  NatGatewayElasticIP:
    Description: Public Elastic IP address attached to the NAT gateway.
    Value:
      Fn::GetAtt:
        - NatEIP
        - PublicIp

Description: >
  Athena named queries for analyzing AppStream 2.0 usage data stored in the
  pre-existing "appstream-usage" database. Provides pre-built monthly
  reporting queries covering average session length per stack (current and
  previous month), daily session counts, session details, streaming hours
  per user, and unique users per application.

Resources:

  AvgSessionLengthPerStackCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: appstream-avg-session-length-per-stack-current-month
      Database: appstream-usage
      Description: Average session length per stack for the current month, for monthly AppStream 2.0 reporting.
      QueryString: !Sub >-
        SELECT stack_name,
               ROUND(AVG(session_duration_seconds) / 60.0, 2) AS avg_session_length_minutes
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = cast(month(current_date) AS varchar)
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY stack_name

  AvgSessionLengthPerStackPreviousMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: appstream-avg-session-length-per-stack-previous-month
      Database: appstream-usage
      Description: Average session length per stack for the previous month, using relative date arithmetic so no dates are hardcoded.
      QueryString: !Sub >-
        SELECT stack_name,
               ROUND(AVG(session_duration_seconds) / 60.0, 2) AS avg_session_length_minutes
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE date_trunc('month', session_date) = date_trunc('month', current_date) - interval '1' month
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY stack_name

  DailySessionCountsCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: appstream-daily-session-counts-current-month
      Database: appstream-usage
      Description: Daily session counts for the current month, useful for spotting usage trends day over day.
      QueryString: !Sub >-
        SELECT date_format(session_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS session_day,
               COUNT(*) AS session_count
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = cast(month(current_date) AS varchar)
        GROUP BY date_format(session_date, '%Y-%m-%d')
        ORDER BY session_day

  SessionDetailsCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: appstream-session-details-current-month
      Database: appstream-usage
      Description: All session detail records for the current month, for ad hoc analysis and drill-down reporting.
      QueryString: !Sub >-
        SELECT *
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = cast(month(current_date) AS varchar)
        ORDER BY session_date

  StreamingHoursPerUserCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: appstream-streaming-hours-per-user-current-month
      Database: appstream-usage
      Description: Total streaming hours per user for the current month, for capacity and billing analysis.
      QueryString: !Sub >-
        SELECT user_name,
               ROUND(SUM(session_duration_seconds) / 3600.0, 2) AS streaming_hours
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = cast(month(current_date) AS varchar)
        GROUP BY user_name
        ORDER BY streaming_hours DESC

  UniqueUsersPerApplicationCurrentMonth:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: appstream-unique-users-per-application-current-month
      Database: appstream-usage
      Description: Unique users per application for the current month, to understand application adoption.
      QueryString: !Sub >-
        SELECT application_name,
               COUNT(DISTINCT user_name) AS unique_users
        FROM appstream_usage
        WHERE year = cast(year(current_date) AS varchar)
          AND month = cast(month(current_date) AS varchar)
        GROUP BY application_name
        ORDER BY unique_users DESC

Outputs:

  AvgSessionLengthPerStackCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: Named query ID for average session length per stack (current month).
    Value: !Ref AvgSessionLengthPerStackCurrentMonth

  AvgSessionLengthPerStackPreviousMonthQueryId:
    Description: Named query ID for average session length per stack (previous month).
    Value: !Ref AvgSessionLengthPerStackPreviousMonth

  DailySessionCountsCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: Named query ID for daily session counts (current month).
    Value: !Ref DailySessionCountsCurrentMonth

  SessionDetailsCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: Named query ID for all session details (current month).
    Value: !Ref SessionDetailsCurrentMonth

  StreamingHoursPerUserCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: Named query ID for streaming hours per user (current month).
    Value: !Ref StreamingHoursPerUserCurrentMonth

  UniqueUsersPerApplicationCurrentMonthQueryId:
    Description: Named query ID for unique users per application (current month).
    Value: !Ref UniqueUsersPerApplicationCurrentMonth

Description: >-
  Self-contained three-tier VPC network foundation. Provisions a 10.0.0.0/16 VPC
  spanning three dynamically resolved Availability Zones, each with a public
  subnet, a private application subnet, and a private database subnet allocated
  from nine sequential /24 blocks (10.0.0.0/24 through 10.0.8.0/24). Public
  subnets route to an Internet Gateway; both private tiers egress through a
  single NAT Gateway backed by an Elastic IP, placed in the first Availability
  Zone. Fully self-contained: no Parameters, no external resource references.

Resources:
  # ===========================================================================
  # VPC
  # ===========================================================================
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: network

  # ===========================================================================
  # Internet Gateway and VPC attachment
  # ===========================================================================
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: network

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ===========================================================================
  # Single NAT Gateway (first AZ's public subnet)
  #
  # ACCEPTED TRADEOFF (per the stated requirement, not an omission): a single
  # NAT gateway means private-tier egress originating from the other two AZs
  # crosses AZ boundaries (incurring cross-AZ data transfer cost) and is
  # unavailable if the NAT gateway's AZ fails.
  # ===========================================================================
  NatElasticIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: network

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatElasticIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-az0"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: network

  # ===========================================================================
  # Public subnets (10.0.0.0/24, 10.0.1.0/24, 10.0.2.0/24)
  #
  # DESIGN NOTE: these subnets are "public" by virtue of their IGW-routed
  # route table, not by automatic public IP assignment. MapPublicIpOnLaunch
  # is deliberately false on ALL subnets (security best practice); downstream
  # stacks that launch instances needing public addresses must assign them
  # explicitly at launch time. The NAT gateway is unaffected — it derives its
  # address from the Elastic IP AllocationId, not this launch setting.
  # ===========================================================================
  PublicSubnetAz0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-az0"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-az1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnetAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-az2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # ===========================================================================
  # Private application subnets (10.0.3.0/24, 10.0.4.0/24, 10.0.5.0/24)
  # ===========================================================================
  PrivateAppSubnetAz0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.3.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-app-az0"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  PrivateAppSubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.4.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-app-az1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  PrivateAppSubnetAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.5.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-app-az2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  # ===========================================================================
  # Private database subnets (10.0.6.0/24, 10.0.7.0/24, 10.0.8.0/24)
  # ===========================================================================
  PrivateDbSubnetAz0:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.6.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-az0"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database

  PrivateDbSubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.7.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-az1"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database

  PrivateDbSubnetAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.8.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-az2"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database

  # ===========================================================================
  # Route tables (one per tier group)
  # ===========================================================================
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateAppRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-app-rt"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  PrivateDbRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-rt"
        - Key: Tier
          Value: database

  # ===========================================================================
  # Default routes
  # ===========================================================================
  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateAppDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateDbDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  # ===========================================================================
  # Subnet-to-route-table associations (public tier)
  # ===========================================================================
  PublicSubnetAz0RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz0
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetAz1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetAz2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ===========================================================================
  # Subnet-to-route-table associations (private application tier)
  # ===========================================================================
  PrivateAppSubnetAz0RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnetAz0
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnetAz1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnetAz1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  PrivateAppSubnetAz2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnetAz2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable

  # ===========================================================================
  # Subnet-to-route-table associations (private database tier)
  # ===========================================================================
  PrivateDbSubnetAz0RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnetAz0
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

  PrivateDbSubnetAz1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnetAz1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

  PrivateDbSubnetAz2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDbSubnetAz2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-id"

  PublicSubnetAz0Id:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in AZ index 0
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnetAz0
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-az0-id"

  PublicSubnetAz1Id:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in AZ index 1
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnetAz1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-az1-id"

  PublicSubnetAz2Id:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in AZ index 2
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnetAz2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-az2-id"

  PrivateAppSubnetAz0Id:
    Description: ID of the private application subnet in AZ index 0
    Value: !Ref PrivateAppSubnetAz0
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az0-id"

  PrivateAppSubnetAz1Id:
    Description: ID of the private application subnet in AZ index 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateAppSubnetAz1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az1-id"

  PrivateAppSubnetAz2Id:
    Description: ID of the private application subnet in AZ index 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateAppSubnetAz2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-az2-id"

  PrivateDbSubnetAz0Id:
    Description: ID of the private database subnet in AZ index 0
    Value: !Ref PrivateDbSubnetAz0
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az0-id"

  PrivateDbSubnetAz1Id:
    Description: ID of the private database subnet in AZ index 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateDbSubnetAz1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az1-id"

  PrivateDbSubnetAz2Id:
    Description: ID of the private database subnet in AZ index 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateDbSubnetAz2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-subnet-az2-id"

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the public route table
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt-id"

  PrivateAppRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the private application route table
    Value: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-id"

  PrivateDbRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the private database route table
    Value: !Ref PrivateDbRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-db-rt-id"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  QuickSight administrative monitoring and data pipeline environment: S3 data lake,
  self-hosted Glue ETL scripts, five Glue jobs with staggered daily triggers, and
  five CloudWatch metric streams via dedicated Kinesis Firehose delivery streams.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: "admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code"
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that stores the Glue ETL scripts.
  EnvironmentTag:
    Type: String
    Default: "production"
    Description: Environment tag applied to all resources.

Resources:

  ConsolidatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - monitoring.r53.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuiteConsolidatedPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3BucketAndObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/*"
              - Sid: KmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
                  - !GetAtt ScriptBucketKey.Arn
              - Sid: GlueAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:GetJobs
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                  - glue:GetTrigger
                  - glue:GetTriggers
                  - glue:StartTrigger
                  - glue:CreateJob
                  - glue:UpdateJob
                  - glue:DeleteJob
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: QuickSightMetadataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:ListUsers
                  - quicksight:DescribeUser
                  - quicksight:ListGroupMemberships
                  - quicksight:ListGroups
                  - quicksight:ListDashboards
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboard
                  - quicksight:ListAnalyses
                  - quicksight:DescribeAnalysis
                  - quicksight:ListDataSets
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:ListDataSources
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:ListFolders
                  - quicksight:DescribeFolder
                  - quicksight:ListFolderMembers
                  - quicksight:DescribeFolderPermissions
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboardPermissions
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSetPermissions
                  - quicksight:ListIngestions
                  - quicksight:DescribeIngestion
                  - quicksight:SearchDashboards
                  - quicksight:SearchAnalyses
                  - quicksight:SearchDataSets
                  - quicksight:SearchDataSources
                  - quicksight:ListTemplates
                  - quicksight:DescribeTemplate
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:quicksight:*:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
              - Sid: IamLimitedAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}"
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetricStreamAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetricStreams
                  - cloudwatch:StartMetricStreams
                  - cloudwatch:StopMetricStreams
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: LogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: FirehoseAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:ListDeliveryStreams
                  - firehose:ListTagsForDeliveryStream
                Resource: "*"

  AdminSuiteKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for the admin-suite QuickSight data lake bucket
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: RootFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ServiceGrants
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-firehose-role-${AWS::AccountId}"
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"

  ScriptBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for the Glue ETL script bucket
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: RootFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ServiceGrants
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-role-${AWS::AccountId}"
                - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-script-upload-${AWS::AccountId}"
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"

  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt AdminSuiteKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag

  AdminSuiteBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSOnlyAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"
          - Sid: EnforceKmsEncryption
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:PutObject"
            Resource: !Sub "${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms
              ArnNotLike:
                aws:PrincipalArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-firehose-role-${AWS::AccountId}"

  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref ScriptBucketName
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ScriptBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag

  ScriptUploadRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "admin-suite-script-upload-${AWS::AccountId}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ScriptUploadPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: ScriptBucket
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      Role: !GetAtt ScriptUploadRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, cfnresponse
          s3 = boto3.client("s3")

          SCRIPTS = {
              "glue/assets_access.py": '''import sys, boto3, json, datetime
          def main():
              qs = boto3.client("quicksight")
              acct = boto3.client("sts").get_caller_identity()["Account"]
              out = []
              for u in qs.list_users(AwsAccountId=acct, Namespace="default")["UserList"]:
                  out.append({"user": u["UserName"], "arn": u["Arn"], "role": u.get("Role"), "active": u.get("Active"), "captured": str(datetime.datetime.utcnow())})
              print(json.dumps(out))
          if __name__ == "__main__": main()''',
              "glue/dataset_metadata.py": '''import sys, boto3, json, datetime
          def main():
              qs = boto3.client("quicksight")
              acct = boto3.client("sts").get_caller_identity()["Account"]
              out = []
              for d in qs.list_data_sets(AwsAccountId=acct)["DataSetSummaries"]:
                  det = qs.describe_data_set(AwsAccountId=acct, DataSetId=d["DataSetId"])["DataSet"]
                  out.append({"id": d["DataSetId"], "name": d["Name"], "mode": det.get("Mode"), "spice": det.get("OutputColumns"), "captured": str(datetime.datetime.utcnow())})
              print(json.dumps(out))
          if __name__ == "__main__": main()''',
              "glue/folder_assets.py": '''import sys, boto3, json, datetime
          def main():
              qs = boto3.client("quicksight")
              acct = boto3.client("sts").get_caller_identity()["Account"]
              out = []
              for f in qs.list_folders(AwsAccountId=acct)["FolderSummaryList"]:
                  members = qs.list_folder_members(AwsAccountId=acct, FolderId=f["FolderId"]).get("FolderMemberList", [])
                  for m in members:
                      out.append({"folder": f["Name"], "member_id": m["MemberId"], "member_type": m["MemberType"], "captured": str(datetime.datetime.utcnow())})
              print(json.dumps(out))
          if __name__ == "__main__": main()''',
              "glue/q_metadata.py": '''import sys, boto3, json, datetime
          def main():
              qs = boto3.client("quicksight")
              acct = boto3.client("sts").get_caller_identity()["Account"]
              out = []
              for d in qs.list_dashboards(AwsAccountId=acct)["DashboardSummaryList"]:
                  out.append({"dashboard": d["Name"], "id": d["Arn"], "last_updated": str(d.get("LastUpdatedTime")), "captured": str(datetime.datetime.utcnow())})
              print(json.dumps(out))
          if __name__ == "__main__": main()''',
              "glue/datasource_properties.py": '''import sys, boto3, json, datetime
          def main():
              qs = boto3.client("quicksight")
              acct = boto3.client("sts").get_caller_identity()["Account"]
              out = []
              for ds in qs.list_data_sources(AwsAccountId=acct)["DataSources"]:
                  out.append({"id": ds["Arn"], "name": ds["Name"], "type": ds["Type"], "status": ds.get("Status"), "captured": str(datetime.datetime.utcnow())})
              print(json.dumps(out))
          if __name__ == "__main__": main()'''
          }

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] in ("Create", "Update"):
                      bucket = event["ResourceProperties"]["ScriptBucketName"]
                      for key, body in SCRIPTS.items():
