AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Secure Terraform state backend - S3 state bucket, DynamoDB lock table, KMS key, admin role,
  CloudTrail data-event logging with log archive bucket. Known deviation: Trivy AVD-AWS-0015
  is a confirmed false positive - the finding tracks the KMSKeyId property casing in Trivy's
  parser, not the key configuration. The deployed trail encrypts with the customer-managed,
  rotation-enabled key alias alias/terraform-state-backend-key (verify via
  aws cloudtrail describe-trails). KMSKeyId is the only schema-valid casing per
  AWS::CloudTrail::Trail.

Parameters:
  Name:
    Type: String
    Description: Base name prefix for resources.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9\-]{1,32}$'
  AdminPrincipalArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the admin principal allowed to assume the state management role. Defaults to current account root.
    Default: default
  ExecutionPrincipalArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the execution principal allowed to assume the state management role. Defaults to current account root.
    Default: default
  SSOPermissionSetArn:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional SSO permission set ARN to include in the role trust policy. Leave as 'default' to omit.
    Default: default
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional VPC ID to restrict state bucket access via aws:SourceVpc. Leave as 'default' to omit.
    Default: default
    AllowedPattern: '^(default|vpc-[0-9a-f]{8,17})$'
  RepositoryTagValue:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional value that the Repository tag must match for assume-role. Defaults to the Name parameter value.
    Default: default
  ObjectLockMode:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues: ['COMPLIANCE', 'GOVERNANCE']
    Default: 'GOVERNANCE'

Conditions:
  CustomAdmin: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AdminPrincipalArn, 'default']]
  CustomExecution: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExecutionPrincipalArn, 'default']]
  HasSSO: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOPermissionSetArn, 'default']]
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, 'default']]
  HasRepoTag: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RepositoryTagValue, 'default']]

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for Terraform state backend ${Name}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowTerraformRoleUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${Name}-${AWS::AccountId}-terraform-state-role'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3UseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - Sid: AllowLogsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/terraform-state-backend-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  TerraformStateRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Name}-${AWS::AccountId}-terraform-state-role'
      MaxSessionDuration: 7200
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowPrincipals
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !If
                  - CustomAdmin
                  - !Ref AdminPrincipalArn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
                - !If
                  - CustomExecution
                  - !Ref ExecutionPrincipalArn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
                - !If
                  - HasSSO
                  - !Ref SSOPermissionSetArn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEqualsIfExists:
                aws:RequestTag/Repository: !If
                  - HasRepoTag
                  - !Ref RepositoryTagValue
                  - 'terraform-state-backend-unset-repository-tag'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TerraformStateManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StateBucketList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetBucketObjectLockConfiguration
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-state
              - Sid: StateBucketObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                Resource: arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-state/*
              - Sid: LockTableAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource: !GetAtt TerraformLockTable.Arn
              - Sid: KmsUse
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  TerraformStateBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: terraform-state-backend-tf-state
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: PurgeNoncurrentStateVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 90
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: terraform-state-backend-tf-logs
        LogFilePrefix: state-bucket-access-logs/

  TerraformStateBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TerraformStateBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-state
              - arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-state/*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: RestrictToVpc
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-state
              - arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-state/*
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                aws:SourceVpc: !If
                  - HasVpc
                  - !Ref VpcId
                  - 'vpc-0000000000000000do-not-match'
          - Sid: AllowAdminAndExecution
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !If
                  - CustomAdmin
                  - !Ref AdminPrincipalArn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
                - !If
                  - CustomExecution
                  - !Ref ExecutionPrincipalArn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketVersioning
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource:
              - arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-state
              - arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-state/*

  TerraformLockTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${Name}-${AWS::AccountId}-terraform-locks'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: LockID
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: LockID
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  LogArchiveBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: terraform-state-backend-tf-logs
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      ObjectLockEnabled: true
      ObjectLockConfiguration:
        ObjectLockEnabled: Enabled
        Rule:
          DefaultRetention:
            Mode: !Ref ObjectLockMode
            Days: 30
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ArchiveLogsToGlacier
            Status: Enabled
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: GLACIER
                TransitionInDays: 30
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  LogArchiveBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LogArchiveBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-logs
              - arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-logs/*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:GetBucketAcl
              - s3:PutObject
            Resource:
              - arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-logs
              - arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-logs/AWSLogs/*
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
          - Sid: AllowS3ServerAccessLogsWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-logs/state-bucket-access-logs/*

  CloudTrailTrail:
    Type: AWS::CloudTrail::Trail
    DependsOn: LogArchiveBucketPolicy
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TrailName: terraform-state-backend-trail
      IsLogging: true
      IsMultiRegionTrail: false
      IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true
      S3BucketName: terraform-state-backend-tf-logs
      S3KeyPrefix: cloudtrail
      KMSKeyId: alias/terraform-state-backend-key
      EnableLogFileValidation: true
      EventSelectors:
        - IncludeManagementEvents: true
          ReadWriteType: All
          DataResources:
            - Type: AWS::S3::Object
              Values:
                - arn:aws:s3:::terraform-state-backend-tf-state/

Outputs:
  StateBucketName:
    Description: Terraform state S3 bucket name
    Value: !Ref TerraformStateBucket
  StateBucketArn:
    Description: Terraform state S3 bucket ARN
    Value: !GetAtt TerraformStateBucket.Arn
  LockTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB lock table name
    Value: !Ref TerraformLockTable
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key ARN used for encryption
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
  StateRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN for managing Terraform state
    Value: !GetAtt TerraformStateRole.Arn
  CloudTrailArn:
    Description: CloudTrail trail ARN
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/terraform-state-backend-trail'
  LogArchiveBucketName:
    Description: Log archive S3 bucket name
    Value: !Ref LogArchiveBucket

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Self-contained EKS environment for EMR on EKS Spark workloads with EMR Celeborn security groups and managed node groups.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: emr-celeborn-demo
    Description: Project name used for resource naming and export prefixes.
  GeneralInstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: m5.xlarge
    Description: Instance type for the general (system pods) node group.
  SparkInstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: r5.2xlarge
    Description: Instance type for the Spark (executor pods) node group.
  GeneralMinSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
  GeneralDesiredSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
  GeneralMaxSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
  SparkMinSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
  SparkDesiredSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
  SparkMaxSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  KubernetesVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: "1.33"
    AllowedValues:
      - "1.32"
      - "1.33"
    Description: EKS Kubernetes version (currently supported minor versions only).

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-public-rt"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAZ1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-natgw"

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-private-rt"

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PublicSubnetAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-public-az1"

  PublicSubnetAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-public-az2"

  PrivateSubnetAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-private-az1"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  PrivateSubnetAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-private-az2"
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  PrivateSubnetAZ1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetAZ2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  EMRClusterSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for EMR cluster nodes.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-cluster-sg"

  EMRCelebornAccessSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group controlling EMR Celeborn access.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 0
          ToPort: 65535
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt EMRClusterSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Description: Allow Celeborn access from EMR cluster nodes.
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-celeborn-sg"

  ClusterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy"

  NodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore"

  EBSCSIDriverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ebs-csi-driver
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateVolume
                  - ec2:DeleteVolume
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:ModifyVolume
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumeAttribute
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumeStatus
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumeModifications
                Resource: "*"

  EKSSecretsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "KMS key for EKS secret encryption - ${ProjectName}"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowEksClusterUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ClusterRole.Arn
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"

  Cluster:
    Type: AWS::EKS::Cluster
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-eks"
      Version: !Ref KubernetesVersion
      RoleArn: !GetAtt ClusterRole.Arn
      EncryptionConfig:
        - Resources:
            - secrets
          Provider:
            KeyArn: !GetAtt EKSSecretsKmsKey.Arn
      ResourcesVpcConfig:
        SubnetIds:
          - !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ1
          - !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ2
        EndpointPrivateAccess: true
        EndpointPublicAccess: false

  NodeGroupLaunchTemplate:
    Type: AWS::EC2::LaunchTemplate
    Properties:
      LaunchTemplateData:
        BlockDeviceMappings:
          - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
            Ebs:
              VolumeSize: 50
              VolumeType: gp3
              Encrypted: true
        MetadataOptions:
          HttpTokens: required
          HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
        TagSpecifications:
          - ResourceType: instance
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-node"
          - ResourceType: network-interface
            Tags:
              - Key: Name
                Value: !Sub "${ProjectName}-node-eni"

  GeneralNodeGroup:
    Type: AWS::EKS::Nodegroup
    Properties:
      NodegroupName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-general"
      ClusterName: !Ref Cluster
      NodeRole: !GetAtt NodeRole.Arn
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ2
      CapacityType: ON_DEMAND
      AmiType: AL2023_x86_64_STANDARD
      ScalingConfig:
        MinSize: !Ref GeneralMinSize
        DesiredSize: !Ref GeneralDesiredSize
        MaxSize: !Ref GeneralMaxSize
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref GeneralInstanceType
      LaunchTemplate:
        Id: !GetAtt NodeGroupLaunchTemplate.LaunchTemplateId
        Version: !GetAtt NodeGroupLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber

  SparkNodeGroup:
    Type: AWS::EKS::Nodegroup
    DependsOn: GeneralNodeGroup
    Properties:
      NodegroupName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-spark"
      ClusterName: !Ref Cluster
      NodeRole: !GetAtt NodeRole.Arn
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ2
      CapacityType: ON_DEMAND
      AmiType: AL2023_x86_64_STANDARD
      ScalingConfig:
        MinSize: !Ref SparkMinSize
        DesiredSize: !Ref SparkDesiredSize
        MaxSize: !Ref SparkMaxSize
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref SparkInstanceType
      LaunchTemplate:
        Id: !GetAtt NodeGroupLaunchTemplate.LaunchTemplateId
        Version: !GetAtt NodeGroupLaunchTemplate.LatestVersionNumber

Outputs:
  ClusterName:
    Description: EKS cluster name.
    Value: !Ref Cluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-cluster-name"

  GeneralNodeGroupName:
    Description: General (system pods) node group name.
    Value: !Ref GeneralNodeGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-general-node-group-name"

  SparkNodeGroupName:
    Description: Spark (executor pods) node group name.
    Value: !Ref SparkNodeGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-spark-node-group-name"

  EBSCSIDriverRoleName:
    Description: EBS CSI driver IAM role name for future IRSA use.
    Value: !Select [1, !Split ["/", !GetAtt EBSCSIDriverRole.Arn]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-ebs-csi-driver-role-name"

  EMRClusterSecurityGroupId:
    Description: EMR cluster security group ID.
    Value: !GetAtt EMRClusterSecurityGroup.GroupId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-cluster-sg-id"

  EMRCelebornAccessSecurityGroupId:
    Description: EMR Celeborn access security group ID.
    Value: !GetAtt EMRCelebornAccessSecurityGroup.GroupId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectName}-emr-celeborn-sg-id"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates the VPC infrastructure for a Puppet Quick Start deployment: a VPC with
  DNS support and DNS hostnames enabled, a public subnet in the second Availability
  Zone, an internet gateway with a default route, and a private Route 53 hosted
  zone for example.com containing A records for the Puppet server and the Linux
  and Windows agent instances.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the Puppet VPC.
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16).

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet (must fall within the VPC CIDR).
    Default: 10.0.0.0/19
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block (e.g., 10.0.0.0/19).

  PuppetServerIp:
    Type: String
    Description: Private IP address for the puppet.example.com A record.
    Default: 10.0.0.10
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address (e.g., 10.0.0.10).

  LinuxAgentIp:
    Type: String
    Description: Private IP address for the linuxagent.example.com A record.
    Default: 10.0.0.11
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address (e.g., 10.0.0.11).

  WindowsAgentIp:
    Type: String
    Description: Private IP address for the windowsagent.example.com A record.
    Default: 10.0.0.12
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address (e.g., 10.0.0.12).

Resources:
  PuppetVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetVPC

  PuppetPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PuppetVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetPublicSubnet

  PuppetInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetInternetGateway

  PuppetVPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PuppetVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref PuppetInternetGateway

  PuppetPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref PuppetVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetPublicRouteTable

  PuppetPublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: PuppetVPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PuppetPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref PuppetInternetGateway

  PuppetPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PuppetPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PuppetPublicRouteTable

  PuppetHostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: example.com
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Private hosted zone for the Puppet Quick Start deployment
      VPCs:
        - VPCId: !Ref PuppetVPC
          VPCRegion: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  PuppetServerRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PuppetHostedZone
      Name: puppet.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PuppetServerIp

  LinuxAgentRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PuppetHostedZone
      Name: linuxagent.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref LinuxAgentIp

  WindowsAgentRecordSet:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref PuppetHostedZone
      Name: windowsagent.example.com
      Type: A
      TTL: 300
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref WindowsAgentIp

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: The ID of the Puppet VPC.
    Value: !Ref PuppetVPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  PublicSubnetId:
    Description: The ID of the Puppet public subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    Value: !Ref PuppetPublicSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained AWS FIS chaos engineering experiment template (bisection
  variant 4: baseline without experiment-template Tags map). Logs encrypted
  with a new KMS key.

Parameters:
  ExperimentDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: PT20M
    Description: ISO 8601 duration for each disruption action (default 20 minutes).
    AllowedPattern: '^PT(\d+[HMS])+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT20M.
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Region scoped for the experiment targets.
    AllowedValues:
      - us-east-1
      - us-east-2
      - us-west-1
      - us-west-2
      - eu-west-1
      - eu-central-1
      - ap-southeast-1
      - ap-northeast-1

Resources:
  FisLogKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      Description: KMS key for FIS experiment CloudWatch logs
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowFisUseForKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUseForKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: fis-chaos-log-key
        - Key: ChaosAllowed
          Value: 'true'

  FisExperimentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FisLogKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 7
      LogGroupName: /aws/fis/chaos-experiments
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: fis-chaos-experiment-logs
        - Key: ChaosAllowed
          Value: 'true'

  FisExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2FullAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3FullAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchLogsFullAccess'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: fis-chaos-experiment-role
        - Key: ChaosAllowed
          Value: 'true'

  # Always-inactive alarm: a custom metric that never publishes data with a
  # threshold that cannot be breached, so the FIS stop condition never fires,
  # preserving the "no effective stop conditions" behavior.
  FisStopConditionAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: Placeholder stop-condition alarm for FIS experiment (never breaches)
      Namespace: FIS/ChaosExperiment
      MetricName: StopConditionNeverBreaches
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1000000
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: fis-stop-condition-alarm
        - Key: ChaosAllowed
          Value: 'true'

  # NOTE (flagged): Network disruption actions (AZ blackhole, transit gateway,
  # subnet blackhole) could not be confirmed against the official AWS FIS
  # Actions reference and are intentionally omitted per Grounded Objective 11.
  # BISECTION NOTE: Variant 4 removes the Tags map from FisExperimentTemplate
  # per remediator bisection objectives (Tags vs StopConditions isolation).
  # All other baseline elements unchanged. If this deploys, the Tags map (e.g.
  # the reserved Name key or map shape) was the defect; re-add compliant tags.
  # ExperimentDuration and TargetRegion remain referenced in the Description.
  FisExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Cross-region chaos experiment targeting resources tagged ChaosAllowed=true in ${TargetRegion} with planned action duration ${ExperimentDuration}'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: aws:cloudwatch:alarm
          Value: !GetAtt FisStopConditionAlarm.Arn
      Targets:
        Ec2Instances:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:instance
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
          SelectionMode: ALL

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Value: !Ref FisExperimentTemplate
  LogGroupArn:
    Value: !GetAtt FisExperimentLogGroup.Arn
  KmsKeyArn:
    Value: !GetAtt FisLogKey.Arn
  FisRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
  StopConditionAlarmArn:
    Value: !GetAtt FisStopConditionAlarm.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with private Cloud Map service discovery, VPC, NAT, and CPU-based auto scaling.
Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment name (used for naming resources).
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-service
    Description: Name of the ECS service and Cloud Map service.
  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    Description: Container image for the microservice.
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: Port exposed by the container.
  CpuUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    Description: CPU units for the Fargate task.
  MemoryUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: Memory (MiB) for the Fargate task.
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Desired number of tasks.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  CustomTaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional IAM role ARN the task role may assume. Leave empty for none.
Conditions:
  HasCustomRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTaskRoleArn, '']]
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-1'
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-1'
  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-2'
  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat'
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  ServiceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow intra-VPC traffic on the container port
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-svc-sg'
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30
  EcsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ecs-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ReadLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  EcsTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ecs-task-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies: !If
        - HasCustomRole
        - - PolicyName: AssumeCustomRole
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action: sts:AssumeRole
                  Resource: !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  EcsAutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ecs-autoscaling-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcsServiceScaling
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                  - ecs:UpdateService
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      Cpu: !Ref CpuUnits
      Memory: !Ref MemoryUnits
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
  PrivateDnsNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::StackName}.svc'
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
  CloudMapService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DependsOn: PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 10
          - Type: A
            TTL: 10
        NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
        RoutingPolicy: WEIGHTED
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: CloudMapService
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
        MaximumPercent: 200
  ScaleInAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: ScaleInPolicy
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-in'
      AlarmDescription: Scale in when average CPU drops to or below 20 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy
  ScaleOutAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: ScaleOutPolicy
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-out'
      AlarmDescription: Scale out when average CPU reaches or exceeds 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: EcsService
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 2
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${EcsCluster}/${ServiceName}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt EcsAutoScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-out'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 30
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 30
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 60
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 60
            ScalingAdjustment: 3
  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-in'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1
Outputs:
  ClusterName:
    Description: ECS cluster name
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster
  EcsServiceName:
    Description: ECS service name
    Value: !Ref EcsService
  CloudMapServiceDnsName:
    Description: DNS name for service discovery
    Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::StackName}.svc'
  CloudMapServiceArn:
    Description: Cloud Map service ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained hybrid interconnect demo network backbone (VPC, TGW, conditional
  OCI VGW-attached VPN with static routes, encrypted flow logs). Inter-VPC OCI
  traffic traverses the VGW-attached VPN's static route, since the TGW VPN
  attachment ID is not addressable from CloudFormation.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet.
  InternalHttpsIngressCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR allowed to reach TCP 443 inbound.
  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.95.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: OCI backbone CIDR for HTTPS egress and VPN static route.
  EnableVpnConnection:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the OCI VPN connection.
  CustomerGatewayIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 203.0.113.10
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$
    Description: Public IP of the OCI customer gateway.
  CustomerGatewayBgpAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 65000
    Description: BGP ASN of the OCI customer gateway.

Conditions:
  CreateVpn: !Equals [!Ref EnableVpnConnection, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-az1'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} demo transit gateway'
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw'

  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-attachment'

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: HTTPS only - inbound from internal CIDR, outbound to OCI backbone
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalHttpsIngressCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg'

  VpnGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNGateway
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vgw'

  VpnGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpnGatewayId: !Ref VpnGateway

  CustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      BgpAsn: !Ref CustomerGatewayBgpAsn
      IpAddress: !Ref CustomerGatewayIp
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cgw'

  VPNConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateVpn
    DependsOn: VpnGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      VpnGatewayId: !Ref VpnGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpn'

  VPNConnectionRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnectionRoute
    Condition: CreateVpn
    DependsOn: VPNConnection
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref VPNConnection

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC flow log encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 30

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-to-cloudwatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlog'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: Private subnet ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit gateway ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup
  VpnConnectionId:
    Description: VPN connection ID
    Value: !If [CreateVpn, !Ref VPNConnection, 'VPN disabled']
  CustomerGatewayId:
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Description: Customer gateway ID
    Value: !Ref CustomerGateway
  FlowLogGroupId:
    Description: Flow log CloudWatch log group
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline (S3, KMS CMK, IAM, Glue jobs, triggers, catalog)

Resources:
  DataBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for QuickSight admin data pipeline S3 bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  DataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'quicksight-admin-dp-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  DataBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref DataBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: PipelineRoleAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt GlueJobRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt DataBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${DataBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedUploads
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${DataBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms

  GlueJobRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'quicksight-admin-dp-role-${AWS::AccountId}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PipelinePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AssumeGlueAndCfnRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/glue-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cfn-*'
              - Sid: PassRoleToGlueAndCfnRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/glue-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cfn-*'
              - Sid: FullServiceAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: '*'
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:RequestedService:
                      - iam
                      - quicksight
                      - glue
                      - s3
                      - cloudwatch
                      - logs
              - Sid: BucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt DataBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${DataBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: BucketKmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt DataBucketKey.Arn

  GlueCatalogDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub 'quicksight_admin_dp_${AWS::AccountId}'

  CloudTrailLogTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueCatalogDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: cloudtrail_logs
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          EXTERNAL: 'true'
          classification: json
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${DataBucket}/cloudtrail-logs/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.openx.data.jsonserde.JsonSerDe
            Parameters:
              paths: eventName,eventSource,eventTime,awsRegion,sourceIPAddress,userIdentity
          Columns:
            - Name: eventName
              Type: string
            - Name: eventSource
              Type: string
            - Name: eventTime
              Type: string
            - Name: awsRegion
              Type: string
            - Name: sourceIPAddress
              Type: string
            - Name: userIdentity
              Type: string

  ScriptUploaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3Upload
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${DataBucket.Arn}/scripts/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt DataBucketKey.Arn

  ScriptUploader:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt ScriptUploaderRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import cfnresponse
          import boto3
          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      s3 = boto3.client('s3')
                      bucket = event['ResourceProperties']['Bucket']
                      kms_key_arn = event['ResourceProperties']['KmsKeyArn']
                      scripts = event['ResourceProperties']['Scripts']
                      for name, body in scripts.items():
                          s3.put_object(
                              Bucket=bucket,
                              Key=f'scripts/{name}',
                              Body=body.encode(),
                              ServerSideEncryption='aws:kms',
                              SSEKMSKeyId=kms_key_arn
                          )
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  print(e)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'error': str(e)})

  ScriptUpload:
    Type: Custom::ScriptUpload
    DependsOn: DataBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ScriptUploader.Arn
      Bucket: !Ref DataBucket
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt DataBucketKey.Arn
      Scripts:
        group_membership.py: |
          import boto3
          print("Group membership extraction job")
        object_access.py: |
          import boto3
          print("Object access extraction job")
