final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Event-driven photo analysis system - S3 -> Lambda -> Step Functions -> Rekognition -> SNS SMS

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
  PhoneNumber:
    Type: String
    Default: "+14070000000"
    AllowedPattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
    Description: SMS phone number for human detection notifications

Resources:
  # ---------------- KMS Key ----------------
  PhotoAnalysisKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for photo analysis S3 bucket and SNS topic encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSNS
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: photo-analysis

  # ---------------- S3 Bucket ----------------
  PhotoBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'photo-analysis-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - BucketKeyEnabled: true
            ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref PhotoAnalysisKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: photo-analysis

  PhotoBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PhotoBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PhotoBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${PhotoBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  # ---------------- Orchestrator Lambda ----------------
  OrchestratorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${OrchestratorLambda}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: photo-analysis

  OrchestratorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: photo-analysis-orchestrator-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: orchestrator-inline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'states:StartExecution'
                Resource: !GetAtt PhotoAnalysisStateMachine.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: photo-analysis

  OrchestratorLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: photo-analysis-orchestrator
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt OrchestratorRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Ref PhotoAnalysisStateMachine
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: photo-analysis
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3
          from urllib.parse import unquote_plus

          sfn = boto3.client('stepfunctions')

          def handler(event, context):
              sm_arn = os.environ['STATE_MACHINE_ARN']
              for record in event.get('Records', []):
                  bucket = record['s3']['bucket']['name']
                  key = unquote_plus(record['s3']['object']['key'])
                  sfn.start_execution(
                      stateMachineArn=sm_arn,
                      name='photo-analysis-' + key.replace('/', '-').replace(' ', '-')[:80],
                      input=json.dumps({'bucket': bucket, 'key': key})
                  )
              return {'statusCode': 200}

  # Custom resource helper for S3 notification (breaks circular dependency)
  S3NotificationHelperLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${S3NotificationHelper}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  S3NotificationHelperRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: photo-analysis-s3-notif-helper-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: s3-notif-helper-inline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 's3:PutBucketNotification'
                Resource: !GetAtt PhotoBucket.Arn

  S3NotificationHelper:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: photo-analysis-s3-notif-helper
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt S3NotificationHelperRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: photo-analysis
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  bucket = event['ResourceProperties']['Bucket']
                  function_arn = event['ResourceProperties']['OrchestratorLambdaArn']
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      s3.put_bucket_notification_configuration(
                          Bucket=bucket,
                          NotificationConfiguration={
                              'LambdaFunctionConfigurations': [
                                  {
                                      'LambdaFunctionArn': function_arn,
                                      'Events': ['s3:ObjectCreated:*']
                                  }
                              ]
                          }
                      )
                  elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      try:
                          s3.put_bucket_notification_configuration(
                              Bucket=bucket,
                              NotificationConfiguration={}
                          )
                      except Exception as e:
                          print(e)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, 's3notif')
              except Exception as e:
                  print(e)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, 's3notif')

  S3NotificationCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn: S3Permission
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt S3NotificationHelper.Arn
      Bucket: !Ref PhotoBucket
      OrchestratorLambdaArn: !GetAtt OrchestratorLambda.Arn

  S3Permission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref OrchestratorLambda
      Action: 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
      Principal: s3.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt PhotoBucket.Arn
      SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  # ---------------- Rekognition Lambda ----------------
  RekognitionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${RekognitionLambda}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: photo-analysis

  RekognitionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: photo-analysis-rekognition-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: rekognition-inline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'rekognition:DetectLabels'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'kms:Decrypt'
                Resource: !GetAtt PhotoAnalysisKmsKey.Arn

  RekognitionLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: photo-analysis-rekognition
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt RekognitionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: photo-analysis
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3

          rekognition = boto3.client('rekognition')
          CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD = 85.0

          def handler(event, context):
              bucket = event['bucket']
              key = event['key']
              response = rekognition.detect_labels(
                  Image={'S3Object': {'Bucket': bucket, 'Name': key}},
                  MaxLabels=50,
                  MinConfidence=CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD
              )
              human_detected = False
              for label in response.get('Labels', []):
                  if label['Name'].lower() in ('person', 'human') and label['Confidence'] >= CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD:
                      human_detected = True
                      break
              return {
                  'humanDetected': human_detected,
                  'bucket': bucket,
                  'key': key
              }

  # ---------------- Notifier Lambda ----------------
  NotifierLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${NotifierLambda}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: photo-analysis

  NotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: photo-analysis-notifications
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref PhotoAnalysisKmsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: photo-analysis

  SmsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: sms
      Endpoint: !Ref PhoneNumber
      TopicArn: !Ref NotificationTopic

  NotifierRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: photo-analysis-notifier-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: notifier-inline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'sns:Publish'
                Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt PhotoAnalysisKmsKey.Arn

  NotifierLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: photo-analysis-notifier
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt NotifierRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TOPIC_ARN: !Ref NotificationTopic
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: photo-analysis
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          sns = boto3.client('sns')

          def handler(event, context):
              bucket = event['bucket']
              key = event['key']
              message = f"Human detected in image! Bucket: {bucket}, Key: {key}"
              sns.publish(
                  TopicArn=os.environ['TOPIC_ARN'],
                  Message=message,
                  Subject='Photo Analysis Alert'
              )
              return {'notified': True}

  # ---------------- Step Functions ----------------
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: photo-analysis-statemachine-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: statemachine-inline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RekognitionLambda.Arn
                  - !GetAtt NotifierLambda.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogDelivery'
                  - 'logs:GetLogDelivery'
                  - 'logs:UpdateLogDelivery'
                  - 'logs:DeleteLogDelivery'
                  - 'logs:ListLogDeliveries'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogGroups'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: '*'

  PhotoAnalysisStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: photo-analysis-workflow
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        RekognitionLambdaArn: !GetAtt RekognitionLambda.Arn
        NotifierLambdaArn: !GetAtt NotifierLambda.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Analyze image for human detection and notify via SMS if found
        StartAt: DetectHuman
        States:
          DetectHuman:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${RekognitionLambdaArn}
              Payload.$: '$'
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.TaskFailed
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 2
                BackoffRate: 2
            Next: HumanDetectedChoice
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                Next: AnalysisFailed
                ResultPath: $.error
          HumanDetectedChoice:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: '$.humanDetected'
                BooleanEquals: true
                Next: SendNotification
            Default: NoHumanDetected
          SendNotification:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${NotifierLambdaArn}
              Payload.$: '$'
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.TaskFailed
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 2
                BackoffRate: 2
            Next: Success
          NoHumanDetected:
            Type: Pass
            End: true
          AnalysisFailed:
            Type: Pass
            End: true
          Success:
            Type: Succeed

Outputs:

    Description: S3 bucket name for image uploads
    Value: !Ref PhotoBucket
  BucketArn:
    Description: S3 bucket ARN
    Value: !GetAtt PhotoBucket.Arn

  SNSTopicArn:
    Description: SNS topic ARN for notifications
    Value: !Ref NotificationTopic

    Description: KMS key ARN used for encryption
    Value: !GetAtt PhotoAnalysisKmsKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: EC2 Image Builder pipeline with Chef recipe component, lifecycle policy, custom build workflow, and supporting IAM/S3/ECR/KMS resources.

Parameters:
  PipelineName:
    Type: String
    Default: al2-ecs-ami-pipeline
    Description: Name of the Image Builder pipeline.
  ComponentName:
    Type: String
    Default: chef-recipe-component
    Description: Name of the custom Chef recipe component.
  RecipeName:
    Type: String
    Default: al2-ecs-chef-recipe
    Description: Name of the image recipe.
  BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: imagebuilder-chef-recipes
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket hosting Chef recipe artifacts.
  EcrRepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: imagebuilder-scan-results
    Description: ECR repository used for image scan findings.
  LifecycleDeprecateAfterDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Deprecate AMIs older than this many days.
  LifecycleTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: al2-ecs-ami-pipeline
  DailyCronExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 6 * * ? *)
    Description: Daily pipeline schedule in cron format (UTC).

Resources:
  RecipeBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for the Image Builder Chef recipe S3 bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ViaService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  PipelineTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for the Image Builder pipeline SNS topic.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilder
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'

  RecipeBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${BucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt RecipeBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  RecipeBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref RecipeBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RecipeBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RecipeBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'imagebuilder-instance-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RecipeBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RecipeBucket}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                Resource: !GetAtt RecipeBucketKey.Arn

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub 'imagebuilder-instance-profile-${AWS::Region}'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'imagebuilder-service-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderPipelinePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:CreateSnapshot'
                  - 'ec2:CreateTags'
                  - 'ec2:DeleteSnapshot'
                  - 'ec2:DeregisterImage'
                  - 'ec2:Describe*'
                  - 'ec2:GetConsoleOutput'
                  - 'ec2:ModifyImageAttribute'
                  - 'ec2:RegisterImage'
                  - 'ec2:RunInstances'
                  - 'ec2:TerminateInstances'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ecr:GetAuthorizationToken'
                  - 'ecr:BatchGetImage'
                  - 'ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability'
                  - 'ecr:CompleteLayerUpload'
                  - 'ecr:InitiateLayerUpload'
                  - 'ecr:PutImage'
                  - 'ecr:UploadLayerPart'
                  - 'ecr:DescribeRepositories'
                  - 'ecr:CreateRepository'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/imagebuilder/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                Resource: !GetAtt PipelineTopicKey.Arn

  ScanRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Ref EcrRepositoryName
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true

  ChefRecipeComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentName
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Updates the SSM agent and executes a Chef recipe from the recipe S3 bucket.
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ${ComponentName}
        description: Update SSM agent, then download and execute Chef recipe from S3
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSsmAgent
                action: aws:executeBashScript
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent || dnf update -y amazon-ssm-agent
                      systemctl restart amazon-ssm-agent
              - name: DownloadChefRecipe
                action: aws:downloadUrlSource
                inputs:
                  - source: arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RecipeBucket}/chef-recipe.zip
              - name: ExecuteChefRecipe
                action: aws:executeBashScript
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      if ! command -v chef-client >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                        curl -L https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh | bash -s -- -P chef
                      fi
                      chef-client --local-mode --chef-license accept --recipe-path /tmp
      Tags:
        Pipeline: !Ref LifecycleTagValue

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref RecipeName
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized base image with Chef recipe component.
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id}}'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt ChefRecipeComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        Pipeline: !Ref LifecycleTagValue

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-infra'
      Description: Infrastructure configuration terminating instances on failure.
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref RecipeBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: imagebuilder-logs/
      SnsTopicArn: !Ref PipelineTopic

  PipelineTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref PipelineTopicKey

  PipelineTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref PipelineTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref PipelineTopic

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-distribution'
      Description: Distribute AMI to the current account in the current region.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: Custom Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI built by Image Builder.
            AmiTags:
              Pipeline: !Ref LifecycleTagValue

  # COMMENT OBJECTIVE: The CloudFormation spec does not expose a verifiable way
  # to pass the runtime build instance ID into the workflow via WorkflowParameters
  # (no WorkflowParameter property carries the instance context). The instanceId
  # parameter is declared in the workflow document and resolved from the workflow
  # execution context ($.instanceId); if execution fails to resolve it, the
  # parameter declaration should be removed in favor of a supported context variable.
  CustomBuildWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: update-ssm-agent-and-metadata
      Version: 1.0.0
      Type: BUILD
      Description: Build workflow that collects instance metadata before AMI creation.
      Data: |
        name: update-ssm-agent-and-metadata
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        description: Collects instance metadata before AMI creation.
        parameters:
          - name: instanceId
            type: string
        steps:
          - name: CollectMetadata
            action: CollectImageMetadata
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: '$.instanceId'

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref PipelineName
      Description: Daily pipeline building custom Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMIs.
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref DailyCronExpression
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
        EcrConfiguration:
          RepositoryName: !Ref ScanRepository
          ContainerTags:
            - !Sub '${PipelineName}-latest'
      Workflows:
        - WorkflowArn: !GetAtt CustomBuildWorkflow.Arn

  AmiLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-ami-lifecycle'
      Description: Deprecates AMIs produced by the pipeline after the configured age.
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderServiceRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Pipeline: !Ref LifecycleTagValue
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
            IncludeResources:
              Amis: true
              Snapshots: false
              Containers: false
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: !Ref LifecycleDeprecateAfterDays
          ExclusionRules:
            TagMap:
              LifecycleExempt: 'true'

Outputs:
  PipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder pipeline.
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePipeline.Arn
  RecipeBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket hosting Chef recipe artifacts.
    Value: !Ref RecipeBucket
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the AMI lifecycle policy.
    Value: !GetAtt AmiLifecyclePolicy.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Contract-test harness for the AWSSamples::LambdaFunctionInvoker::Hook.
  Creates five independent Lambda functions (LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest1
  through LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest5), each with its own UseCallbacks flag,
  a shared basic-execution IAM role, and pre-created CloudWatch Logs log groups
  with a configurable retention period.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Per-function callback flags
        Parameters:
          - UseCallbacks1
          - UseCallbacks2
          - UseCallbacks3
          - UseCallbacks4
          - UseCallbacks5
      - Label:
          default: Logging
        Parameters:
          - LogRetentionInDays
    ParameterLabels:
      UseCallbacks1:
        default: Function 1 use callbacks
      UseCallbacks2:
        default: Function 2 use callbacks
      UseCallbacks3:
        default: Function 3 use callbacks
      UseCallbacks4:
        default: Function 4 use callbacks
      UseCallbacks5:
        default: Function 5 use callbacks
      LogRetentionInDays:
        default: Log retention (days)

Parameters:
  UseCallbacks1:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest1 uses callbacks during hook contract testing.
    Default: no
    AllowedValues:
      - no
      - yes
  UseCallbacks2:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest2 uses callbacks during hook contract testing.
    Default: no
    AllowedValues:
      - no
      - yes
  UseCallbacks3:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest3 uses callbacks during hook contract testing.
    Default: no
    AllowedValues:
      - no
      - yes
  UseCallbacks4:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest4 uses callbacks during hook contract testing.
    Default: no
    AllowedValues:
      - no
      - yes
  UseCallbacks5:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest5 uses callbacks during hook contract testing.
    Default: no
    AllowedValues:
      - no
      - yes
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention period in days applied to every function log group.
    Default: 7
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653

Mappings:
  LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest:
    Naming:
      FunctionNamePrefix: LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest

Resources:

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Shared basic execution role for the LambdaFunctionInvokerHook contract-test functions.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AWSSamplesLambdaFunctionInvokerHookContractTest

  LambdaFunction1LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub
        - '/aws/lambda/${FunctionNamePrefix}1'
        - FunctionNamePrefix: !FindInMap
            - LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest
            - Naming
            - FunctionNamePrefix
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AWSSamplesLambdaFunctionInvokerHookContractTest

  LambdaFunction2LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub
        - '/aws/lambda/${FunctionNamePrefix}2'
        - FunctionNamePrefix: !FindInMap
            - LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest
            - Naming
            - FunctionNamePrefix
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AWSSamplesLambdaFunctionInvokerHookContractTest

  LambdaFunction3LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub
        - '/aws/lambda/${FunctionNamePrefix}3'
        - FunctionNamePrefix: !FindInMap
            - LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest
            - Naming
            - FunctionNamePrefix
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AWSSamplesLambdaFunctionInvokerHookContractTest

  LambdaFunction4LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub
        - '/aws/lambda/${FunctionNamePrefix}4'
        - FunctionNamePrefix: !FindInMap
            - LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest
            - Naming
            - FunctionNamePrefix
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: AWSSamplesLambdaFunctionInvokerHookContractTest

  LambdaFunction5LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub
        - '/aws/lambda/${FunctionNamePrefix}5'
        - FunctionNamePrefix: !FindInMap
            - LambdaFunctionInvokerHookTest
            - Naming
            - FunctionNamePrefix
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Provisions five EC2 instances in a self-contained VPC along with 11 CloudWatch
  alarms: 5 CPU utilization alarms (all instances), 3 status check failure alarms
  (instances 1-3), and 3 attached EBS volume reachability alarms (instances 1-3).
  Instances enforce IMDSv2 and use encrypted root volumes; the subnet does not
  auto-assign public IPs.

Parameters:
  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: SSM path to the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI.
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.micro
    AllowedValues:
      - t3.micro
      - t3.small
      - t3.medium
    Description: Instance type used by all five monitored instances.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - staging
      - development
    Description: Environment tag value applied to instances and alarms.

Resources:
  MonitoringVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringVPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MonitoringVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref MonitoringInternetGateway

  MonitoringPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MonitoringVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MonitoringVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringPublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: MonitoringVPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref MonitoringPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref MonitoringInternetGateway

  MonitoringSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref MonitoringPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref MonitoringPublicRouteTable

  MonitoringSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Monitoring target security group - no inbound rules, default egress only
      VpcId: !Ref MonitoringVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monitoring-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringInstance1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref MonitoringPublicSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref MonitoringSecurityGroup
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
        HttpTokens: required
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringInstance2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref MonitoringPublicSubnet

      MetadataOptions:
        HttpEndpoint: enabled

      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda

            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringInstance3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref MonitoringPublicSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref MonitoringSecurityGroup
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
        HttpTokens: required
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringInstance5:

    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Test DynamoDB table (on-demand billing, point-in-time recovery enabled) with a
  comprehensive set of 60-second CloudWatch alarms covering throttling, errors,
  latency, capacity utilization, and replication metrics.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: test-users-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB test table.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Table name must be 3-255 characters of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, '_', '-', and '.'.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    Description: Environment tag value applied to the table.

Resources:
  TestUsersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  WriteThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-write-throttle-events'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when write throttle events on the table exceed 1 in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-throttled-requests'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when throttled requests on the table exceed 1 in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ConditionalCheckFailedRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-conditional-check-failures'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when conditional check failed requests exceed 1 in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ConditionalCheckFailedRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-errors'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when DynamoDB user errors for the table exceed 1 in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-system-errors'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when DynamoDB system errors for the table exceed 1 in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  TransactionConflictAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-transaction-conflicts'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when transaction conflicts on the table exceed 1 in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: TransactionConflict
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  OnlineIndexThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-online-index-throttle-events'
      AlarmDescription: >
        Triggers when online index throttle events exceed 10 in a 60-second period.
        Note this metric is only emitted for Global Secondary Indexes; this table
        defines none, so the alarm will remain in INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: OnlineIndexThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  SuccessfulRequestLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-successful-request-latency'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when average successful request latency exceeds 100 milliseconds in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SuccessfulRequestLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Average
      Unit: Milliseconds
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ProvisionedReadCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-provisioned-read-capacity-utilization'
      AlarmDescription: >
        Triggers when table-level provisioned read capacity utilization exceeds 85 percent
        in a 60-second period. Note this is a provisioned-capacity metric and may report
        INSUFFICIENT_DATA on a purely on-demand table.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ProvisionedReadCapacityUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-provisioned-write-capacity-utilization'
      AlarmDescription: >
        Triggers when table-level provisioned write capacity utilization exceeds 85 percent
        in a 60-second period. Note this is a provisioned-capacity metric and may report
        INSUFFICIENT_DATA on a purely on-demand table.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  AccountProvisionedReadCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-account-provisioned-read-capacity-utilization'
      AlarmDescription: >
        Triggers when account-level provisioned read capacity utilization exceeds 85 percent
        in a 60-second period. Note this is a provisioned-capacity metric and may report
        INSUFFICIENT_DATA on a purely on-demand account.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: AccountProvisionedReadCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  AccountProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-account-provisioned-write-capacity-utilization'
      AlarmDescription: >
        Triggers when account-level provisioned write capacity utilization exceeds 85 percent
        in a 60-second period. Note this is a provisioned-capacity metric and may report
        INSUFFICIENT_DATA on a purely on-demand account.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: AccountProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  PendingReplicationCountAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pending-replication-count'
      AlarmDescription: >
        Triggers when pending replication count exceeds 100. Note this metric is emitted
        only by DynamoDB Global Tables; a single-region table will keep this alarm in
        INSUFFICIENT_DATA unless the table is part of a Global Table.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: PendingReplicationCount
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
        - Name: Region
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ReplicationLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-replication-latency'
      AlarmDescription: >
        Triggers when average replication latency exceeds 10 milliseconds. Note this metric
        is emitted only by DynamoDB Global Tables; a single-region table will keep this
        alarm in INSUFFICIENT_DATA unless the table is part of a Global Table.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReplicationLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
        - Name: Region
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

      will fail fast at runtime otherwise.
    Description: >
      Name of the pre-existing S3 Access Point to scan, in the same account
      and region as this stack. The default is a placeholder that MUST be
      overridden with the real access point name at deploy time.
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid email address.
    Description: Optional email to subscribe to scan notifications. Leave empty to skip SNS subscription.
  CreateSnsTopic:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Whether to create an SNS topic for scan notifications.
  CreateEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: >
      When true AND a VPC ID is supplied, create S3 Gateway, Comprehend,
      DynamoDB, and SNS interface endpoints. Set to false if the target VPC
      already has any of these endpoints (duplicates cause rollback failure).
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^vpc-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
    Description: VPC ID if the access point has VPC network origin. Empty for internet-origin.
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Subnet IDs for the Lambda (required if VpcId supplied).
  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^sg-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid security group ID (sg-*).
    Description: Security group ID for the Lambda (required if VpcId supplied).
  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Route table IDs for the S3 Gateway endpoint (required if VpcId supplied).
  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 3
    MaxValue: 900
  ComprehendLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: 'en'
    AllowedValues: ['en', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'it', 'pt', 'ar', 'hi', 'ja', 'ko', 'zh', 'zh-TW']
  MaxFilesPerInvocation:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10000

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  CreateEndpoints: !And [!Condition HasVpc, !Equals [!Ref CreateEndpoints, 'true']]
  CreateTopic: !Equals [!Ref CreateSnsTopic, 'true']
  HasEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:
  ScanReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'pii-classification-reports-${AWS::StackName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: AccessPointName
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: AccessPointName
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ScanNotificationKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateTopic
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for the PII scan notification SNS topic
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLambdaRolePublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ScannerLambdaRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  ScanNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: CreateTopic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub 'pii-scan-notifications-${AWS::StackName}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref ScanNotificationKey
      Subscription:
        - !If
          - HasEmail
          - Protocol: email
            Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  ScanNotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Condition: CreateTopic
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref ScanNotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaRolePublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ScannerLambdaRole.Arn
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref ScanNotificationTopic

  ScannerLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'pii-scanner-lambda-role-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !If
          - HasVpc
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiiScannerAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AccessPointRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${AccessPointName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${AccessPointName}/object/*'
              - Sid: AccessPointMetadataCheck
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetAccessPoint
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${AccessPointName}'
              - Sid: ComprehendPii
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DynamoDbWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ScanReportTable.Arn

  ScannerSnsPublishPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateTopic
    Properties:
      PolicyName: PiiScannerSnsPublish
      Roles:
        - !Ref ScannerLambdaRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: SnsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref ScanNotificationTopic
          - Sid: KmsForEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: !GetAtt ScanNotificationKey.Arn

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway

  ComprehendInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds: !If [HasVpc, [!Ref SecurityGroupId], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  DynamoDbInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds: !If [HasVpc, [!Ref SecurityGroupId], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SnsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds: !If [HasVpc, [!Ref SecurityGroupId], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  ScannerLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'pii-scanner-${AWS::StackName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ACCESS_POINT_NAME: !Ref AccessPointName
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${AccessPointName}'
          REPORT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref ScanReportTable
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !If [CreateTopic, !Ref ScanNotificationTopic, '']
          LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref ComprehendLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES: !Ref MaxFilesPerInvocation
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasVpc
        - SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
          SecurityGroupIds: !If [HasVpc, [!Ref SecurityGroupId], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3
          import uuid
          import random
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          s3 = boto3.client("s3")
          s3control = boto3.client("s3control")
          comprehend = boto3.client("comprehend")
          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["REPORT_TABLE_NAME"])
          sns = boto3.client("sns")

          ACCESS_POINT_NAME = os.environ["ACCESS_POINT_NAME"]
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN = os.environ["ACCESS_POINT_ARN"]
          AWS_REGION = os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", os.environ["AWS_DEFAULT_REGION"])
          ACCOUNT_ID = os.environ.get("ACCOUNT_ID", "")
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ.get("SNS_TOPIC_ARN", "")
          LANGUAGE_CODE = os.environ.get("LANGUAGE_CODE", "en")
          MAX_FILES = int(os.environ.get("MAX_FILES", "500"))
          MAX_CHUNK_BYTES = 450000

          def validate_config():
              if "replace-me" in ACCESS_POINT_NAME:
                  raise ValueError(
                      "The AccessPointName parameter still has its placeholder "
                      "default ('replace-me-access-point-name'). Re-deploy the "
                      "stack with the real pre-existing access point name."
                  )
              parts = ACCESS_POINT_ARN.split(":")
              if len(parts) != 6 or parts[0] != "arn" or parts[2] != "s3":
                  raise ValueError("Malformed access point ARN: " + ACCESS_POINT_ARN)
              if parts[3] != AWS_REGION:
                  raise ValueError(
                      "Access point ARN region '{}' does not match the stack "
                      "region '{}'. The access point must live in the same "
                      "region as this stack.".format(parts[3], AWS_REGION)
                  )
              if ACCOUNT_ID and parts[4] != ACCOUNT_ID:
                  raise ValueError(
                      "Access point ARN account '{}' does not match the stack "
                      "account. The access point must live in the same account "
                      "as this stack.".format(parts[4])
                  )

          def check_access_point_network_origin():
              acct = ACCESS_POINT_ARN.split(":")[4]
              resp = s3control.get_access_point(AccountId=acct, Name=ACCESS_POINT_NAME)
              origin = resp.get("NetworkOrigin", "")
              if origin == "VPC":
                  vpc_cfg = resp.get("VpcConfiguration", {})
                  raise ValueError(
                      "Access point '{}' has VPC network origin (VPC: {}). "
                      "This stack must be deployed with the VpcId, SubnetIds, "
                      "SecurityGroupId and RouteTableIds parameters supplied so "
                      "the scanner Lambda can run inside that VPC.".format(
                          ACCESS_POINT_NAME, vpc_cfg.get("VpcId", "unknown")
                      )
                  )
              return origin

          def paginate_objects():
              paginator = s3.get_paginator("list_objects_v2")
              for page in paginator.paginate(Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN):
                  for obj in page.get("Contents", []):
                      yield obj["Key"]

          def chunk_bytes(data, size):
              for i in range(0, len(data), size):
                  yield data[i:i + size]

          def write_findings(ap_name, key, entities):
              for e in entities:
                  dynamodb.put_item(
                      Item={
                          "AccessPointName": ap_name,
                          "ObjectKey": key,
                          "FindingId": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                          "EntityType": e["Type"],
                          "Score": str(e["Score"]),
                          "BeginOffset": e["BeginOffset"],
                          "EndOffset": e["EndOffset"],
                          "ScannedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                      }
                  )

          def notify(subject, message):
              if SNS_TOPIC_ARN:
                  sns.publish(TopicArn=SNS_TOPIC_ARN, Subject=subject[:99], Message=message)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              validate_config()
              origin = check_access_point_network_origin()
              sample_rate = float(event.get("sample_rate", 1.0))
              scan_summary = {
                  "files_scanned": 0,
                  "files_skipped": 0,
                  "chunks_processed": 0,
                  "findings": 0,
                  "network_origin": origin,
              }
              for key in paginate_objects():
                  if scan_summary["files_scanned"] >= MAX_FILES:
                      break
                  if sample_rate < 1.0 and random.random() > sample_rate:
                      scan_summary["files_skipped"] += 1
                      continue
                  try:
                      obj = s3.get_object(Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN, Key=key)
                      body = obj["Body"].read()
                  except Exception as ex:
                      scan_summary["files_skipped"] += 1
                      print("Skipped {}: {}".format(key, ex))
                      continue
                  file_findings = []
                  for chunk in chunk_bytes(body, MAX_CHUNK_BYTES):
                      text = chunk.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                      try:
                          resp = comprehend.detect_pii_entities(
                              Text=text, LanguageCode=LANGUAGE_CODE
                          )
                          entities = resp.get("Entities", [])
                      except Exception as ex:
                          print("Comprehend failed for {}: {}".format(key, ex))
                          entities = []
                      scan_summary["chunks_processed"] += 1
                      if entities:
                          write_findings(ACCESS_POINT_NAME, key, entities)
                          file_findings.extend(e["Type"] for e in entities)
                  scan_summary["files_scanned"] += 1
                  scan_summary["findings"] += len(file_findings)
                  if file_findings:
                      notify(
                          "PII detected in {}".format(key),
                          "Access Point: {}\nObject: {}\nEntity types: {}\nCount: {}".format(
                              ACCESS_POINT_NAME, key,
                              sorted(set(file_findings)), len(file_findings)
                          ),
                      )
              notify("PII scan summary for " + ACCESS_POINT_NAME, json.dumps(scan_summary, indent=2))
              return scan_summary

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >
  Creates two Glue databases (property graph and RDF) with tables for the
  air-routes dataset, including graph label metadata, Gremlin and SPARQL
  query parameters, and air-routes ontology URIs.

Parameters:
  LpgDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database
    Description: Name of the property graph (LPG) Glue database.
  RdfDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database-rdf
    Description: Name of the RDF Glue database.

Resources:
  DataBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the graph data S3 bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowGlueServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  DataBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/graph-data-bucket-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataBucketKey

  DataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref DataBucketKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  DataBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref DataBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ForceTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt DataBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${DataBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  GraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref LpgDatabaseName
        Description: Property graph (LPG) database for air-routes tables.

  RdfGraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref RdfDatabaseName
        Description: RDF database for air-routes tables.

  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: DataBucket
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          graph: gremlin
          vertex: "true"
          gremlin.query: "g.V().hasLabel('airport').out('route').limit(10).project('src','dst').by(values('code')).by(values('code'))"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${DataBucket}/graph/airport/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double

  CountryTable:

      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase

        Name: country

        StorageDescriptor:

        StorageDescriptor:

        Name: route

        StorageDescriptor:

          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:

          Columns:
            - Name: src

            - Name: dst

            - Name: airlinecode

  CustomAirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: DataBucket
    Properties:

      TableInput:
        Name: airport_rdf

        Parameters:

          classuri: 'class:Airport'
          querymode: class
          prefix.class: 'class:'
          prefix.datatypeProperty: 'datatypeProperty:'
          prefix.objectProperty: 'objectProperty:'
        StorageDescriptor:

          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:

              separatorChar: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: code

            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: elev
              Type: int

  RouteRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: DataBucket
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RdfGraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          rdf-type: "true"
          querymode: sparql
          stripuriprefix: "true"

          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat

            - Name: incode

            - Name: outcode

            - Name: dist

          sparql.query: >-

            <http://www.example.com/air-routes#outcode> ?outcode ;
            <http://www.example.com/air-routes#dist> ?dist . } LIMIT 10
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${DataBucket}/rdf/route_rdf_nopfx/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
