final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  PiBot Cognito authentication. Creates two independent Cognito setups: (1) the main
  web application with a user pool, user pool client, identity pool allowing
  unauthenticated identities, and authenticated/unauthenticated IAM roles granting
  IoT operations, Kinesis Video streaming, Rekognition label detection, and standard
  Cognito Sync / Mobile Analytics actions; (2) an IoT trusted user provisioning setup
  with its own user pool, client, identity pool, and roles where the authenticated role
  grants IoT trusted user provisioning actions. Roles are attached via
  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment resources to avoid circular dependencies.

Resources:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main web application setup
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  PiBotWebAppUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PiBotWebAppUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email

  PiBotWebAppUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: PiBotWebAppClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref PiBotWebAppUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  PiBotWebAppIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PiBotWebAppIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref PiBotWebAppUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !Sub 'cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PiBotWebAppUserPool}'

  PiBotWebAppAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Sub '${PiBotWebAppIdentityPool}'
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotWebAppAuthenticatedAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:CreateStream
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - cognito-identity:*
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'

  PiBotWebAppUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Sub '${PiBotWebAppIdentityPool}'
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotWebAppUnauthenticatedAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:CreateStream
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - cognito-identity:*
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'

  PiBotWebAppIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PiBotWebAppIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt PiBotWebAppAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt PiBotWebAppUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IoT trusted user provisioning setup
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  PiBotProvisioningUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PiBotProvisioningUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email

  PiBotProvisioningUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: PiBotProvisioningClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref PiBotProvisioningUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  PiBotProvisioningIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PiBotProvisioningIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref PiBotProvisioningUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !Sub 'cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PiBotProvisioningUserPool}'

  PiBotProvisioningAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Sub '${PiBotProvisioningIdentityPool}'
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotProvisioningTrustedUserAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-identity:*
                  - iot:AddThingToThingGroup
                  - iot:AttachThingPrincipal
                  - iot:AttachPolicy
                  - iot:CreateKeysAndCertificate
                  - iot:CreatePolicy
                  - iot:CreateThing
                  - iot:CreateThingGroup
                  - iot:CreateThingType
                  - iot:DeleteCertificate
                  - iot:DeletePolicy
                  - iot:DeleteThing
                  - iot:DeleteThingGroup
                  - iot:DeleteThingType
                  - iot:DescribeCertificate
                  - iot:DescribeThing
                  - iot:DescribeThingGroup
                  - iot:DescribeThingType
                  - iot:DetachThingPrincipal
                  - iot:DetachPolicy
                  - iot:GetRegistrationCode
                  - iot:ListAttachedPolicies
                  - iot:ListCertificates
                  - iot:ListTargetsForPolicy
                  - iot:ListThingGroupsForThing
                  - iot:ListThings
                  - iot:ListThingsInThingGroup
                  - iot:RegisterCertificate
                  - iot:RegisterThing
                  - iot:UpdateCertificate
                  - iot:UpdateThing
                  - iot:UpdateThingGroup
                  - iot:UpdateThingType
                Resource: '*'

  PiBotProvisioningUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Sub '${PiBotProvisioningIdentityPool}'
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotProvisioningUnauthenticatedAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:CreateStream
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - cognito-identity:*
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'

  PiBotProvisioningIdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref PiBotProvisioningIdentityPool
      Roles:
        authenticated: !GetAtt PiBotProvisioningAuthenticatedRole.Arn
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt PiBotProvisioningUnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:

  MainIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Identity pool ID for the main web application setup
    Value: !Ref PiBotWebAppIdentityPool

  MainUserPoolId:
    Description: User pool ID for the main web application setup
    Value: !Ref PiBotWebAppUserPool

  MainUserPoolClientId:
    Description: User pool client ID for the main web application setup
    Value: !Ref PiBotWebAppUserPoolClient

  ProvisioningIdentityPoolId:
    Description: Identity pool ID for the IoT trusted user provisioning setup
    Value: !Ref PiBotProvisioningIdentityPool

  ProvisioningUserPoolId:
    Description: User pool ID for the IoT trusted user provisioning setup
    Value: !Ref PiBotProvisioningUserPool

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Template A of 2: production public DNS zone for radiotopia.fm with email
  records (SPF, DMARC, MX), apex website records, podcast feed proxy, and
  third-party verification records (Zendesk, MailChimp, Squarespace, Campaign
  Monitor, Google Workspace). After this stack completes, update the

    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone

    Properties:

        Comment: Production DNS for radiotopia.fm

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Deploys a Bedrock AgentCore Gateway and Gateway Target for MCP integration
  supporting protein variant effect prediction. Two-phase workflow: deploy
  with DeployGateway=false (default) in a greenfield account to create the
  resolver, IAM role, and SSM role-ARN parameter; after a bootstrap stack
  creates the backend Lambda, Cognito authorizer, and SSM parameters
  (/agentcore/prediction-lambda-arn, /agentcore/cognito/discovery-url,
  /agentcore/cognito/client-id), update with DeployGateway=true so the
  resolver re-reads SSM and the gateway is created with real config. AgentCore
  validates the discovery hostname at create time, so placeholders cannot be
  used for the gateway itself. Check ConfigResolutionStatus before production.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,62}$'
    Description: Project name used for resource naming and SSM parameter paths.
  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: AgentCore Gateway for protein variant effect prediction MCP tools
    Description: Description applied to the AgentCore Gateway.
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(|[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,62})$'
    Description: Optional gateway name. Auto-generated from ProjectName if blank.
  DeployGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to 'true' only after the bootstrap stack has populated the required SSM parameters.

Conditions:
  UseDefaultGatewayName: !Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']
  CreateGateway: !Equals [!Ref DeployGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  SsmConfigResolverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssm-resolver-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: get-ssm-config
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/agentcore/*'

  SsmConfigResolverFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssm-config-resolver'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt SsmConfigResolverRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

          def handler(event, context):
              props = event['ResourceProperties']
              region = props['Region']
              account = props['AccountId']
              response_data = {}
              missing = []
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      try:
                          response_data['LambdaArn'] = ssm.get_parameter(
                              Name=props['LambdaArnParam'])['Parameter']['Value']
                      except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                          missing.append(props['LambdaArnParam'])
                          print('WARNING: SSM parameter %s not found; using PLACEHOLDER' % props['LambdaArnParam'])
                          response_data['LambdaArn'] = (
                              'arn:aws:lambda:%s:%s:function:PLACEHOLDER-NOT-CONFIGURED'
                              % (region, account))
                      try:
                          response_data['DiscoveryUrl'] = ssm.get_parameter(
                              Name=props['DiscoveryUrlParam'])['Parameter']['Value']
                      except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                          missing.append(props['DiscoveryUrlParam'])
                          print('WARNING: SSM parameter %s not found; using PLACEHOLDER' % props['DiscoveryUrlParam'])
                          response_data['DiscoveryUrl'] = (
                              'https://PLACEHOLDER.auth.%s.amazoncognito.com/.well-known/openid-configuration'
                              % region)
                      try:
                          response_data['ClientId'] = ssm.get_parameter(
                              Name=props['ClientIdParam'])['Parameter']['Value']
                      except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                          missing.append(props['ClientIdParam'])
                          print('WARNING: SSM parameter %s not found; using PLACEHOLDER' % props['ClientIdParam'])
                          response_data['ClientId'] = 'PLACEHOLDER'
                      response_data['ConfigResolutionStatus'] = (
                          'PLACEHOLDER' if missing else 'RESOLVED')
                      if missing:
                          print('WARNING: missing SSM parameters: %s' % ', '.join(missing))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, response_data)
              except Exception as e:
                  print(str(e))
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, response_data)

  SsmConfigResolver:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SsmConfigResolverFunction.Arn
      Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      LambdaArnParam: /agentcore/prediction-lambda-arn
      DiscoveryUrlParam: /agentcore/cognito/discovery-url
      ClientIdParam: /agentcore/cognito/client-id

  AgentCoreGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DependsOn: SsmConfigResolver
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: invoke-prediction-lambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt SsmConfigResolver.LambdaArn

  GatewayRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/gateway-role-arn'
      Type: String
      Description: !Sub 'ARN of the ${ProjectName} AgentCore Gateway IAM role'
      Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGatewayRole.Arn

  AgentCoreGateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    Condition: CreateGateway
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - UseDefaultGatewayName
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway'
        - !Ref GatewayName
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AgentCoreGatewayRole.Arn
      ProtocolType: MCP
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: !GetAtt SsmConfigResolver.DiscoveryUrl
          AllowedClients:
            - !GetAtt SsmConfigResolver.ClientId

  AgentCoreGatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    Condition: CreateGateway
    DependsOn: AgentCoreGatewayRole
    Properties:
      GatewayIdentifier: !Ref AgentCoreGateway
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-prediction-target'
      Description: MCP tools for submitting protein sequences and retrieving variant effect prediction results
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !GetAtt SsmConfigResolver.LambdaArn
            ToolSchema:
              - Name: invoke_endpoint
                Description: Submit protein sequences for variant effect prediction
                InputSchema:
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    sequence:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Amino acid sequence to predict variant effects for
                    mutations:
                      Type: array
                      Description: List of variant mutations to evaluate
                      Items:
                        Type: string
                  Required:
                    - sequence
              - Name: get_results
                Description: Check job completion status and retrieve prediction results
                InputSchema:
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    job_id:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Identifier of the prediction job to query
                  Required:
                    - job_id
      CredentialProviderConfigurations:
        - CredentialProviderType: GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE

Outputs:
  GatewayArn:
    Description: ARN of the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway (only when DeployGateway=true)
    Value: !If [CreateGateway, !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayArn, 'gateway-not-deployed (DeployGateway=false)']
  GatewayId:
    Description: Identifier of the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway (only when DeployGateway=true)

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Private VPC infrastructure for secured application deployment. Creates a VPC
  with two private ALB subnets in separate AZs, one private Lambda subnet in a
  third AZ, an optional NAT egress path (for OAuth / external IdP flows), a
  customer-managed KMS key (retained on stack deletion), and a versioned,
  KMS-encrypted artifact bucket locked down with a bucket policy.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  AlbSubnetACidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the first private ALB subnet (AZ index 0).
  AlbSubnetBCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the second private ALB subnet (AZ index 1).
  LambdaSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the private Lambda subnet (AZ index 2).
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet hosting the NAT gateway (only created when egress is enabled).
  EnableNatEgress:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to provision internet egress (IGW + NAT gateway) for OAuth and external identity provider flows.

Conditions:
  EnableNatEgressCondition: !Equals [!Ref EnableNatEgress, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  AlbSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnetACidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-subnet-a'

  AlbSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnetBCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-subnet-b'

  LambdaSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lambda-subnet'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnetARouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetBRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  LambdaSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref LambdaSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: EnableNatEgressCondition
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: EnableNatEgressCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: EnableNatEgressCondition
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'

  NatElasticIp:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: EnableNatEgressCondition
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: EnableNatEgressCondition
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatElasticIp.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-gw'

  PublicRouteTable:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SQS audit event queue with KMS encryption, DLQ, CloudWatch alarms, and SNS notifications.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: audit-events
    Description: Application name used for tagging and resource naming.
  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ops@example.com
    Description: Email address for alarm notifications.
  AlarmProtocol:
    Type: String
    Default: email
    AllowedValues:
      - email
      - email-json
      - https
    Description: Protocol for the SNS subscription.
  AgeOfOldestMessageThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3600
    Description: Seconds before the oldest-message alarm fires.
  MaxReceiveCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    Description: Number of receives before a message is moved to the DLQ.

Conditions:
  IsNonDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]]
  ProdLikeRetention: !Equals [!Ref Environment, prod]
  StagingRetention: !Equals [!Ref Environment, staging]

Resources:
  QueueKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for ${ApplicationName} audit queue (${Environment})'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSqsService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sqs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AlarmTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for ${ApplicationName} alarm topic (${Environment})'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  DeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-audit-dlq-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !If
        - ProdLikeRetention
        - 1209600
        - !If
          - StagingRetention
          - 604800
          - 86400
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AuditQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-audit-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !If
        - ProdLikeRetention
        - 1209600
        - !If
          - StagingRetention
          - 604800
          - 86400
      VisibilityTimeout: !If
        - ProdLikeRetention
        - 300
        - !If
          - StagingRetention
          - 240
          - 120
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNonDev
        - !Sub
          - '{"deadLetterTargetArn":"${DLQArn}","maxReceiveCount":${MaxReceiveCount}}'
          - DLQArn: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-alarms-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AlarmSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic
      Protocol: !Ref AlarmProtocol
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail

  OldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-audit-${Environment}-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when the oldest message in the audit queue exceeds the threshold.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref AgeOfOldestMessageThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  DlqAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-audit-${Environment}-dlq-messages'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when messages appear in the dead letter queue.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

Outputs:
  AuditQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the primary audit queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditQueue
  AuditQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the primary audit queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.Arn
  DeadLetterQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the dead letter queue.
    Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the alarm notification topic.
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for queue encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt QueueKey.Arn
  AlarmTopicKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for the alarm topic.
    Value: !GetAtt AlarmTopicKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Cognito User Pool for researchapp/AgentCore with MFA (optional TOTP), email-as-username,
  admin/customer groups, custom resource server read scope, web (auth code) and
  machine (client credentials) clients, a standalone Lambda to add users to the
  customer group, and SSM parameters under /app/researchapp/agentcore/.
  NOTE: The Cognito domain prefix is globally unique across all AWS accounts.
  The default may be taken in your region; override the DomainPrefix parameter
  if deployment fails with an availability error.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool.
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine app client.
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the web app client.
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: researchapp-agentcore-tmpl
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9\-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    Description: >-
      Globally unique lowercase Cognito domain prefix (3-63 chars, lowercase
      letters, numbers, hyphens). Must be unique across all AWS accounts in the region.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Welcome to researchapp. Your verification code is {####}.'
      EmailVerificationSubject: 'researchapp - Verify your email'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: !Ref UserPool
      Name: researchapp-resource-server
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to researchapp resources

  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Sub '${UserPool}/read'
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  MachineAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${UserPool}/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoGroupManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:ListUsersInGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'

  AddUserToCustomerGroupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${UserPoolName}-add-to-customer-group'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = os.environ["USER_POOL_ID"]
              username = event.get("userName") or event.get("username")
              if not username:
                  raise ValueError("userName is required")
              cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  GroupName="customer",
                  Username=username,
              )
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": f"User {username} added to customer group"}

  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool

  SSMWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web-client-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient

  SSMMachineClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-client-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineAppClient

  SSMMachineClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-client-secret
      Type: String
      Description: >-
        Machine client secret stored as a plaintext String parameter because
        AWS::SSM::Parameter does not support SecureString in CloudFormation.
        If secrecy is required, rotate/secure this value post-deployment.
      Value: !GetAtt MachineAppClient.ClientSecret

  SSMScope:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/oauth-scope
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub '${UserPool}/read'

  SSMDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/discovery-url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  SSMTokenUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/token-url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

  SSMAuthorizeUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/authorize-url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize'

  SSMDomainUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito-domain-url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  WebAppClientId:
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient
  MachineAppClientId:
    Value: !Ref MachineAppClient
  CognitoDomain:
    Value: !Sub 'https://${DomainPrefix}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  DiscoveryUrl:
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'
  OAuthReadScope:
    Value: !Sub '${UserPool}/read'
  AddToCustomerGroupFunctionArn:
    Value: !GetAtt AddUserToCustomerGroupFunction.Arn
  SSMParameterPaths:
    Value: '/app/researchapp/agentcore/*'
    Description: >-
      SSM prefix holding user-pool-id, web-client-id, machine-client-id,
      machine-client-secret (String, not SecureString - see parameter
      description), oauth-scope, discovery-url, token-url, authorize-url,
      and cognito-domain-url.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL API for cryptocurrency ticker data backed by DynamoDB.

Resources:
  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      XrayEnabled: false

  CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Query {
          ticker(symbol: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        type TickerInfo {
          symbol: String
          price: Float
          timestamp: String
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type PriceRecord {
          ticker: String
          price: Float
          timestamp: String
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceRecord]
          nextToken: String
        }

  CryptoTickerAPIKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId

  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  DynamoDBAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  DynamoDBAccessPolicy:

  CoinGeckoDataSource:

  APIDataTableDataSource:

  FetchCoinGeckoPriceFunction:

      RequestMappingTemplate: |

          "version": "2018-05-29",

  PutPriceRecordFunction:

      RequestMappingTemplate: |

          "attributeValues": {

  TickerResolver:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  MediaPackage v2 live streaming channel group/channel with conditional HLS and/or
  DASH origin endpoints, conditional S3 archive and VOD source buckets
  (KMS-encrypted with an in-template CMK) with a MediaPackage access role,
  and environment/custom tagging.

Parameters:
  LogicalResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: livestream
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$
    MaxLength: 64
    Description: Logical prefix used for resource names.
  NameSuffix:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]*$
    MaxLength: 32
    Description: >
      Optional suffix appended to MediaPackage resource names to guarantee
      uniqueness against any orphaned resources from prior deployments.
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    Description: Segment duration in seconds for the HLS endpoint.
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,256}$
    Description: Manifest name for the origin endpoints.
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    Description: Startover window in seconds for both endpoints.
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Which origin endpoint(s) to create.
  ArchiveBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
    MaxLength: 63
    Description: >
      If supplied (non-empty), the archive S3 bucket is named with this value to
      support live-to-VOD workflows.
  VodSourceBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
    MaxLength: 63
    Description: >
      If supplied (non-empty), the VOD source S3 bucket is named with this value.
  EnvironmentTag:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment tag applied to all taggable resources.
  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional custom tag key.
  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional custom tag value.

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucketName, ""]]
  HasVodBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucketName, ""]]
  HasCustomTag: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey, ""]]
  IsOutputTypeAll: !Equals [!Ref OutputType, "ALL"]
  IsOutputTypeHls: !Equals [!Ref OutputType, "APPLE_HLS"]
  IsOutputTypeDash: !Equals [!Ref OutputType, "ISO_DASH"]
  CreateHlsEndpoint: !Or [!Condition IsOutputTypeHls, !Condition IsOutputTypeAll]
  CreateDashEndpoint: !Or [!Condition IsOutputTypeDash, !Condition IsOutputTypeAll]

Resources:
  MediaPackageBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer managed key for ${LogicalResourceNamePrefix} MediaPackage S3 buckets"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasVodBucket
        - !Ref VodSourceBucketName
        - !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-vod-source-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodSourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref VodSourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasArchiveBucket
        - !Ref ArchiveBucketName
        - !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-archive-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ArchiveBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArchiveBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  MediaPackageRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: mediapackage-s3-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadVodSource
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: ArchiveReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: ArchiveList
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
              - Sid: KmsBucketKeyUse
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt MediaPackageBucketKey.Arn

  LiveChannelGroup:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackageV2::ChannelGroup
    Properties:
      ChannelGroupName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-group${NameSuffix}"
      Description: Channel group for the live streaming workflow
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  LiveChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackageV2::Channel
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ChannelName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-channel${NameSuffix}"
      ChannelGroupName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-group${NameSuffix}"
      Description: Live streaming channel
      InputType: HLS
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # NOTE: MediaPackage v2 has no per-endpoint "Origination" ALLOW/DENY control
  # equivalent to v1. The live-to-VOD intent (DENY when ArchiveBucketName is
  # supplied) is preserved by gating the archive bucket provisioning; harvesting
  # is performed against the channel/endpoint by the downstream harvester.
  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackageV2::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Properties:
      OriginEndpointName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-hls${NameSuffix}"
      ChannelName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-channel${NameSuffix}"
      ChannelGroupName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-group${NameSuffix}"
      ContainerType: TS
      Description: HLS origin endpoint
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Segment:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
      HlsManifests:
        - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackageV2::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Properties:
      OriginEndpointName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-dash${NameSuffix}"
      ChannelName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-channel${NameSuffix}"
      ChannelGroupName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-group${NameSuffix}"
      ContainerType: CMAF
      Description: DASH origin endpoint
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Segment:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
      DashManifests:
        - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

Outputs:
  ChannelId:
    Description: MediaPackage v2 channel name
    Value: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-channel${NameSuffix}"
  HlsEndpointArn:
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Description: >
      HLS origin endpoint ARN. Playback manifest URLs can be derived from this
      endpoint via the MediaPackage v2 API/Console (GetOriginEndpoint).
    Value: !Ref HlsOriginEndpoint
  DashEndpointArn:
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Description: >
      DASH origin endpoint ARN. Playback manifest URLs can be derived from this
      endpoint via the MediaPackage v2 API/Console (GetOriginEndpoint).
    Value: !Ref DashOriginEndpoint
  VodSourceBucketName:
    Description: VOD source bucket name
    Value: !Ref VodSourceBucket
  ArchiveBucketNameOutput:
    Description: Archive bucket name
    Value: !Ref ArchiveBucket
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt MediaPackageBucketKey.Arn

Description: >-
  IAM roles, instance profiles, and managed policies for the Cluster API
  Provider AWS (CAPA), covering EC2-based and EKS-based cluster lifecycle
  management.

Resources:

  CAPAControlPlanePolicy:

      ManagedPolicyName: capa-control-plane
      Description: Broad permissions for CAPA control plane (EC2, ELB, ASG, KMS).
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  CAPAControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-controllers
      Description: Extensive permissions for CAPA controllers (EC2, ELB, ASG, IAM, EKS).
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateAccessEntry
              - eks:DeleteAccessEntry
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:UpdateAccessEntry
              - eks:ListAssociatedAccessPolicies
              - eks:AssociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:DisassociateAccessPolicy
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAutoScaling'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKS'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
                  - autoscaling.amazonaws.com
                  - eks.amazonaws.com

  CAPAControllersEKSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-controllers-eks
      Description: EKS cluster and nodegroup management permissions for CAPA.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:GetPolicy
              - iam:GetPolicyVersion
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:RetireGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                kms:RequestAlias: 'alias/cluster-api-provider-aws-*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - eks.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com

  CAPANodesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-nodes
      Description: Node permissions for CAPA-managed Kubernetes worker nodes.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
              - ecr:UploadLayerPart
              - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
              - ecr:PutImage
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::capa-bootstrap-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*'

  CAPAControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-control-plane
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CAPAControlPlanePolicy
        - !Ref CAPAControllersEKSPolicy

  CAPAControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-controllers
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CAPAControllersPolicy
        - !Ref CAPAControllersEKSPolicy

  CAPANodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-nodes
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Ref CAPANodesPolicy

  CAPAControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: capa-control-plane
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPAControlPlaneRole

  CAPAControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: capa-controllers
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPAControllersRole

  CAPANodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: capa-nodes
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPANodesRole

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-eks-control-plane
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'

Outputs:

  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA control plane role.
    Value: !GetAtt CAPAControlPlaneRole.Arn

  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA controllers role.
    Value: !GetAtt CAPAControllersRole.Arn

  NodesRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA nodes role.
    Value: !GetAtt CAPANodesRole.Arn

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Description: Name of the CAPA control plane instance profile.
    Value: !Ref CAPAControlPlaneInstanceProfile

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Description: Name of the CAPA controllers instance profile.
    Value: !Ref CAPAControllersInstanceProfile

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Description: Name of the CAPA nodes instance profile.
    Value: !Ref CAPANodesInstanceProfile

  EKSControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the dedicated EKS control plane role.
    Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Self-contained ECS Fargate service behind a public ALB with tasks in private subnets.
  Accepted-risk exceptions (intentional design, explicitly required by the user request):
  (1) The ALB Scheme is internet-facing — the service must be publicly reachable; exposure is
  limited by the ALB security group allowing only inbound TCP 80 from 0.0.0.0/0 (AWS-0053).
  (2) The two public subnets set MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true — required for the NAT gateway and
  ALB; Fargate tasks run in private subnets with AssignPublicIp: DISABLED (AWS-0164).
Metadata:
  SecurityExceptions:
    AWS-0053:
      Rule: Load balancer exposed to the internet
      Justification: Internet-facing ALB is an explicit user requirement; access restricted to HTTP port 80 from the internet via security group ingress.
    AWS-0164:
      Rule: Subnets should not auto-assign public IPs
      Justification: Public subnets require auto-assign for NAT gateway and ALB placement; application tasks run in private subnets with no public IP assignment.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    MaxLength: 10
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$"
    Description: Environment name used for resource naming.
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-service
    MaxLength: 10
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$"
    Description: Name of the ECS service.
  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx:latest
    Description: Container image to deploy.
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: Port the container listens on.
  Cpu:
    Type: String
    Default: "256"
    Description: CPU units for the Fargate task.
  Memory:
    Type: String
    Default: "512"
    Description: Memory (MiB) for the Fargate task.
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    Description: Desired number of tasks.
  PathPattern:
    Type: String
    Default: "/*"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9/_.?*-]+$"
    Description: URL path pattern for the ALB listener rule.
  ListenerRulePriority:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 50000
    Description: Priority of the ALB listener rule.
  TaskRoleArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional IAM role ARN for the task containers.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

Conditions:
  HasCustomTaskRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TaskRoleArn, ""]]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true  # trivy:ignore:AVD-aws-0164 -- Public subnets required for NAT gateway/ALB; Fargate tasks run in private subnets with AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true  # trivy:ignore:AVD-aws-0164 -- Public subnets required for NAT gateway/ALB; Fargate tasks run in private subnets with AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-2"

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 6, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-2"

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt"

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: NatEIP
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat"

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt"

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: NatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2Association:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  AlbSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: ALB security group - HTTP from internet only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-alb-sg"

  TaskSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Fargate task security group - container port from ALB only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AlbSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-task-sg"

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}"
      RetentionInDays: 30

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-cluster"

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  DefaultTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-tg"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: ip
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: !Ref ContainerPort
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: "200"

  ApplicationLoadBalancer:  # trivy:ignore:AVD-AWS-0053 -- Internet-facing ALB is an explicit requirement; ingress restricted to TCP 80 via AlbSecurityGroup
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-alb"
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Type: application
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref AlbSecurityGroup
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled
          Value: "true"

  HttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ApplicationLoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: redirect
          RedirectConfig:
            StatusCode: HTTP_301
            Protocol: HTTPS
            Port: "443"
            Host: "#{host}"
            Path: "/#{path}"
            Query: "#{query}"

  HttpListenerRule:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::ListenerRule
    Properties:
      ListenerArn: !Ref HttpListener
      Priority: !Ref ListenerRulePriority
      Conditions:
        - Field: path-pattern
          PathPatternConfig:
            Values:
              - !Ref PathPattern
      Actions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}"
      Cpu: !Ref Cpu
      Memory: !Ref Memory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If
        - HasCustomTaskRole
        - !Ref TaskRoleArn
        - !Ref DefaultTaskRole
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: HttpListener
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}"
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

Outputs:
  LoadBalancerDnsName:
    Description: Public DNS name of the Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt ApplicationLoadBalancer.DNSName
  ClusterName:
    Description: ECS cluster name
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster
  ServiceName:
    Description: ECS service name
    Value: !Ref EcsService
