AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Configurable DynamoDB table with optional sort key, billing mode switch,
  point-in-time recovery, optional customer-managed KMS encryption, and
  optional CloudWatch alarms publishing to an encrypted SNS topic.

Parameters:
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: "id"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$"
    Description: Name of the partition key attribute.
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
    Description: Type of the partition key attribute.
  UseSortKey:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Whether to define a sort key.
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: "sortKey"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$"
    Description: Name of the sort key attribute.
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "N"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
    Description: Type of the sort key attribute.
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: "PROVISIONED"
    AllowedValues: ["PROVISIONED", "PAY_PER_REQUEST"]
    Description: DynamoDB billing mode.
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Read capacity units (used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Write capacity units (used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).
  EnablePITR:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery.
  EnableCMK:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Use a customer-managed KMS key for server-side encryption.
  EnableAlerting:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Create CloudWatch alarms and an SNS topic for alerting.
  AlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Threshold for alarm metrics (sum over period).
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional custom table name. Leave empty to let DynamoDB auto-generate."
  Application:
    Type: String
    Default: "myapp"
    Description: Application tag value.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: "dev"
    AllowedValues: ["dev", "test", "staging", "prod"]
    Description: Environment tag value.

Conditions:
  HasSortKey: !Equals [!Ref UseSortKey, "true"]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, "PROVISIONED"]
  PITREnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnablePITR, "true"]
  CMKEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableCMK, "true"]
  AlertingEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlerting, "true"]
  HasCustomTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, ""]]

Resources:
  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !If
        - HasCustomTableName
        - !Ref TableName
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      AttributeDefinitions: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
      KeySchema: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: !If
        - PITREnabled
        - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      SSESpecification: !If
        - CMKEnabled
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  KMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CMKEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer-managed key for ${Application} DynamoDB table"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"

  AlertTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: AlertingEnabled
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer-managed key for ${Application}-${Environment}-dynamodb-alerts SNS topic"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*"

  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: AlertingEnabled
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "${Application}-${Environment}-dynamodb-alerts"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AlertTopicKey

  TableThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlertingEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: "DynamoDB throttled requests exceeded threshold"
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref AlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

  TableSystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlertingEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: "DynamoDB system errors exceeded threshold"
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref AlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

  TableUserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlertingEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: "DynamoDB user errors exceeded threshold"
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref AlarmThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !Ref Table
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table
    Value: !GetAtt Table.Arn
  KMSKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt KMSKey.Arn
    Condition: CMKEnabled
  AlertTopicKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key protecting the SNS alert topic
    Value: !GetAtt AlertTopicKey.Arn
    Condition: AlertingEnabled
  AlertTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS alert topic
    Value: !Ref AlertTopic
    Condition: AlertingEnabled

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  EC2 Image Builder pipeline building custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs for x86_64
  and arm64 with Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and SSM sudo access.
  AMIs are distributed publicly and shared with an AWS Organization.

Parameters:
  X86RecipeName:
    Type: String
    Default: custom-al2023-x86-recipe
    Description: Name of the x86_64 image recipe.
  Arm64RecipeName:
    Type: String
    Default: custom-al2023-arm64-recipe
    Description: Name of the arm64 image recipe.
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$
    Description: Semantic version for the image recipes and pipelines.
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1024
    Description: Root EBS volume size in GiB for the built AMIs.
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$
    Description: >
      Optional AWS Organization ID (o-xxxxxxxxxx) to share the AMIs with.
      Leave empty to skip organization sharing.

Conditions:
  HasOrganizationId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationId, '']]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  BuilderSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instances and VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt BuilderSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt BuilderSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt BuilderSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:DescribeAssociation
                  - ssm:GetDeployablePatchSnapshotForInstance
                  - ssm:GetDocument
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                  - ssm:GetManifest
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:ListAssociations
                  - ssm:ListInstanceAssociations
                  - ssm:PutInventory
                  - ssm:PutComplianceItems
                  - ssm:PutConfigurePackageResult
                  - ssm:UpdateAssociationStatus
                  - ssm:UpdateInstanceAssociationStatus
                  - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
                  - ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel
                  - ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel
                  - ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel
                  - ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel
                  - ec2messages:AcknowledgeMessage
                  - ec2messages:GetEndpoint
                  - ec2messages:GetMessages
                  - ec2messages:SendReply
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponent
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponentVersion
                  - imagebuilder:GetInfrastructureConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:ListComponents
                  - imagebuilder:ListComponentVersions
                  - imagebuilder:ListInfrastructureConfigurations
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-role'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderPipelineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:*
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:RegisterImage
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - sns:Publish
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-role'

  SoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-software-component'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and SSM sudo access
      Data: |
        name: SoftwareInstallation
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker python3.12 python3.12-pip
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - curl -SL https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-linux-x86_64 -o /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
                    - chmod +x /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
                    - ln -sf /usr/local/bin/docker-compose /usr/bin/docker-compose
                    - python3.12 -m pip install --no-cache-dir synapseclient pandas pysftp
                    - echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user

  TestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-test-component'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Verifies Docker Compose and Python package imports
      Data: |
        name: VerificationTests
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: VerifyDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker-compose --version
              - name: VerifyPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3.12 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp"

  X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref X86RecipeName
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SoftwareComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt TestComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-x86-recipe'

  Arm64ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref Arm64RecipeName
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SoftwareComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt TestComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-arm64-recipe'

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >
  CloudWatch Logs Insights queries and dashboard for AWS Client VPN usage reporting.
  Covers total usage per endpoint, usage per authentication type (AD/SAML, Mutual Auth,
  Mixed Auth), distinct users, and connection durations.
  NOTE: Query definitions reference the Client VPN log group by name only; the log group
  is generated by the pre-existing Client VPN endpoint and is not created by this template.
  Accepted behavior: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition tolerates log group names that do not
  exist at creation time.

Parameters:
  FolderPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    Description: Optional folder path to organize the CloudWatch Logs Insights queries.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\/]*$'
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws/aws-client-vpn/prod
    Description: Name of the Client VPN connection log group (not created by this template).
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\/\.]+$'
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - staging
      - development
    Description: Environment identifier embedded in resource names.
  Name:
    Type: String
    Default: client-vpn-usage-reporting
    Description: Base name for all resources.

Resources:
  UsagePerEndpointQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPrefix}usage-per-endpoint'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /connection-attempt(?<connectionId>[^\s"]*)/
        | filter ispresent(connectionId)
        | stats count(*) as connectionAttempts by coalesce(connection-endpoint-ip, "unknown") as endpoint
        | sort connectionAttempts desc

  UsagePerAuthTypeQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPrefix}usage-per-auth-type'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /authentication\s*:\s*(?<authType>[^\s,}]+)/
        | filter ispresent(authType)
        | stats count(*) as connections by authType
        | sort connections desc

  DistinctUsersQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPrefix}distinct-users'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /username(?:['"])?\s*[:=]\s*['"]?(?<userName>[^'",\s}]+)/
        | filter ispresent(userName)
        | stats count_distinct(userName) as distinctUsers, count(*) as totalConnections

  ConnectionDurationsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPrefix}connection-durations'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /connection-duration(?:-time)?\s*[:=]\s*['"]?(?<durationSeconds>\d+)/
        | filter ispresent(durationSeconds)
        | stats avg(durationSeconds) as avgDurationSeconds, max(durationSeconds) as maxDurationSeconds, min(durationSeconds) as minDurationSeconds, count(*) as sessions by bin(1h) as sessionHour
        | sort sessionHour desc

  ClientVpnDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub '${Name}-${Environment}-client-vpn-dashboard'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "QueryDefinitionId": "${UsagePerEndpointQuery}",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Total Usage per Endpoint",
                "view": "table"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "QueryDefinitionId": "${UsagePerAuthTypeQuery}",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Usage per Authentication Type (AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, Mixed Auth)",
                "view": "table"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "QueryDefinitionId": "${DistinctUsersQuery}",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Distinct Users",
                "view": "table"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "QueryDefinitionId": "${ConnectionDurationsQuery}",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Connection Durations",
                "view": "table"
              }
            }
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  DashboardURL:
    Description: URL of the Client VPN usage reporting dashboard.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AWS::AccountId}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${AWS::Region}#dashboards:name=${Name}-${Environment}-client-vpn-dashboard'

    Description: Name of the distinct users query definition.
    Value: !Ref DistinctUsersQuery
  ConnectionDurationsQueryName:
    Description: Name of the connection durations query definition.
    Value: !Ref ConnectionDurationsQuery

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Hospitality Insights prod Cognito user pool with post-auth Lambda trigger, groups, optional SSO and hosted UI domain.

Parameters:
  SsoLoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: SAML IdP login/metadata URL. Leave empty to disable SSO.
  SsoProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name of the SAML identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO.
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. Leave empty to skip domain creation.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{0,63}$'
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights

Conditions:
  SsoEnabled: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoLoginUrl, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoProviderName, '']]
  DomainEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DomainPrefix, '']]

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-userpool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn

  PostAuthLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-postauth-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostAuthLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'

  PostAuthLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-post-auth-trigger'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import logging
          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(os.environ.get('LOG_LEVEL', 'INFO'))
          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Post-authentication event received for user pool %s", event.get('userPoolId'))
              try:
                  user_attrs = event.get('request', {}).get('userAttributes', {})
                  username = user_attrs.get('sub') or event.get('userName')
                  client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=event['userPoolId'],
                      Username=username,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {
                              'Name': 'custom:last_login',
                              'Value': event['request'].get('timestamp', '')
                          }
                      ]
                  )
              except Exception:
                  logger.exception("Failed to update custom:last_login attribute")
                  raise
              return event

  LambdaCognitoPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: hours

  UserPoolClientSso:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Condition: SsoEnabled
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-client-sso'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - !Ref SsoProviderName
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: hours

  SamlIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: SsoEnabled
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SsoProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      ProviderDetails:
        IDPSignout: 'true'
        MetadataURL: !Ref SsoLoginUrl

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 1

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 2

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 3

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Condition: DomainEnabled
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Value: !If
      - SsoEnabled
      - !Ref UserPoolClientSso
      - !Ref UserPoolClient
  HostedUiDomain:
    Condition: DomainEnabled
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: WebSocket API with $connect, $default, $disconnect routes backed by Lambda and DynamoDB session tracking.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9-]+$"
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API stage.

Resources:
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sessions"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expireAt
        Enabled: true

  ConnectLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConnectPutItem
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  DefaultLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DefaultExecuteApi
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: execute-api:Invoke
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/@connections/*

  DisconnectLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DisconnectDeleteItem
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  ConnectFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt ConnectLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SESSION_TABLE: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import time
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["SESSION_TABLE"])

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event["requestContext"]["connectionId"]
              domain = event["requestContext"]["domainName"]
              stage = event["requestContext"]["stage"]
              item = {
                  "connectionId": connection_id,
                  "connectedAt": int(time.time()),
                  "expireAt": int(time.time()) + 86400,
                  "endpoint": f"https://{domain}/{stage}",
              }
              qs = event.get("queryStringParameters") or {}
              if qs:
                  item["queryParams"] = qs
              headers = event.get("headers") or {}
              if headers.get("user-agent"):
                  item["userAgent"] = headers["user-agent"]
              table.put_item(Item=item)
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Connected."}

  DefaultFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt DefaultLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SESSION_TABLE: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["SESSION_TABLE"])

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event["requestContext"]["connectionId"]
              domain = event["requestContext"]["domainName"]
              stage = event["requestContext"]["stage"]
              endpoint = f"https://{domain}/{stage}"
              client = boto3.client("apigatewaymanagementapi", endpoint_url=endpoint)
              body = event.get("body") or ""
              client.post_to_connection(ConnectionId=connection_id, Data=body.encode("utf-8"))
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps({"echoed": body})}

  DisconnectFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt DisconnectLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SESSION_TABLE: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["SESSION_TABLE"])

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event["requestContext"]["connectionId"]
              table.delete_item(Key={"connectionId": connection_id})
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Disconnected."}

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-websocket"
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: "$request.body.action"

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ConnectFunction.Arn}/invocations

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DefaultFunction.Arn}/invocations

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DisconnectFunction.Arn}/invocations

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      Target: !Sub integrations/${ConnectIntegration}

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DefaultIntegration}

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      AutoDeploy: true

  ConnectInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ConnectFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/$connect

  DefaultInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DefaultFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/$default

  DisconnectInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DisconnectFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/$disconnect

Outputs:

    Description: WebSocket (wss) endpoint for clients.
    Value: !Sub "wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}"
  SessionTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table tracking client sessions.
    Value: !Ref SessionTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: BestFriends - Self-contained ECS Fargate app behind a public ALB, tasks in private subnets, with optional in-template ACM HTTPS.
Metadata:
  SecurityPosture: >-
    AWS-0164 remediated: public subnets do not auto-assign public IPs (internet-facing ALB
    requires only IGW routing). AWS-0053 is a documented intentional exposure: the user request
    mandates an internet-facing ALB; sanctioned scanner ignore annotation applied on the
    LoadBalancer resource. AWS-0054 is a documented intentional exposure: the user request
    explicitly requires a port-80 listener that forwards all paths; no ACM certificate can be
    validated in a greenfield account without operator-controlled DNS. HTTPS is available via
    EnableHttps=true. AWS-0104 is a documented intentional exception: the app SG egress allows
    TCP 443 to 0.0.0.0/0 because the default image is pulled from public.ecr.aws, which has no
    VPC endpoint — the pull traverses the NAT gateway and requires internet-bound 443. This
    exception is unavoidable while a public registry image is used; switching to a private
    in-template ECR repository (operator pushes the image) would allow removing it.
  HttpsOperation: >-
    HTTPS is optional (EnableHttps parameter, default false). When enabled, an in-template ACM
    certificate is created with DNS validation — the operator must control the domain's DNS and
    complete validation out-of-band before HTTPS traffic works.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/nginx:1.27-alpine
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8000
    Description: Port the container listens on (must match the target group and task port mapping).
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
  EnableHttps:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Set to 'true' to create the ACM certificate and HTTPS:443 listener. Requires a domain whose DNS you control; complete DNS validation out-of-band.
  CertificateDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: app.example.com
    Description: Domain name for the in-template ACM certificate (only used when EnableHttps=true). Must be a domain whose Route53/DNS the operator controls; validation records must be created after stack creation.
  S3PrefixListId:
    Type: String
    Default: pl-63a5400a
    Description: AWS-managed S3 gateway prefix list ID for the deployment region (AWS-owned identifier, not account-specific).

Conditions:
  HasHttps: !Equals [!Ref EnableHttps, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt'

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  ContainerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${AWS::StackName}/bestfriends'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'
      CapacityProviders:
        - FARGATE
        - FARGATE_SPOT
      DefaultCapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Weight: 1

  AlbCertificate:
    Type: AWS::CertificateManager::Certificate
    Condition: HasHttps
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Ref CertificateDomainName
      ValidationMethod: DNS

  AlbSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTP/HTTPS from the internet to the ALB
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-sg'

  AppSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow TCP 8000 from the ALB only; egress scoped to VPC CIDR, S3 prefix list, and internet 443 (see Metadata)
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-sg'

  AppEgressToS3PrefixList:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt AppSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref S3PrefixListId

  AppEgressInternet443:
    # trivy:ignore:AVD-AWS-0104 -- required for public.ecr.aws image pulls via NAT; no VPC endpoint exists for public ECR
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt AppSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0

  AlbToAppEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt AlbSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 8000
      ToPort: 8000
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt AppSecurityGroup.GroupId

  AppIngressFromAlb:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !GetAtt AppSecurityGroup.GroupId
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 8000
      ToPort: 8000
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt AlbSecurityGroup.GroupId

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tg'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: ip
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: !Ref ContainerPort
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 30
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      Matcher:
        HttpCode: '200'
      TargetGroupAttributes:
        - Key: deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds
          Value: '30'

  LoadBalancer:
    # trivy:ignore:AVD-AWS-0053 -- public ALB is an explicit application requirement
    # tfsec:ignore:aws-elb-alb-not-public
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb'
      Scheme: internet-facing
      Type: application
      SecurityGroups:
        - !GetAtt AlbSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Subnets:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled
          Value: 'true'

  HttpsListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Condition: HasHttps
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref LoadBalancer
      Port: 443
      Protocol: HTTPS
      SslPolicy: ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS13-1-2-2021-06
      Certificates:
        - CertificateArn: !Ref AlbCertificate
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  HttpListener:
    # trivy:ignore:AVD-AWS-0054 -- port-80 forward is the explicit user requirement; no controllable DNS for ACM in greenfield
    # tfsec:ignore:aws-elb-http-not-https
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref LoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ecs-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt ContainerLogGroup.Arn

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: bestfriends
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: bestfriends-app
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          EntryPoint:
            - sh
            - -c
          Command:
            - >-
              printf 'server {\n  listen 8000;\n  location / { return 200
              "BestFriends OK\n"; add_header Content-Type text/plain; }\n}\n'
              > /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf && exec nginx -g 'daemon off;'
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ContainerLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: HttpListener
    Properties:
      ServiceName: bestfriends
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: 2
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: false
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !GetAtt AppSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
          ContainerName: bestfriends-app
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort

Outputs:
  AlbDnsName:
    Description: Public DNS name of the Application Load Balancer
    Value: !GetAtt LoadBalancer.DNSName
  ClusterName:
    Description: ECS cluster name
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group for container logs (retained on delete/replace)
    Value: !Ref ContainerLogGroup
  CertificateArn:
    Condition: HasHttps
    Description: ARN of the in-template ACM certificate (complete DNS validation to enable HTTPS)
    Value: !Ref AlbCertificate

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Basic VPC with a single public /22 subnet for testing purposes. Includes an
  internet gateway, a public route table with a default route to the internet
  gateway, and a network ACL allowing all inbound and outbound traffic.
  Note: instances launched into the subnet do NOT receive public IPv4
  addresses automatically; consumers must explicitly request a public IP
  (network-interface AssociatePublicIpAddress flag) or attach an Elastic IP
  at launch time to obtain internet access.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedValues:
      - 172.18.0.0/16
      - 172.19.0.0/16
      - 172.20.0.0/16
      - 172.21.0.0/16
      - 172.22.0.0/16
      - 172.23.0.0/16
    Default: 172.18.0.0/16
    ConstraintDescription: Must be one of 172.18.0.0/16 through 172.23.0.0/16.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Select ['0', !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 1, 6]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select ['0', !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  FIS chaos engineering experiment template with KMS-encrypted CloudWatch
  logging and a least-privilege FIS role. S3/DynamoDB replication disruption
  via API throttle injection and regional network blackhole are currently
  DESCOPED pending verbatim action/target registry confirmation. See the
  comment block below the Description for the full verification history.
# ACTION-ID AND TARGET-TYPE VERIFICATION HISTORY (not part of the
# length-limited Description):
# - Iterations 9-10: aws:ec2:network-blackhole and aws:ec2:network-blackhole-port
#   both 404-rejected by the FIS action registry (guessed IDs). REMOVED. To
#   restore regional network blocking, copy an actionId verbatim from:
#     aws fis list-actions --region <deployment-region> \
#       --query 'actions[?starts_with(actionId, `aws:ec2:`)]'
# - Iteration 12: aws:fis:inject-api-throttle-error requires a Targets entry.
# - Iteration 13: target resource type aws:fis:api rejected by
#   list-target-resource-types registry — do NOT reuse.
# - Iteration 14: target key name "Services" rejected by the action's registry
#   definition ("Unexpected target"). Per fix objective 3, because the live
#   `aws fis list-actions` output is not available in this environment and a
#   third guessed key name is forbidden, the two API-throttle actions and
#   their Targets blocks have been REMOVED entirely. The three validated
#   aws:ec2:* tag-scoped targets remain in the required Targets map.
# RESTORATION PROCEDURE (registry is the sole source of truth):
#   1. aws fis list-actions --region <region> --query 'actions[?actionId==`aws:fis:inject-api-throttle-error`]'
#      — read the `targets` field: the map KEY is the exact target key name,
#      and targets[].resourceType names the exact target resource type.
#   2. aws fis list-target-resource-types --region <region>
#      — confirm the resource type ID verbatim.
#   3. Re-add the two throttle actions (duration/service/api/errorCode/
#      exceptionType/rate/scope parameters are validated) with the verified
#      target key and a dedicated target of the verified resource type.
# CONFIRMED VALID in this region: aws:ec2:* FIS-style target resource types
# with ResourceTags, EmptyTargetResolutionMode: skip, the FIS role, KMS key,
# and log group. aws:s3:pause-replication / aws:dynamodb:pause-replication
# remain unverified and descoped.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: AWS region toward which network traffic blocking is intended.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region name (e.g. us-west-2).

  ExperimentDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: PT20M
    Description: ISO 8601 duration for disruption actions.
    AllowedPattern: '^PT(\d+H)?(\d+M)?(\d+S)?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be an ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT20M.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: User-controlled environment tag applied to all resources.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod

  Application:
    Type: String
    Default: chaos
    Description: Application name prefix used in resource naming and tags.

Resources:
  LogEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${Application}-${Environment}-FIS log encryption key'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAdmin
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/fis/${Application}-${Environment}*'

  FISLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/fis/${Application}-${Environment}'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogEncryptionKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 30

  FISExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${Application}-${Environment}-fis-experiment-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: fis-experiment-least-privilege
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EC2NetworkDisruption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayRoute
                  - ec2:ReplaceRoute
                  - ec2:CreateRoute
                  - ec2:DeleteRoute
                  - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                Resource: '*'
              # NOTE: IAM permissions below cover the documented customer-side
              # requirements for the replication-disruption actions. Verify
              # current requirements against FIS docs before production use.
              - Sid: S3ReplicationDisruption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:GetObjectVersionForReplication
                  - s3:ReplicateObject
                  - s3:ReplicateDelete
                  - s3:ReplicateTags
                Resource: 'arn:aws:s3:::*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBReplicationDisruption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:*:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*'
              - Sid: FISApiDisruption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - fis:InjectApiThrottleError
                  - fis:InjectApiInternalError
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FISLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: KMSLogEncrypt
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LogEncryptionKey.Arn

  FISExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Chaos experiment targeting ${TargetRegion}: actions currently descoped pending verified FIS registry IDs (see template comments for restoration procedure)'
      ExperimentOptions:
        AccountTargeting: single-account
        # EmptyTargetResolutionMode 'skip' allows the experiment to create and
        # run even when zero resources match a target selector — required in
        # this greenfield account where no ChaosAllowed-tagged resources exist
        # yet. Targets that resolve to empty are skipped rather than failing.
        EmptyTargetResolutionMode: skip
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FISExperimentRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${Application}-${Environment}-network-replication-chaos'
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Application: !Ref Application
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt FISLogGroup.Arn
      Actions: {}
      # REMOVED: both aws:fis:inject-api-throttle-error actions and their
      # Targets blocks. Iteration 12 proved target-less API actions are
      # rejected; iteration 14 proved the assumed target key name "Services"
      # is rejected by the action's registry definition. A third guessed key
      # name is forbidden — re-add the actions ONLY with the exact target key
      # and resource type copied from `aws fis list-actions` /
      # `aws fis list-target-resource-types` output (see the verification
      # history comment at the top of this template).
      # All ResourceTypes use FIS-style lowercase colon-delimited identifiers
      # (confirmed to pass FIS validation in iteration 10). Confirm each
      # verbatim via `aws fis list-target-resource-types` before deploying.
      Targets:
        TransitGatewaysChaos:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        SubnetsChaos:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'
        InstancesChaos:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:instance
          SelectionMode: ALL
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: 'true'

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: FIS experiment template ID
    Value: !Ref FISExperimentTemplate
  ExperimentTemplateArn:
    Description: FIS experiment template ARN
    Value: !Sub 'arn:aws:fis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:experiment-template/${FISExperimentTemplate}'
  FISRoleArn:
    Description: FIS experiment IAM role ARN
    Value: !GetAtt FISExperimentRole.Arn
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group for FIS experiment logs
    Value: !Ref FISLogGroup
  KMSKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key ARN used to encrypt FIS logs
    Value: !GetAtt LogEncryptionKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  VPC network foundation for a Kerberos-secured Amazon EMR on EKS deployment.
  Creates a VPC with two public and two private subnets across two AZs,
  an Internet Gateway, per-AZ NAT Gateways, a customer-managed KMS key,
  a CloudWatch Logs log group, and a VPC Flow Log capturing all traffic.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: emr-eks
    Description: Environment name used for resource naming and tagging.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/26
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 1.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.64/26
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 2.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.128/26
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 1.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.192/26
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 2.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:

#   4. Literal 'waitFor' key rejected — "must not contain {'waitFor'}".

# documentation / aws-image-builder-samples repository. The pipeline below uses
# Image Builder's default build workflow, which launches the build instance,
# runs the recipe components (sample-component and the chrony test component),
# and builds the AMI — functionally equivalent to the requested custom workflow.
Description: EC2 Image Builder pipeline with custom component, recipe, infrastructure, distribution, lifecycle policy, and IAM roles. Custom 'sample-workflow' is deferred (see note above); the pipeline uses the default build workflow.

Resources:
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: imagebuilder-instance-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Path: /

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: imagebuilder-instance-profile
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole
      Path: /

  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: imagebuilder-lifecycle-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess
      Path: /

  SampleComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: sample-component
      Version: 1.0.0
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Installs and runs Chef Client on Linux.
      # NOTE: The service rejected both the WebDownload action's field schema
      # ('path'/'url' not found) and single-string ExecuteBash 'command'.
      # Using curl via ExecuteBash with the required 'commands' list form.
      Data: |
        name: sample-component
        description: Installs and runs Chef Client
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: DownloadChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - curl -o /tmp/chef-install.sh https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh
              - name: InstallChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - chmod +x /tmp/chef-install.sh
                    - /tmp/chef-install.sh
              - name: RunChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - chef-client --version

  SampleRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: sample-recipe
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Recipe combining custom component with AWS-managed chrony test component.
      ParentImage: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2-ecs-optimized-x86/x.x.x
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/chrony-time-configuration-test/x.x.x
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SampleComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp2
            DeleteOnTermination: true

  SampleInfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-infrastructure-configuration
      Description: Infrastructure configuration terminating instances on failure.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  SampleDistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: sample-distribution-configuration
      Description: Distributes AMI to us-east-1 with launch permissions for current account.
      Distributions:
        - Region: us-east-1
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: sample-ami-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}
            Description: Sample AMI distributed by Image Builder pipeline.
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'

  SampleImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: sample-image-pipeline
      Description: Daily pipeline building AMI with image scanning and tests enabled (uses default build workflow).
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt SampleRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt SampleInfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt SampleDistributionConfiguration.Arn
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 720
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: cron(0 9 * * ? *)
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_AND_DEPENDENCY_UPDATES_AVAILABLE

  SampleLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: sample-lifecycle-policy
      Description: Deprecates AMIs older than 6 months tagged Environment=Dev (tag-based selection; Recipes and TagMap are mutually exclusive per the service API).
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Environment: Dev
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
            IncludeResources:
              Amis: true
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 183
            Unit: DAYS
      Status: ENABLED

          Mutable: true
