      HealthCheckPath: /
  ProdAdminTG:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: prod-admin-tg
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
  ProdApiTG:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: prod-api-tg
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
  ProdFeedTG:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: prod-feed-tg
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
  ProdProjectsTG:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: prod-projects-tg
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
  ProdFilesTG:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: prod-files-tg
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /

  # ---------------- Stag target groups (one per endpoint type) ----------------
  StagWwwTG:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: stag-www-tg
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
  StagWpTG:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: stag-wp-tg
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
  StagAdminTG:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: stag-admin-tg
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
  StagApiTG:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: stag-api-tg
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
  StagFilesTG:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: stag-files-tg
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: instance
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /

  # PHASE 1: only port-80 redirect listeners (no certificate dependency).
  # PHASE 2 adds the HTTPS:443 listeners and host-header routing rules once
  # the PHASE 2 certificate (validated against the delegated zone) is ISSUED.
  ProdHTTPListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref ProdALB
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: redirect
          RedirectConfig:
            Protocol: HTTPS
            Port: '443'
            StatusCode: HTTP_301

  StagHTTPListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref StagALB
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: redirect
          RedirectConfig:
            Protocol: HTTPS
            Port: '443'
            StatusCode: HTTP_301

  # ---------------- All DNS records in one RecordSetGroup (single change batch) ----------------
  DNSRecordSetGroup:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSetGroup
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      RecordSets:
        # Single apex TXT consolidating SPF, Microsoft 365 verification, and
        # Google site verification (only one record set allowed per name/type).
        - Name: !Ref DomainName
          Type: TXT
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - '"v=spf1 include:spf.protection.outlook.com include:_spf.google.com ~all"'
            - !Sub '"${MSVerificationCode}"'
            - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerification}"'
        - Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${DomainName}'
          Type: TXT
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:${DmarcRua}"'
        # NOTE: One MX record set cannot serve both O365 and Google Workspace;
        # root MX routes to Office 365, gmail./gsuite. subdomains to Google.
        - Name: !Ref DomainName
          Type: MX
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub '0 ${O365MXTenant}'
        - Name: !Sub 'gmail.${DomainName}'
          Type: MX
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - '1 aspmx.l.google.com'
            - '5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com'
            - '5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com'
            - '10 alt3.aspmx.l.google.com'
            - '10 alt4.aspmx.l.google.com'
        - Name: !Sub 'gsuite.${DomainName}'
          Type: MX
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Sub '1 ${GoogleMXTenant}'
        # CNAMEs (third-party integrations)
        - Name: !Sub 'support.${DomainName}'
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 300
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref ZendeskTarget
        - Name: !Sub 'reply.${DomainName}'
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 300
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref CampaignMonitorReplyTarget
        - Name: !Sub 'email.${DomainName}'
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 300
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref EmailTrackingTarget
        - Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}'
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 300
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref DomainName
        # DKIM CNAMEs
        - Name: !Sub 'selector1._domainkey.${DomainName}'
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref O365DKIM1
        - Name: !Sub 'selector2._domainkey.${DomainName}'
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref O365DKIM2
        - Name: !Sub 'cm1._domainkey.${DomainName}'
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref CampaignMonitorDKIM1
        - Name: !Sub 'cm2._domainkey.${DomainName}'
          Type: CNAME
          TTL: 3600
          ResourceRecords:
            - !Ref CampaignMonitorDKIM2
        # NOTE: CloudFront alias records (apex, prod., stag. -> distribution)
        # are NOT created here. They belong to PHASE 2 because they require the
        # PHASE 2 distribution (ACM custom cert + TLSv1.2_2021) and aliases are
        # invalid against a default-certificate distribution. CloudFrontAliasesPending.
        # ALB aliases (prod-* -> ProdALB, stag-* -> StagALB; PHASE 2 host-header
        # listener rules will route each hostname to the correct target group)
        - Name: !Sub 'prod-www.${DomainName}'
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt ProdALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt ProdALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: !Sub 'prod-www.${DomainName}'
          Type: AAAA
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt ProdALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt ProdALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: !Sub 'stag-www.${DomainName}'
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt StagALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt StagALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: !Sub 'stag-www.${DomainName}'
          Type: AAAA
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt StagALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt StagALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: !Sub 'prod-wp.${DomainName}'
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt ProdALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt ProdALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: !Sub 'stag-wp.${DomainName}'
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt StagALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt StagALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: !Sub 'prod-admin.${DomainName}'
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt ProdALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt ProdALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: !Sub 'stag-admin.${DomainName}'
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt StagALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt StagALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: !Sub 'prod-api.${DomainName}'
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt ProdALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt ProdALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: !Sub 'stag-api.${DomainName}'
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt StagALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt StagALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: !Sub 'prod-feed.${DomainName}'
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt ProdALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt ProdALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: !Sub 'prod-projects.${DomainName}'
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt ProdALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt ProdALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: !Sub 'prod-files.${DomainName}'
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt ProdALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt ProdALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false
        - Name: !Sub 'stag-files.${DomainName}'
          Type: A
          AliasTarget:
            HostedZoneId: !GetAtt StagALB.CanonicalHostedZoneID
            DNSName: !GetAtt StagALB.DNSName
            EvaluateTargetHealth: false

      MX root=O365, gmail./gsuite.=Google; apex TXT consolidates SPF + Microsoft 365 (MS=) + Google

      against the HostedZoneId output + HTTPS listeners + host-header rules + CloudFront
      distribution + custom alias records, referencing this stack's outputs).

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Fully event-driven Security Hub organization onboarding for AWS Control Tower.
  Creates /superwerker/ SSM parameters, SSM automation documents for landing zone
  bootstrap and new-account onboarding, IAM roles for SSM automation and
  EventBridge targets, and EventBridge rules reacting to Control Tower lifecycle
  events. Account IDs are resolved at runtime from Parameter Store.

Resources:

  AuditAccountIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/audit-account-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Description: Account ID of the Security Hub delegated administrator (audit) account.

  LogArchiveAccountIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/log-archive-account-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Description: Account ID of the Control Tower log archive account. Update after deployment with the actual log archive account ID.

  RegionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/region
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Description: Control Tower home region.

  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: security-hub-onboarding-automation-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: security-hub-onboarding-automation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AssumeControlTowerExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
              - Sid: SecurityHubActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableSecurityHub
                  - securityhub:DisableSecurityHub
                  - securityhub:EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:ListOrganizationAdminAccounts
                  - securityhub:CreateMembers
                  - securityhub:DeleteMembers
                  - securityhub:InviteMembers
                  - securityhub:DisassociateMembers
                  - securityhub:GetMembers
                  - securityhub:AcceptInvitation
                  - securityhub:GetMasterAccount
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadSuperwerkerParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/*'

  EventBusTargetRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: security-hub-onboarding-event-target-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: start-automation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${LandingZoneBootstrapDocument}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${NewAccountOnboardingDocument}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService': ssm.amazonaws.com

  LandingZoneBootstrapDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: security-hub-landing-zone-bootstrap
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables Security Hub org-wide bootstrap after Control Tower landing zone setup/update finishes.
        assumeRole: '{{ automationRoleArn }}'
        parameters:
          automationRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: ''
            description: ARN of the SSM automation role (passed by the EventBridge target).
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetAuditAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: /superwerker/audit-account-id
            outputs:
              - Name: Value
                Selector: $.Parameter.Value
          - name: GetLogArchiveAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: /superwerker/log-archive-account-id
            outputs:
              - Name: Value
                Selector: $.Parameter.Value
          - name: EnableSecurityHubInAuditAccount
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(events, context):
                    audit_account_id = events['AuditAccountId']
                    region = events['Region']
                    creds = assume(audit_account_id)
                    sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **creds)
                    sh.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                    sh.enable_organization_admin_account(AdminAccountId=audit_account_id)

                def assume(account_id):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    resp = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution',
                        RoleSessionName='SecurityHubBootstrap'
                    )
                    return {
                        'aws_access_key_id': resp['Credentials']['AccessKeyId'],
                        'aws_secret_access_key': resp['Credentials']['SecretAccessKey'],
                        'aws_session_token': resp['Credentials']['SessionToken'],
                    }
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.Value }}'
                Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          - name: EnableSecurityHubInLogArchiveAccount
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(events, context):
                    audit_account_id = events['AuditAccountId']
                    log_archive_account_id = events['LogArchiveAccountId']
                    region = events['Region']
                    audit_creds = assume(audit_account_id)
                    audit_sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **audit_creds)
                    audit_sh.create_members(AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': log_archive_account_id}])
                    audit_sh.invite_members(AccountIds=[log_archive_account_id])
                    log_creds = assume(log_archive_account_id)
                    log_sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **log_creds)
                    master = audit_sh.get_master_account().get('Master', {})
                    if master.get('InvitationId'):
                        log_sh.accept_invitation(
                            MasterId=master.get('AccountId', audit_account_id),
                            InvitationId=master.get('InvitationId')
                        )

                def assume(account_id):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    resp = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution',
                        RoleSessionName='SecurityHubBootstrap'
                    )
                    return {
                        'aws_access_key_id': resp['Credentials']['AccessKeyId'],
                        'aws_secret_access_key': resp['Credentials']['SecretAccessKey'],
                        'aws_session_token': resp['Credentials']['SessionToken'],
                    }
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.Value }}'
                LogArchiveAccountId: '{{ GetLogArchiveAccountId.Value }}'
                Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  NewAccountOnboardingDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: security-hub-new-account-onboarding
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables Security Hub in newly provisioned Control Tower accounts and associates them with the audit account.
        assumeRole: '{{ automationRoleArn }}'
        parameters:
          automationRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: ''
            description: ARN of the SSM automation role (passed by the EventBridge target).
          newAccountId:
            type: String
            description: Account ID of the newly provisioned account.
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetAuditAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: /superwerker/audit-account-id
            outputs:
              - Name: Value
                Selector: $.Parameter.Value
          - name: OnboardNewAccount
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(events, context):
                    audit_account_id = events['AuditAccountId']
                    new_account_id = events['NewAccountId']
                    region = events['Region']

                    new_creds = assume(new_account_id)
                    new_sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **new_creds)
                    new_sh.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)

                    audit_creds = assume(audit_account_id)
                    audit_sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **audit_creds)
                    audit_sh.create_members(AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': new_account_id}])
                    audit_sh.invite_members(AccountIds=[new_account_id])

                    members = audit_sh.get_members(AccountIds=[new_account_id]).get('Members', [])
                    invitation_id = members[0].get('InvitationId') if members else None
                    if invitation_id:
                        new_sh.accept_invitation(
                            MasterId=audit_account_id,
                            InvitationId=invitation_id
                        )

                def assume(account_id):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    resp = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution',
                        RoleSessionName='SecurityHubOnboarding'
                    )
                    return {
                        'aws_access_key_id': resp['Credentials']['AccessKeyId'],
                        'aws_secret_access_key': resp['Credentials']['SecretAccessKey'],
                        'aws_session_token': resp['Credentials']['SessionToken'],
                    }
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.Value }}'
                NewAccountId: '{{ newAccountId }}'
                Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  CreateManagedAccountRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: security-hub-on-new-managed-account
      Description: Triggers Security Hub onboarding when Control Tower successfully provisions a new managed account.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - Control Tower Lifecycle Event
        detail:
          action:
            - CreateManagedAccount
          event:
            - Succeeded
      Targets:
        - Id: SecurityHubNewAccountOnboarding
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${NewAccountOnboardingDocument}'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBusTargetRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              account: $.detail.accountId
            InputTemplate: !Sub |-
              {
                "DocumentName": "security-hub-new-account-onboarding",
                "automationRoleArn": "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/security-hub-onboarding-automation-role",
                "newAccountId": <account>
              }

  LandingZoneUpdateRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: security-hub-on-landing-zone-update
      Description: Triggers Security Hub bootstrap when Control Tower landing zone setup/update finishes successfully.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - Control Tower Lifecycle Event
        detail:
          action:
            - UpdateLandingZone
          event:
            - Succeeded
      Targets:
        - Id: SecurityHubLandingZoneBootstrap
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${LandingZoneBootstrapDocument}'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBusTargetRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputTemplate: !Sub |-
              {
                "DocumentName": "security-hub-landing-zone-bootstrap",
                "automationRoleArn": "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/security-hub-onboarding-automation-role"
              }

Outputs:
  LandingZoneBootstrapDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the landing zone bootstrap SSM automation document.
    Value: !Ref LandingZoneBootstrapDocument
  NewAccountOnboardingDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the new account onboarding SSM automation document.
    Value: !Ref NewAccountOnboardingDocument
  CreateManagedAccountRuleName:
    Description: EventBridge rule for newly provisioned managed accounts.
    Value: !Ref CreateManagedAccountRule
  LandingZoneUpdateRuleName:
    Description: EventBridge rule for landing zone setup/update completion.
    Value: !Ref LandingZoneUpdateRule
  SSMAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SSM automation execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn

Metadata:
  UncertaintyNotes:
    - >
      Verify the exact Control Tower lifecycle event detail-type string
      ("Control Tower Lifecycle Event") and detail field values
      ("CreateManagedAccount", "UpdateLandingZone", "Succeeded") against current
      AWS Control Tower documentation before deployment; omit or adjust any
      event pattern fields that cannot be confirmed.
    - >
      The /superwerker/audit-account-id and /superwerker/log-archive-account-id
      parameters default to the management account on deployment. After the
      Control Tower audit and log archive accounts are provisioned, update both
      parameter values to the actual account IDs and re-run the bootstrap
      automation.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Shared EKS IAM roles, GuardDuty detector (15-min findings), registry log groups, and condition-gated AWSQS Kubernetes ResourceVersion registrations.

# ============================================================================
# OPERATIONAL GUIDANCE (free-text comments — no length limit here)
#
# MANDATORY DEPLOY-TIME OVERRIDES:
#   - BastionBucketName: override the placeholder default with the real target
#     bucket name via --parameter-overrides. The default is syntactically valid
#     only.
#   - KubernetesResourceHandlerPackage / KubernetesHelmHandlerPackage /
#     EksClusterHandlerPackage: REQUIRED at deploy time for registry
#     registration. Leave the empty defaults and pass the real S3 handler
#     package ARNs via --parameter-overrides. The corresponding ResourceVersion
#     resources are condition-gated, so the stack deploys roles/GuardDuty/log
#     groups cleanly when these inputs are not supplied.
#
# PERMISSIONS BOUNDARY (OPTIONAL — commented out):
#   To enable, uncomment AS ONE ATOMIC CHANGE:
#     1. The PermissionsBoundaryArn Parameter below.
#     2. A Conditions entry: HasPermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, ""]]
#     3. A `PermissionBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn` property in each
#        of the eight role resources.
#   The condition makes the boundary load-bearing only in environments that
#   require it; when absent, the template deploys cleanly.
# ============================================================================

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: "eks"
    Description: Short alias used as the prefix for all IAM role and log group names.
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,20}$"
  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Default: "001"
    Description: Short hash suffix appended to role names to avoid collisions.
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,8}$"
  BastionBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: "replace-me-example-bucket"
    Description: >
      **MUST BE OVERRIDDEN AT DEPLOY TIME** — existing S3 bucket name that scopes the
      bastion role's S3 GetObject access. The default is a syntactically valid
      placeholder only; pass the real bucket name via --parameter-overrides.
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9.-]{1,253}[a-zA-Z0-9]$"
  KubernetesResourceHandlerPackage:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      REQUIRED AT DEPLOY TIME — leave empty default and pass the real S3 handler
      package ARN via --parameter-overrides. Gates the condition-gated
      AWSQS::Kubernetes::Resource ResourceVersion; it cannot register without it.
  KubernetesHelmHandlerPackage:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      REQUIRED AT DEPLOY TIME — leave empty default and pass the real S3 handler
      package ARN via --parameter-overrides. Gates the condition-gated
      AWSQS::Kubernetes::Helm ResourceVersion; it cannot register without it.
  EksClusterHandlerPackage:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      REQUIRED AT DEPLOY TIME — leave empty default and pass the real S3 handler
      package ARN via --parameter-overrides. Gates the condition-gated
      AWSQS::EKS::Cluster ResourceVersion; it cannot register without it.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # OPTIONAL: PermissionsBoundary (commented out). See the OPERATIONAL GUIDANCE
  # comment block above the Parameters section for the full enablement steps.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PermissionsBoundaryArn:
  #   Type: String
  #   Description: ARN of the IAM managed policy to apply as a permissions boundary
  #     to all roles. Only enable in environments that require it.

Conditions:
  HasK8sResourcePackage: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KubernetesResourceHandlerPackage, ""]]
  HasK8sHelmPackage: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KubernetesHelmHandlerPackage, ""]]
  HasEksClusterPackage: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EksClusterHandlerPackage, ""]]

Resources:
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  LogGroupK8sResource:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}/cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource"
      RetentionInDays: 90

  LogGroupK8sHelm:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}/awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs"
      RetentionInDays: 90

  LogGroupEksCluster:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}/cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster"
      RetentionInDays: 90

  LambdaDiscoveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-discovery-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: read-only-resource-discovery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:Describe*
                  - eks:List*
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:List*
                  - cloudformation:Get*
                  - s3:List*
                  - s3:Get*
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - logs:Describe*
                  - logs:Get*
                  - cloudtrail:Describe*
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                Resource: "*"

  LambdaCallerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-caller-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: caller-identity-cfn-cloudtrail
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                Resource: "*"

  EksNodegroupDescribeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-eks-nodegroup-describe-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-nodegroup-describe
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                Resource: "*"

  CfnExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-execution-role"
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cfn-execution-broad
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:*
                  - secretsmanager:*
                  - kms:*
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - ec2:*
                  - lambda:*
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:DeleteLogGroup
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: "*"

  LoggingDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-logging-delivery-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: registry-log-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt LogGroupK8sResource.Arn
                  - !GetAtt LogGroupK8sHelm.Arn
                  - !GetAtt LogGroupEksCluster.Arn
                  - !Sub "${LogGroupK8sResource.Arn}:*"
                  - !Sub "${LogGroupK8sHelm.Arn}:*"
                  - !Sub "${LogGroupEksCluster.Arn}:*"

  CodeBuildEksRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-codebuild-eks-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: codebuild-ecr-s3-eks
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                Resource: "*"

  CfnHookRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-hook-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - hooks.cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cfn-hooks-broad
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                Resource: "*"

  BastionInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-bastion-instance-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: bastion-bucket-and-services
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${BastionBucketName}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:DescribeRepositories
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codebuild:BatchGetProjects
                  - codebuild:ListProjects
                  - codebuild:StartBuild
                  - codebuild:BatchGetBuilds
                  - codebuild:ListBuilds
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codepipeline:GetPipeline
                  - codepipeline:GetPipelineState
                  - codepipeline:ListPipelines
                  - codepipeline:StartPipelineExecution
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  BastionInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-bastion-instance-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref BastionInstanceRole

  ResourceTypeK8sResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::ResourceVersion
    Condition: HasK8sResourcePackage
    Properties:
      TypeName: AWSQS::Kubernetes::Resource
      SchemaHandlerPackage: !Ref KubernetesResourceHandlerPackage
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CfnExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
        LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupK8sResource

  ResourceTypeK8sHelm:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::ResourceVersion
    Condition: HasK8sHelmPackage
    Properties:
      TypeName: AWSQS::Kubernetes::Helm
      SchemaHandlerPackage: !Ref KubernetesHelmHandlerPackage
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CfnExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
        LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupK8sHelm

  ResourceTypeEksCluster:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::ResourceVersion
    Condition: HasEksClusterPackage
    Properties:
      TypeName: AWSQS::EKS::Cluster
      SchemaHandlerPackage: !Ref EksClusterHandlerPackage
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt CfnExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogRoleArn: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
        LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupEksCluster

Outputs:
  GuardDutyDetectorId:
    Description: GuardDuty detector ID for the region.
    Value: !Ref GuardDutyDetector
  LambdaDiscoveryRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda resource discovery role.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaDiscoveryRole.Arn
  LambdaCallerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda caller identity / CloudTrail role.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaCallerRole.Arn
  EksNodegroupDescribeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS node group describe role.
    Value: !GetAtt EksNodegroupDescribeRole.Arn
  CfnExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudFormation execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt CfnExecutionRole.Arn
  LoggingDeliveryRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the registry logging delivery role.
    Value: !GetAtt LoggingDeliveryRole.Arn
  CodeBuildEksRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CodeBuild/EKS integration role.
    Value: !GetAtt CodeBuildEksRole.Arn
  CfnHookRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudFormation hooks role.
    Value: !GetAtt CfnHookRole.Arn
  BastionInstanceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the bastion instance role.
    Value: !GetAtt BastionInstanceRole.Arn
  BastionInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the bastion instance profile.
    Value: !GetAtt BastionInstanceProfile.Arn
  K8sResourceTypeArn:
    Description: Type ARN of the registered AWSQS::Kubernetes::Resource (if registered).
    Value: !If
      - HasK8sResourcePackage
      - !GetAtt ResourceTypeK8sResource.Arn
      - "not-registered"
  K8sHelmTypeArn:
    Description: Type ARN of the registered AWSQS::Kubernetes::Helm (if registered).
    Value: !If
      - HasK8sHelmPackage
      - !GetAtt ResourceTypeK8sHelm.Arn
      - "not-registered"
  EksClusterTypeArn:
    Description: Type ARN of the registered AWSQS::EKS::Cluster (if registered).
    Value: !If
      - HasEksClusterPackage
      - !GetAtt ResourceTypeEksCluster.Arn
      - "not-registered"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained ECS Fargate environment with internal ALB, path-based
  routing, and CPU-based auto scaling. ContainerPort 80 refers to the
  target-side container protocol. The internal ALB serves HTTP on port 80
  with an HTTPS redirect default action; TLS termination is out of scope
  pending caller-controlled DNS for certificate validation.
  IMAGE PULL PATH: the default public-ECR image is pulled through the NAT
  gateway with egress scoped to two prefix lists sourced from AWS's
  published ip-ranges.json (ECR_PUBLIC service ranges for registry API
  access and S3 service ranges for the layer fetch); no 0.0.0.0/0 egress
  exists. PROMOTION PATH: push an image to the created immutable-tag
  AppRepository and redeploy setting ContainerImage to
  '<account>.dkr.ecr.<region>.amazonaws.com/<env>-app:<tag>' (private pulls
  flow through the in-stack ECR interface endpoints).

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Environment name used to derive resource identifiers.
  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/nginx:latest
    Description: >
      Docker image to deploy. Default is a pullable public image; after the
      stack exists, promote to the private ECR repository output below.
  TaskCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues: [256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
    Description: Fargate task CPU units.
  TaskMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    AllowedValues: [512, 1024, 2048, 4096, 8192]
    Description: Fargate task memory (MiB).
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    Description: Container port (target-side protocol).

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.16.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.32.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.48.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref EndpointSecurityGroup]

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref EndpointSecurityGroup]

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds: [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]
      SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref EndpointSecurityGroup]

  S3Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds: [!Ref PrivateRouteTable]

  RegistryPrefixList:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PrefixList
    Properties:
      PrefixListName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ecr-public'
      MaxEntries: 8
      AddressFamily: IPv4
      Entries:
        - Cidr: 3.94.221.112/29
          Description: ECR_PUBLIC service range (ip-ranges.json)
        - Cidr: 3.94.224.32/28
          Description: ECR_PUBLIC service range (ip-ranges.json)
        - Cidr: 18.97.11.128/26
          Description: ECR_PUBLIC service range (ip-ranges.json)
        - Cidr: 34.199.222.128/26
          Description: ECR_PUBLIC service range (ip-ranges.json)
        - Cidr: 44.208.200.192/27
          Description: ECR_PUBLIC service range (ip-ranges.json)
        - Cidr: 52.4.24.176/29
          Description: ECR_PUBLIC service range (ip-ranges.json)
        - Cidr: 98.80.56.0/26
          Description: ECR_PUBLIC service range (ip-ranges.json)
        - Cidr: 98.80.57.0/26
          Description: ECR_PUBLIC service range (ip-ranges.json)
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  S3PrefixList:
    Type: AWS::EC2::PrefixList
    Properties:
      PrefixListName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-s3-public'
      MaxEntries: 6
      AddressFamily: IPv4
      Entries:
        - Cidr: 52.216.0.0/17
          Description: Amazon S3 service range
        - Cidr: 52.216.128.0/17
          Description: Amazon S3 service range
        - Cidr: 52.217.0.0/17
          Description: Amazon S3 service range
        - Cidr: 52.217.128.0/17
          Description: Amazon S3 service range
        - Cidr: 54.231.0.0/17
          Description: Amazon S3 service range
        - Cidr: 54.231.128.0/17
          Description: Amazon S3 service range
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AppRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-app'
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-cluster'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}-service'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ecs-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ecs-autoscaling-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ecs-service-scaling
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:UpdateService
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:service/${EcsCluster}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-task'
      RequiresCompatibilities: [FARGATE]
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: !Ref TaskCpu
      Memory: !Ref TaskMemory
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-container'
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AlbSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-alb-sg'
      GroupDescription: Allows inbound HTTP from within the VPC to the ALB
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TaskSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-task-sg'
      GroupDescription: Allows inbound container port from ALB only; scoped egress for pulls and endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt AlbSecurityGroup.GroupId
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TaskRegistryEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref RegistryPrefixList

  TaskS3Egress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !Ref S3PrefixList

  TaskToEndpointEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref TaskSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt EndpointSecurityGroup.GroupId

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoint-sg'
      GroupDescription: Allows HTTPS from tasks within the VPC to interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !GetAtt TaskSecurityGroup.GroupId
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LoadBalancer:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::LoadBalancer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-alb'
      Scheme: internal
      Type: application
      Subnets: [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]
      SecurityGroups: [!Ref AlbSecurityGroup]
      LoadBalancerAttributes:
        - Key: routing.http.drop_invalid_header_fields.enabled
          Value: 'true'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TargetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::TargetGroup
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tg'
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TargetType: ip
      Protocol: HTTP
      Port: !Ref ContainerPort
      HealthCheckProtocol: HTTP
      HealthCheckPath: /
      HealthyThresholdCount: 2
      UnhealthyThresholdCount: 3
      HealthCheckIntervalSeconds: 15
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  HttpListener:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::Listener
    Properties:
      LoadBalancerArn: !Ref LoadBalancer
      Port: 80
      Protocol: HTTP
      DefaultActions:
        - Type: redirect
          RedirectConfig:
            Protocol: HTTPS
            Port: '443'
            StatusCode: HTTP_301

  ListenerRule:
    Type: AWS::ElasticLoadBalancingV2::ListenerRule
    Properties:
      ListenerArn: !Ref HttpListener
      Priority: 1
      Conditions:
        - Field: path-pattern
          Values: ['/app/*']
      Actions:
        - Type: forward
          TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup

  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: HttpListener
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-service'
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: 2
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      DeploymentController:
        Type: ECS
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 75
        MaximumPercent: 200
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          Subnets: [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]
          SecurityGroups: [!Ref TaskSecurityGroup]
      LoadBalancers:
        - TargetGroupArn: !Ref TargetGroup
          ContainerName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-container'
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${EcsCluster}/${EnvironmentName}-service'
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10
      RoleARN: !GetAtt AutoScalingRole.Arn

  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-scale-out'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: 1

  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-scale-in'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  ScaleOutAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-cpu-high'
      AlarmDescription: Scale out when CPU exceeds 70 percent
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-service'
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      Threshold: 70
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy

  ScaleInAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-cpu-low'
      AlarmDescription: Scale in when CPU falls below 20 percent
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-service'
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      Threshold: 20
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >
  Comprehensive SQS test infrastructure: FIFO queues, DLQs, standard queue,
  KMS encryption, and CloudWatch alarms. All alarms have actions disabled.

Resources:

  SqsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SQS queue encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSqsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  FifoQueueNoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  FifoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  FifoQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  StandardDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  StandardQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  SeparateFifoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-standard-queue-messages-sent
      AlarmDescription: Sum of messages sent on standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName

  FifoWithDlqAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-fifo-with-dlq-sent-anomaly
      AlarmDescription: Anomaly detection band on messages sent for FIFO queue with DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanUpperThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      Metrics:
        - Id: ad1
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)
          Label: MessagesSentExpected
          ReturnData: true
        - Id: m1
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
          ReturnData: true
      TreatMissingData: missing

  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-standard-queue-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 183500
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName

  SeparateFifoDlqSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-separate-fifo-dlq-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on separate FIFO queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 183500
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName

  StandardDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-standard-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: Alert when standard DLQ has visible messages
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 0
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDlq.QueueName

  FifoDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-fifo-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: Alert when FIFO DLQ has visible messages
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 0
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoDlq.QueueName

  StandardQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-standard-queue-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of oldest message on standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 15
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName

  SeparateFifoDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-separate-fifo-dlq-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of oldest message on separate FIFO queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 15
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName

  StandardQueueNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-standard-queue-not-visible
      AlarmDescription: Maximum number of in-flight messages on standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 108000
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName

  SeparateFifoDlqNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-separate-fifo-dlq-not-visible
      AlarmDescription: Maximum number of in-flight messages on separate FIFO queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 18000
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName

  StandardDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-standard-dlq-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of oldest message on standard DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 90
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDlq.QueueName

  SyntheticAlwaysOkAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-synthetic-always-ok
      AlarmDescription: Synthetic alarm that always evaluates to OK
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Metrics:
        - Id: ok1
          Expression: m0 * 0
          Label: AlwaysZero
          ReturnData: true
        - Id: m0
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Sum
          ReturnData: false

  StandardQueueArn:
    Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.Arn

    Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.Arn

    Value: !GetAtt SqsKmsKey.Arn
