final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Private ROSA networking with egress VPC, NAT, and Transit Gateway (PrivateLink-ready).

Parameters:
  RosaVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  AzCount:
    Type: String
    Default: '3'
    AllowedValues: ['1', '3']
  RosaSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/17
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  RosaSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.128.0/18
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  RosaSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.192.0/18
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  EgressVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  EgressPublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.128.0/20
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  EgressPrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/20
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  CreateElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
  EnableFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

Conditions:
  CreateElbRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateElbServiceLinkedRole, 'true']
  FlowLogsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableFlowLogs, 'true']
  TwoExtraSubnets: !Equals [!Ref AzCount, '3']

Resources:
  RosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-vpc}
  EgressVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: egress-vpc}

  RosaSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-private-1}
        - {Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb, Value: '1'}
  RosaSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: TwoExtraSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-private-2}
        - {Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb, Value: '1'}
  RosaSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: TwoExtraSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-private-3}
        - {Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb, Value: '1'}

  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: egress-public}
  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: egress-private}

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
  IgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: IgwAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: egress-nat}

  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
  EgressPublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: IgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  EgressPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable

  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
  EgressPrivateNatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway
  EgressPrivateTgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
  EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-tgw}
  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    DependsOn: IgwAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      SubnetIds: !If
        - TwoExtraSubnets
        - [!Ref RosaSubnet1, !Ref RosaSubnet2, !Ref RosaSubnet3]
        - [!Ref RosaSubnet1]
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-attachment}
  EgressTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    DependsOn: IgwAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: egress-attachment}

  RosaAttachmentAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment
  EgressAttachmentAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    DependsOn: RosaAttachmentAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  TgwRouteToRosa:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    DependsOn: RosaAttachmentAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment
  TgwRouteToEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    DependsOn: EgressAttachmentAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  RosaRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-private-rt}
  RosaDefaultTgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
  RosaSubnet1RtAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable
  RosaSubnet2RtAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: TwoExtraSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable
  RosaSubnet3RtAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: TwoExtraSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable

  ElbServiceLinkedRoleFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateElbRole
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: lambda.amazonaws.com}
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateSlr
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing'
  ElbServiceLinkedRoleFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: CreateElbRole
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt ElbServiceLinkedRoleFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, cfnresponse
          def handler(event, context):
              if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                  try:
                      boto3.client('iam').create_service_linked_role(
                          AWSServiceName='elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com',
                          Description='ELB service-linked role for ROSA')
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, 'slr')
                  except Exception as e:
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'error': str(e)}, 'slr')
              else:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, 'slr')
  ElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: Custom::ELBServiceLinkedRole
    Condition: CreateElbRole
    DependsOn: ElbServiceLinkedRoleFunctionRole
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ElbServiceLinkedRoleFunction.Arn

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: logs.amazonaws.com}
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/vpc-flow-logs-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com}
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  RosaVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'
  EgressVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'

Outputs:
  RosaVpcId:
    Value: !Ref RosaVpc
  EgressVpcId:
    Value: !Ref EgressVpc
  RosaSubnet1Id:
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet1
  RosaSubnet2Id:
    Condition: TwoExtraSubnets
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet2
  RosaSubnet3Id:
    Condition: TwoExtraSubnets
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet3
  EgressPublicSubnetId:
    Value: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
  EgressPrivateSubnetId:
    Value: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
  NatGatewayId:
    Value: !Ref NatGateway
  NatEipAllocationId:
    Value: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  PCI DSS remediation prerequisites and nine SSM Automation documents for
  automated remediation of PCI DSS controls.

Resources:
  CloudTrailKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for CloudTrail log encryption (PCI DSS remediation)
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${AWS::StackName}-cloudtrail-logs*"

  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-cloudtrail-logs"
      RetentionInDays: 1827
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CloudTrailKmsKey.Arn

  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ssm-automation-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  CloudTrailCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-cloudtrail-cw-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource: "*"

  RemediateCloudTrailEncryptionDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-remediate-cloudtrail-encryption"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to remediate
          KMSKeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID/ARN to encrypt the trail
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailEncryptionAndCloudWatch
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              KmsKeyId: '{{ KMSKeyId }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchRole.Arn
            outputs:
              - Name: TrailARN
                Selector: $.TrailARN
                Type: String
          - name: StartLogging
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: StartLogging
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'

  EnableKmsKeyRotationDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-enable-kms-key-rotation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID/ARN to enable rotation on
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: '{{ KeyId }}'

  IntegrateCloudTrailCloudWatchDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-integrate-cloudtrail-cloudwatch"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to integrate
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailCloudWatchIntegration
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchRole.Arn
          - name: StartLogging
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: StartLogging
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'

  UpdateIamPasswordPolicyDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-update-iam-password-policy"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters: {}
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireSymbols: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              HardExpiry: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24

  EnableTrailValidationDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-enable-trail-log-validation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to remediate
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableValidationMultiRegionAndCloudWatch
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchRole.Arn
          - name: StartLogging
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: StartLogging
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'

  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-revoke-default-sg-rules"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the security group to revoke all rules from
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetIngressRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    security_group_id = events['InputPayload']['SecurityGroupId']
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    response = ec2.describe_security_group_rules(
                        Filters=[{'Name': 'group-id', 'Values': [security_group_id]}]
                    )
                    ingress_ip = []
                    ingress_sg = []
                    egress_ip = []
                    egress_sg = []
                    for rule in response['SecurityGroupRules']:
                        permission = {
                            'IpProtocol': rule['IpProtocol'],
                            'FromPort': rule.get('FromPort', -1) if rule['IpProtocol'] != '-1' else -1,
                            'ToPort': rule.get('ToPort', -1) if rule['IpProtocol'] != '-1' else -1,
                            'IpRanges': [{'CidrIp': rule['CidrIpv4']}] if rule['CidrIpv4'] else [],
                            'Ipv6Ranges': [{'CidrIpv6': rule['CidrIpv6']}] if rule['CidrIpv6'] else [],
                            'PrefixListIds': [{'PrefixListId': rule['PrefixListId']}] if rule['PrefixListId'] else []
                        }
                        if 'ReferencedGroupInfo' in rule:
                            if not rule['IsEgress']:
                                ingress_sg.append({
                                    'GroupId': security_group_id,
                                    'SourceSecurityGroupId': rule['ReferencedGroupInfo']['GroupId']
                                })
                            else:
                                egress_sg.append({
                                    'GroupId': security_group_id,
                                    'DestinationSecurityGroupId': rule['ReferencedGroupInfo']['GroupId']
                                })
                        elif not rule['IsEgress']:
                            ingress_ip.append({
                                'GroupId': security_group_id,
                                'IpPermissions': [permission]
                            })
                        else:
                            egress_ip.append({
                                'GroupId': security_group_id,
                                'IpPermissions': [permission]
                            })
                    return {
                        'IngressIpRules': ingress_ip,
                        'IngressSgRules': ingress_sg,
                        'EgressIpRules': egress_ip,
                        'EgressSgRules': egress_sg
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: IngressIpRules
                Selector: $.Payload.IngressIpRules
                Type: StringMap
              - Name: IngressSgRules
                Selector: $.Payload.IngressSgRules
                Type: StringMap
              - Name: EgressIpRules
                Selector: $.Payload.EgressIpRules
                Type: StringMap
              - Name: EgressSgRules
                Selector: $.Payload.EgressSgRules
                Type: StringMap
          - name: RevokeIngressIpRules
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              IpPermissions: '{{ GetIngressRules.IngressIpRules }}'
          - name: RevokeIngressSgRules
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              IpPermissions: '{{ GetIngressRules.IngressSgRules }}'
          - name: RevokeEgressIpRules
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              IpPermissions: '{{ GetIngressRules.EgressIpRules }}'
          - name: RevokeEgressSgRules
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              IpPermissions: '{{ GetIngressRules.EgressSgRules }}'

  DeleteSecurityGroupDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-delete-security-group"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the security group to delete
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'

  ReleaseElasticIpDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-release-elastic-ip"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: Allocation ID of the Elastic IP to release
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseAddress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'

  SanitizeCodeBuildProjectDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sanitize-codebuild-env-vars"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CodeBuild project to sanitize
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetProject
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: codebuild
              Api: BatchGetProjects
              names:
                - '{{ ProjectName }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: Project
                Selector: $.projects[0]
                Type: StringMap
          - name: FilterEnvVars
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                Project: '{{ GetProject.Project }}'
              Script: |-
                def script_handler(events, context):
                    project = events['InputPayload']['Project']
                    env = project.get('environment', {})
                    env_vars = env.get('environmentVariables', []) or []
                    sanitized = [
                        v for v in env_vars
                        if v.get('name') not in ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')
                    ]
                    env['environmentVariables'] = sanitized
                    return {'SanitizedEnvironment': env}
            outputs:
              - Name: SanitizedEnvironment
                Selector: $.Payload.SanitizedEnvironment
                Type: StringMap
          - name: UpdateProject
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: codebuild
              Api: UpdateProject
              name: '{{ ProjectName }}'
              environment: '{{ FilterEnvVars.SanitizedEnvironment }}'

  EnableKmsKeyRotationDocName:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Telemetry monitoring for Claude Desktop (CoWork) usage - log group, dual-schema metric filters, and dashboard. Estimated cost is derived at the dashboard layer via metric math because pricing-metric multiplication is unsupported inside metric filter MetricValue expressions. Default prices (per token) - input 0.000003, output 0.000015, cache read 0.0000003, cache creation 0.00000375.'
Parameters:
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: ClaudeDesktop-CoWork-Telemetry
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch dashboard to create.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Dashboard name may contain only letters, digits, dot, underscore, and hyphen (URL-safe).
  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Region whose metrics the dashboard displays.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region name, e.g. us-east-1.
  PricePerInputToken:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.000003
    Description: Price per input token (USD) used in dashboard cost math.
  PricePerOutputToken:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.000015
    Description: Price per output token (USD) used in dashboard cost math.
  PriceCacheRead:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.0000003
    Description: Price per cache read token (USD) used in dashboard cost math.
  PriceCacheWrite:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.00000375
    Description: Price per cache creation token (USD) used in dashboard cost math.
Resources:
  CoWorkEventsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-events'
      RetentionInDays: 90
  LocalAgentInputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-local-input-tokens'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.usage.input_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.usage.input_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user_id'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.model'
  LocalAgentOutputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-local-output-tokens'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.usage.output_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.usage.output_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user_id'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.model'
  LocalAgentCacheReadTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-local-cache-read'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.usage.cache_read_input_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.usage.cache_read_input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
  LocalAgentCacheCreationTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-local-cache-creation'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
  LocalAgentSessionTurnsFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-local-session-turns'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.user_id = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: SessionTurns
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '1'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user_id'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.model'
  DesktopInputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-desktop-input-tokens'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.message.usage.input_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.message.usage.input_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.message.model'
  DesktopOutputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-desktop-output-tokens'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.message.usage.output_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.message.usage.output_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.message.model'
  DesktopCacheReadTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-desktop-cache-read'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
  DesktopCacheCreationTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-desktop-cache-creation'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
  DesktopSessionTurnsFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-desktop-session-turns'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.user = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: SessionTurns
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '1'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.message.model'
  CoWorkDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "widgets": [
              {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Total Input Tokens",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens"]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 6, "y": 0, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Total Output Tokens",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens"]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 0, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Total Tokens (In + Out)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens"], [".", "OutputTokens"]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 18, "y": 0, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Cache Hit Tokens (Read + Creation)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "CacheReadTokens"], [".", "CacheCreationTokens"]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 4, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Total Estimated Cost ($)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens", {"id": "in", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens", {"id": "out", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheReadTokens", {"id": "cr", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheCreationTokens", {"id": "cc", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             [{"expression": "SUM(in)*${PricePerInputToken}+SUM(out)*${PricePerOutputToken}+SUM(cr)*${PriceCacheRead}+SUM(cc)*${PriceCacheWrite}", "id": "cost", "label": "Estimated Cost ($)", "region": "${MetricsRegion}"}]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 6, "y": 4, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Total Session Turns",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "SessionTurns"]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 4, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Average Cost per Turn ($)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens", {"id": "in2", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens", {"id": "out2", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheReadTokens", {"id": "cr2", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheCreationTokens", {"id": "cc2", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "SessionTurns", {"id": "t", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             [{"expression": "(SUM(in2)*${PricePerInputToken}+SUM(out2)*${PricePerOutputToken}+SUM(cr2)*${PriceCacheRead}+SUM(cc2)*${PriceCacheWrite})/SUM(t)", "id": "avgcost", "label": "Avg $/Turn", "region": "${MetricsRegion}"}]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 18, "y": 4, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "period": 3600,
                 "title": "Active Users (turns > 0)",
                 "metrics": [[{"expression": "SEARCH('{${Namespace},User} SessionTurns SUM>0', 'Sum', 3600)", "id": "au1", "visible": false}],
                             [{"expression": "COUNT(au1)", "id": "au2", "label": "Active Users"}]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
               "properties": {"view": "timeSeries", "stacked": false, "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 3600,
                 "title": "Token Usage Trend (1h)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens", {"id": "tin", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens", {"id": "tout", "visible": false}],
                             [{"expression": "SUM(tin)", "id": "ein", "label": "Input Tokens"}],
                             [{"expression": "SUM(tout)", "id": "eout", "label": "Output Tokens"}]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
               "properties": {"view": "timeSeries", "stacked": false, "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 3600,
                 "title": "Estimated Cost Trend (1h)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens", {"id": "in3", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens", {"id": "out3", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheReadTokens", {"id": "cr3", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheCreationTokens", {"id": "cc3", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             [{"expression": "SUM(in3)*${PricePerInputToken}+SUM(out3)*${PricePerOutputToken}+SUM(cr3)*${PriceCacheRead}+SUM(cc3)*${PriceCacheWrite}", "id": "costtrend", "label": "Estimated Cost ($)", "region": "${MetricsRegion}"}]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 14, "width": 8, "height": 6,
               "properties": {"view": "timeSeries", "stacked": true, "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 3600,
                 "title": "Token Usage by User",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens", {"stat": "Sum"}]],
                 "groupBy": "User"}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 8, "y": 14, "width": 8, "height": 6,
               "properties": {"view": "timeSeries", "stacked": true, "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 3600,
                 "title": "Estimated Cost by User ($)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens", {"id": "uin", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens", {"id": "uout", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheReadTokens", {"id": "ucr", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheCreationTokens", {"id": "ucc", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             [{"expression": "SUM(uin)*${PricePerInputToken}+SUM(uout)*${PricePerOutputToken}+SUM(ucr)*${PriceCacheRead}+SUM(ucc)*${PriceCacheWrite}", "id": "ucost", "label": "Cost by User ($)", "region": "${MetricsRegion}"}]],
                 "groupBy": "User"}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 16, "y": 14, "width": 8, "height": 6,
               "properties": {"view": "timeSeries", "stacked": true, "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 3600,
                 "title": "Session Activity by User",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "SessionTurns", {"stat": "Sum"}]],
                 "groupBy": "User"}},
              {"type": "log", "x": 0, "y": 20, "width": 24, "height": 8,
               "properties": {"view": "table", "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                 "title": "Recent Raw CoWork Events (newest first)",
                 "query": "SOURCE logGroup = '${LogGroupName}' | FIELDS @timestamp, @message | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 100"}}
            ]
          }
        - Namespace: 'ClaudeDesktop/CoWork'
          MetricsRegion: !Ref MetricsRegion
          LogGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-events'
          PricePerInputToken: !Ref PricePerInputToken
          PricePerOutputToken: !Ref PricePerOutputToken
          PriceCacheRead: !Ref PriceCacheRead

    Description: Log group receiving CoWork telemetry events.
    Value: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained CDK bootstrap environment (file assets, container assets, KMS, publishing/deployment roles)

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fds
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]{1,10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Qualifier must be lowercase alphanumeric, up to 10 characters.
    Description: Short identifier to uniquely qualify bootstrap resources.
  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Comma-delimited list of trusted account root ARNs, recorded for cross-account bootstrap federation (e.g. arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root). Granting of cross-account assume-role is applied as a post-bootstrap update.
  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1'
    Description: Bootstrap version tracked in SSM.

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CDK bootstrap key (${Qualifier})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAM
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/cdk-${AWS::StackName}-${Qualifier}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  AssetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  AssetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AssetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AssetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AssetBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowFilePublishingPut
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AssetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AssetBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Sid: AllowDeploymentRead
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AssetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AssetBucket.Arn}/*'

  AssetRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KmsKey: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Expire untagged images",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "untagged",
                  "countType": "sinceImagePushed",
                  "countUnit": "days",
                  "countNumber": 7
                },
                "action": {"type": "expire"}
              }
            ]
          }
      RepositoryPolicyText:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowPullAccountRoot
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage

  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
                - !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FilePublishing
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AssetBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AssetBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
                - !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImagePublishing
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: !GetAtt AssetRepository.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Lookup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - cloudfront:ListDistributions
                Resource: '*'

  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeploymentActions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AssetBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AssetBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/cdk-${Qualifier}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PassRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'

  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
      Description: CDK bootstrap version

Outputs:
  AssetBucketName:
    Value: !Ref AssetBucket
  AssetRepositoryUri:
    Value: !GetAtt AssetRepository.RepositoryUri
  KmsKeyArn:
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
  FilePublishingRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
  ImagePublishingRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePublishingRole.Arn
  LookupRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt LookupRole.Arn
  DeploymentActionRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
  CloudFormationExecutionRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
  BootstrapVersionParameterName:
    Value: !Ref BootstrapVersionParameter
  BootstrapVersionValue:
    Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
  TrustedAccountsConfigured:
    Value: !Ref TrustedAccounts

        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true

        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: NIHGrantsResearchAssistant

        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:

          import json

  StatusCheckFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'nih-template-status-${AWS::StackName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt StatusCheckLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          def handler(event, context):
              return {"statusCode": 200, "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                      "body": json.dumps({"message": "status check handler"})}

  ArtifactListFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'nih-artifact-list-${AWS::StackName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt ArtifactListLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ARTIFACTS_BUCKET: !Ref ArtifactsBucket
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3
          def handler(event, context):
              s3 = boto3.client("s3")
              resp = s3.list_objects_v2(Bucket=os.environ["ARTIFACTS_BUCKET"])
              keys = [o["Key"] for o in resp.get("Contents", [])]
              return {"statusCode": 200, "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                      "body": json.dumps({"artifacts": keys})}

  # ---------- KMS + SQS ----------

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for NIH template generation SQS queues
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAM
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAPIGatewayGenerateDataKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSQSManagedKeys
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/nih-grants-sqs-key-${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  TemplateGenDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub 'nih-template-generation-dlq-${AWS::StackName}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false

  TemplateGenDLQPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref TemplateGenDLQ
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: sqs:*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
            Resource: !GetAtt TemplateGenDLQ.Arn

  TemplateGenQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub 'nih-template-generation-queue-${AWS::StackName}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: false
      VisibilityTimeout: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt TemplateGenDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  TemplateGenQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues:
        - !Ref TemplateGenQueue
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: sqs:*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
            Resource: !GetAtt TemplateGenQueue.Arn

  ApiGatewaySqsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - PolicyName: SqsSendMessage

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Elastic Beanstalk Blue-Green template. Creates (or reuses) an application,
  deploys a sample application version, and creates the blue environment.
  A green environment can be enabled for traffic swapping, then terminated
  after routing traffic back to blue. The platform ARN is resolved at deploy
  time by an in-template Lambda custom resource, and all networking and
  instance-profile dependencies are created in-template (greenfield-safe).
  NOTE: on failure, capture 'aws cloudformation describe-stack-events' and
  'aws elasticbeanstalk describe-events' BEFORE rollback deletes evidence.

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyApp
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-_]{0,99}$'
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application (new or existing).
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyApp-env
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,48}$'
    Description: Name of the blue Elastic Beanstalk environment.
  CreateGreenEnvironment:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a temporary green environment clone for traffic routing.

Conditions:
  CreateApplication: !Equals
    - !Ref ApplicationName
    - MyApp
  CreateGreen: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateGreenEnvironment
    - 'true'

Resources:
  Application:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    Condition: CreateApplication
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Blue-Green Elastic Beanstalk application

  ApplicationVersion:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - CreateApplication
        - !Ref Application
        - !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Sample application version
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !Sub 'elasticbeanstalk-samples-${AWS::Region}'
        S3Key: python-sample.zip

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-a'

  PublicSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-b'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetARouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetBRouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Beanstalk instance security group
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  EC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWebTier

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2Role

  PlatformResolverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ListPlatformVersions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: elasticbeanstalk:ListPlatformVersions
                Resource: '*'

  PlatformResolverFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt PlatformResolverRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          BRANCH_CANDIDATES = [
              'Python 3.13 running on 64bit Amazon Linux 2023',
              'Python 3.12 running on 64bit Amazon Linux 2023',
              'Python 3.11 running on 64bit Amazon Linux 2023',
          ]

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                      return
                  eb = boto3.client('elasticbeanstalk')
                  arn = None
                  for branch in BRANCH_CANDIDATES:
                      resp = eb.list_platform_versions(
                          Filters=[
                              {'Attribute': 'PlatformBranchName', 'Operation': '=', 'Values': [branch]},
                              {'Attribute': 'PlatformStatus', 'Operation': '=', 'Values': ['Ready']},
                          ],
                          MaxRecords=1,
                      )
                      platforms = resp.get('PlatformSummaryList', [])
                      if platforms:
                          detail = eb.describe_platform_version(
                              PlatformArn=platforms[0]['PlatformArn']
                          )
                          arn = detail['PlatformDescription']['PlatformArn']
                          break
                  if not arn:
                      raise RuntimeError('No Ready AL2023 Python platform found in region')
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'PlatformArn': arn})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Message': str(e)})

  PlatformResolver:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt PlatformResolverFunction.Arn

  BlueEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - CreateApplication
        - !Ref Application
        - !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Ref EnvironmentName
      PlatformArn: !GetAtt PlatformResolver.PlatformArn
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: SingleInstance
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Ref PublicSubnetA
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: AssociatePublicIpAddress
          Value: 'true'
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: SecurityGroups
          Value: !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile

  GreenEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: CreateGreen
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - CreateApplication
        - !Ref Application
        - !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-green'
      PlatformArn: !GetAtt PlatformResolver.PlatformArn
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: SingleInstance
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Ref PublicSubnetA
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: AssociatePublicIpAddress
          Value: 'true'
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: SecurityGroups
          Value: !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile

Outputs:
  BlueEnvironmentURL:
    Description: URL of the blue environment
    Value: !GetAtt BlueEnvironment.EndpointURL
  GreenEnvironmentURL:
    Condition: CreateGreen
    Description: URL of the temporary green environment (use eb swap / CNAME swap to route traffic, then delete this stack resource)
    Value: !GetAtt GreenEnvironment.EndpointURL
  ApplicationNameOut:
    Description: Elastic Beanstalk application name
    Value: !If
      - CreateApplication
      - !Ref Application
      - !Ref ApplicationName
  ResolvedPlatformArn:
    Description: Platform ARN resolved at deploy time and applied to both environments
    Value: !GetAtt PlatformResolver.PlatformArn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained AWS Service Catalog environment for an ML workshop with two
  portfolios (admin lead and end users), seven products, per-product launch
  constraint roles, and end-user roles with least-privilege access.
  Product templates are seeded into an in-stack, privately encrypted S3
  bucket fronted by a WAF-protected CloudFront distribution with an Origin
  Access Control, so LoadTemplateFromURL resolves over HTTPS only without
  exposing the bucket publicly.

Parameters:
  RootS3Url:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Root S3 URL where the nested CloudFormation product templates are stored.
      If left at the default, an in-stack bucket seeded with valid product
      templates is used instead.
    Default: USE_IN_STACK_BUCKET
    AllowedPattern: ^(https://.*|USE_IN_STACK_BUCKET)$
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment prefix used for resource naming and tagging.
    Default: user-1
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$

Conditions:
  UseInStackBucket: !Equals [!Ref RootS3Url, 'USE_IN_STACK_BUCKET']

Resources:

  ############################################################################
  # KMS key, private template bucket, CloudFront + WAF fronting
  ############################################################################
  TemplateBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key encrypting the ML workshop Service Catalog template bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SeederAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-template-seeder'
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  TemplateBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-workshop-sc-templates-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt TemplateBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  TemplateOriginAccessControl:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessControl
    Properties:
      OriginAccessControlConfig:
        Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-template-oac'
        OriginAccessControlOriginType: s3
        SigningBehavior: always
        SigningProtocol: sigv4

  TemplateWebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-template-webacl'
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      Description: WAF for the ML workshop Service Catalog template distribution
      Rules:
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 0
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-CommonRuleSetMetric'
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
      VisibilityConfig:
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-TemplateWebACLMetric'
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true

  TemplateBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TemplateBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CloudFrontOACRead
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudfront.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${TemplateBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudfront::${AWS::AccountId}:distribution/${TemplateDistribution}'

  TemplateDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} ML workshop Service Catalog template distribution'
        DefaultRootObject: ''
        WebACLId: !GetAtt TemplateWebACL.Arn
        Origins:
          - Id: template-bucket-origin
            DomainName: !GetAtt TemplateBucket.RegionalDomainName
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: ''
            OriginAccessControlId: !GetAtt TemplateOriginAccessControl.Id
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: template-bucket-origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: https-only
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true

  TemplateSeedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-template-seeder'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: seed-templates
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject

              - Effect: Allow

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-template-seeder'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt TemplateSeedRole.Arn
      Environment:

          import os

          Parameters:

              DeletionPolicy: Retain
              UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
              Properties:
