AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Environment VPC with IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack support for staging or production.
  Three public subnets, two private subnets, IGW, egress-only IGW, optional NAT
  Gateway, two network ACLs, placement group, and DHCP options set.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Target environment (staging or production)
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging
  DeployNat:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether to deploy a NAT Gateway with Elastic IP for the private subnets
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"

Conditions:
  ShouldDeployNat: !Equals [!Ref DeployNat, "true"]

Mappings:
  EnvironmentCidrs:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: 10.100.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.100.0.0/24
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.100.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.100.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.100.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.100.11.0/24
      DomainName: staging.internal
    production:
      VpcCidr: 10.200.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.200.0.0/24
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.200.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.200.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.200.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.200.11.0/24
      DomainName: production.internal

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VPCIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  DhcpOptions:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, DomainName]
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dhcp-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DhcpOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DhcpOptions
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet3Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-3-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: compute

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: data

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: ShouldDeployNat
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: ShouldDeployNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: ShouldDeployNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-nacl-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-nacl-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicAclInboundHttpIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicAclInboundHttpIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101

      RuleAction: allow

      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained serverless Movies API (Lambda + DynamoDB + API Gateway REST API with CORS)

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Stage name for the API Gateway deployment.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$'

Resources:

  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'Movies-${EnvironmentName}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      DeletionProtectionEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        Enabled: true
        AttributeName: expiresAt
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCrudPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'dynamodb:GetItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:PutItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:UpdateItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:DeleteItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:Query'
                  - 'dynamodb:Scan'
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateApiGatewayLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: WriteApiGatewayLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/*:log-stream:*'

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  ApiAccessLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/movies-api-${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api

  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/movies-create-${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api

  ReadMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/movies-read-${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api

  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/movies-update-${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api

  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/movies-delete-${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api

  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CreateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'movies-create-${EnvironmentName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return _response(400, {'message': 'Invalid JSON body'})
              if 'title' not in body:
                  return _response(400, {'message': 'Missing required attribute: title'})
              table.put_item(Item=body)
              return _response(201, {'message': 'Movie created', 'movie': body})

          def _response(status, payload):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'

                  'body': json.dumps(payload)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SageMaker Studio MLOps engineer user profile with scoped execution roles and optional self-contained domain.

Parameters:
  ExistingDomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional existing SageMaker Studio domain ID. Leave empty to create a new domain.
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional security group IDs associated with the existing domain.
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional subnet IDs associated with the existing domain.

Conditions:
  CreateNewDomain: !Equals [!Ref ExistingDomainId, '']
  UseExistingDomain: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExistingDomainId, '']]
  UsingProvidedSGs: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref SecurityGroupIds], '']]
  UsingProvidedSubnets: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref SubnetIds], '']]

Resources:
  MLOpsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'sagemaker-mlops-execution-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLOpsPipelineMonitoringGovernance
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PipelinesReadOnlyAndExecutions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineDefinitionForExecution
                  - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelines
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
                  - sagemaker:ListPipelineParametersForExecution
                  - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
                  - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:DeletePipeline
                  - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
                  - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: MonitoringSchedulesAndProcessing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
                  - sagemaker:ListMonitoringExecutions
                  - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ModelsAndModelRegistry
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ExperimentsTrialsLineageReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:Search
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
                  - sagemaker:QueryLineage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: TrainingTransformTuningJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                Resource: '*'

                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint

                  - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint

                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
                  - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs

                  - iam:PassRole

        Statement:

              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain

    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Condition: UsingProvidedSubnets
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/sagemaker-studio/${AWS::StackName}/existing-domain-subnets'
      Type: StringList
      Value: !Join [',', !Ref SubnetIds]
      Description: Subnet IDs supplied for use with the existing SageMaker Studio domain (traceability record only).

  MLOpsUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If
        - UseExistingDomain
        - !Ref ExistingDomainId
        - !Ref SageMakerDomain
      UserProfileName: mlops-engineer
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt PerUserExecutionRole.Arn

    Value: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn
  PerUserExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the per-user SageMaker execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt PerUserExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudWatch monitoring for cross-language database encryption SDK performance
  benchmarks. Creates a CloudWatch Logs log group that receives structured JSON
  benchmark result events, plus 40 CloudWatch Logs metric filters (eight per
  language: Java, .NET/DotNet, Python, Go, Rust) that publish memory efficiency,
  peak memory, throughput latency, and concurrency latency metrics into
  per-language CloudWatch namespaces with a Language dimension.

Parameters:
  BenchmarkLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives structured JSON
      benchmark result events.
    Default: /benchmarks/encryption-sdk/performance
    AllowedPattern: '^[\.\/#A-Za-z0-9\-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Log group name may only contain letters, digits, underscores, hyphens,
      slashes, dots, and the '#' character.

Mappings:
  Languages:
    Java:
      MetricNamespace: EncryptionBenchmarks/Java
    DotNet:
      MetricNamespace: EncryptionBenchmarks/DotNet
    Python:
      MetricNamespace: EncryptionBenchmarks/Python
    Go:
      MetricNamespace: EncryptionBenchmarks/Go
    Rust:
      MetricNamespace: EncryptionBenchmarks/Rust

Resources:
  BenchmarkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 30

  JavaMemoryEfficiencyRatioFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-java-memory-efficiency-ratio'
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.language = "Java" && $.test_type = "memory" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: MemoryEfficiencyRatio
          MetricNamespace: !FindInMap [Languages, Java, MetricNamespace]
          MetricValue: '$.memory_efficiency_ratio'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: '$.language'

  JavaPeakMemoryFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-java-peak-memory-mb'
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.language = "Java" && $.test_type = "memory" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: PeakMemoryMB
          MetricNamespace: !FindInMap [Languages, Java, MetricNamespace]
          MetricValue: '$.peak_memory_mb'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: '$.language'

  JavaThroughputLatencyP50Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-java-throughput-latency-p50'
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.language = "Java" && $.test_type = "throughput" && $.data_size = "1MB" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: ThroughputLatencyP50
          MetricNamespace: !FindInMap [Languages, Java, MetricNamespace]
          MetricValue: '$.latency_p50'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: '$.language'

  JavaThroughputLatencyP95Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-java-throughput-latency-p95'
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.language = "Java" && $.test_type = "throughput" && $.data_size = "1MB" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: ThroughputLatencyP95
          MetricNamespace: !FindInMap [Languages, Java, MetricNamespace]
          MetricValue: '$.latency_p95'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: '$.language'

  JavaThroughputLatencyP99Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-java-throughput-latency-p99'
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.language = "Java" && $.test_type = "throughput" && $.data_size = "1MB" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: ThroughputLatencyP99
          MetricNamespace: !FindInMap [Languages, Java, MetricNamespace]
          MetricValue: '$.latency_p99'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: '$.language'

  JavaConcurrencyLatencyP50Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-java-concurrency-latency-p50'
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.language = "Java" && $.test_type = "concurrency" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: ConcurrencyLatencyP50
          MetricNamespace: !FindInMap [Languages, Java, MetricNamespace]
          MetricValue: '$.latency_p50'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: '$.language'

  JavaConcurrencyLatencyP95Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-java-concurrency-latency-p95'
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.language = "Java" && $.test_type = "concurrency" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: ConcurrencyLatencyP95
          MetricNamespace: !FindInMap [Languages, Java, MetricNamespace]
          MetricValue: '$.latency_p95'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: '$.language'

  JavaConcurrencyLatencyP99Filter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-java-concurrency-latency-p99'
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.language = "Java" && $.test_type = "concurrency" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: ConcurrencyLatencyP99
          MetricNamespace: !FindInMap [Languages, Java, MetricNamespace]
          MetricValue: '$.latency_p99'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: '$.language'

  DotNetMemoryEfficiencyRatioFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-dotnet-memory-efficiency-ratio'
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.language = "DotNet" && $.test_type = "memory" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: MemoryEfficiencyRatio
          MetricNamespace: !FindInMap [Languages, DotNet, MetricNamespace]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL Todo API with JS pipeline resolvers and DynamoDB

Resources:
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: TodoTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: owner-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${TodoTable}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${TodoTable}/index/*'

  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: TodoAPIwithJs
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  GraphQLApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Description: Default API Key

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
          subscription: Subscription
        }

        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          title: String
          content: String
          owner: String
          version: Int
          createdAt: AWSDateTime
          updatedAt: AWSDateTime
        }

        input CreateTodoInput {
          title: String!
          content: String
          owner: String
        }

        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          title: String
          content: String
          owner: String
          version: Int
        }

        input DeleteTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          version: Int
        }

        input TodoFilterInput {
          id: IDFilterInput
          title: StringFilterInput
          content: StringFilterInput
          owner: StringFilterInput
        }

        input IDFilterInput {
          ne: ID
          eq: ID
          le: ID
          lt: ID
          ge: ID
          gt: ID
          contains: ID
          notContains: ID
          beginsWith: ID
          in: [ID]
          notIn: [ID]
        }

        input StringFilterInput {
          ne: String
          eq: String
          le: String
          lt: String
          ge: String
          gt: String
          contains: String
          notContains: String
          beginsWith: String
          in: [String]
          notIn: [String]
        }

        enum SortDirection {
          ASC
          DESC
        }

        type TodoConnection {
          items: [Todo]
          nextToken: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos(filter: TodoFilterInput, limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
          queryTodosByOwner(owner: String!, sortDirection: SortDirection, filter: TodoFilterInput, limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
        }

        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(input: DeleteTodoInput!): Todo
        }

        type Subscription {
          onCreateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createTodo"])
          onUpdateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateTodo"])
          onDeleteTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["deleteTodo"])
        }

  TodoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: TodoDs
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref TodoTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  CreateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: [GraphQLSchema, TodoDataSource]
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: CreateTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDs
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { args } = ctx;
          const id = util.autoId();
          const createdAt = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const values = {
            title: args.input.title,
            content: args.input.content,
            owner: args.input.owner,
            version: 1,
            createdAt: createdAt,
            updatedAt: createdAt,
          };
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: id }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(values),
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  UpdateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: [GraphQLSchema, TodoDataSource]
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: UpdateTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDs
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const input = ctx.args.input;
          const id = input.id;
          const updatedAt = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const names = {};
          const vals = {};
          const sets = [];
          const fields = ['title', 'content', 'owner'];
          let i = 0;
          for (const k of fields) {
            if (input[k] !== undefined) {
              names['#k' + i] = k;
              vals[':v' + i] = input[k];
              sets.push('#k' + i + ' = :v' + i);
              i = i + 1;
            }
          }
          names['#u'] = 'updatedAt';
          vals[':u'] = updatedAt;
          sets.push('#u = :u');
          return {
            operation: 'UpdateItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: id }),
            update: {
              expression: 'SET ' + sets.join(', '),
              expressionNames: names,
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(vals),
            },
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  DeleteTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: [GraphQLSchema, TodoDataSource]
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: DeleteTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDs
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'DeleteItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.args.input.id }),
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  GetTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: [GraphQLSchema, TodoDataSource]
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: GetTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDs
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'GetItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.args.id }),
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  ListTodosFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: [GraphQLSchema, TodoDataSource]
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: ListTodosFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDs
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const req = {
            operation: 'Scan',
          };
          if (ctx.args.limit !== undefined) {
            req.limit = ctx.args.limit;
          }
          if (ctx.args.nextToken !== undefined) {
            req.nextToken = ctx.args.nextToken;
          }
          if (ctx.args.filter !== undefined) {
            req.filter = util.transform.toDynamoDBFilterExpression(ctx.args.filter);
          }
          return req;
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return { items: ctx.result.items, nextToken: ctx.result.nextToken };
        }

  QueryTodosByOwnerFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: [GraphQLSchema, TodoDataSource]
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: QueryTodosByOwnerFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDs
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const req = {
            operation: 'Query',
            index: 'owner-index',
            query: {
              expression: '#owner = :owner',
              expressionNames: { '#owner': 'owner' },
              expressionValues: { ':owner': util.dynamodb.toDynamoDB(ctx.args.owner) },
            },
            scanIndexForward: ctx.args.sortDirection !== 'DESC',
          };
          if (ctx.args.limit !== undefined) {
            req.limit = ctx.args.limit;
          }
          if (ctx.args.nextToken !== undefined) {
            req.nextToken = ctx.args.nextToken;
          }
          if (ctx.args.filter !== undefined) {
            req.filter = util.transform.toDynamoDBFilterExpression(ctx.args.filter);
          }
          return req;
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return { items: ctx.result.items, nextToken: ctx.result.nextToken };
        }

  CreateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: createTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !Ref CreateTodoFunction

  UpdateTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: updateTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !Ref UpdateTodoFunction

  DeleteTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: deleteTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !Ref DeleteTodoFunction

  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      Kind: PIPELINE
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !Ref GetTodoFunction

  ListTodosResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: listTodos
      Kind: PIPELINE
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !Ref ListTodosFunction

  QueryTodosByOwnerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: queryTodosByOwner
      Kind: PIPELINE
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !Ref QueryTodosByOwnerFunction

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
  GraphQLEndpointUrl:
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  ApiKeyArn:
    Value: !Ref GraphQLApiKey
  TodoTableName:
    Value: !Ref TodoTable

Description: >
  Data Master project - self-contained IAM role set for data pipeline (ingestion through analytics).
  IMPORTANT: Both parameters carry PLACEHOLDER defaults required by validation tooling. They MUST be

  - TargetAccountId: the 12-digit target AWS account ID for STS AssumeRole scoping.
    Default placeholder: 000000000000
  Failure to override the defaults will create roles whose KMS and DMS statements reference
  non-existent resources (the 000000000000 account/key does not exist).

Parameters:

    Type: String
    Description: ARN of existing KMS key used for raw data encryption. PLACEHOLDER default must be overridden at deploy time.
    Default: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:000000000000:key/replace-me-at-deploy-time
    AllowedPattern: "^arn:aws:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:key/.+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid KMS key ARN
  TargetAccountId:

    Description: Target AWS Account ID used to scope STS AssumeRole trust policies. PLACEHOLDER default must be overridden at deploy time.
    Default: "000000000000"
    AllowedPattern: "^[0-9]{12}$"

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Required Deploy-Time Inputs (placeholders MUST be overridden)

          - KmsKeyArn

      KmsKeyArn:
        default: "Existing KMS key ARN for raw data encryption (placeholder default; override at deploy time)"
      TargetAccountId:
        default: "Target AWS account ID for STS AssumeRole scoping (placeholder default; override at deploy time)"

Resources:

  DmsKinesisRole:

                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${TargetAccountId}:role/dms-vpc-role-*"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Cross-region failover health monitoring for the existing Remittance API Gateway API,
  the existing GetRemittances and CreateRemittance Lambda functions, and the existing
  dbcluster1-instance1 RDS instance. This template creates ONLY AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
  and AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm resources and references the pre-existing
  monitored resources strictly via metric dimension NAME strings (ApiName,
  FunctionName, DBInstanceIdentifier).

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway metric alarms (existing API referenced via ApiName: Remittance)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RemittanceApi4XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: remittance-api-4xx-errors
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Remittance API Gateway health: average 4XXError count above 0 over a
        300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RemittanceApi5XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: remittance-api-5xx-errors
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Remittance API Gateway health: average 5XXError count above 1 over a
        60 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RemittanceApiLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: remittance-api-latency
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Remittance API Gateway health: average Latency at or above 10000
        milliseconds over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda metric alarms (existing functions referenced via FunctionName)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: getremittances-errors
      AlarmDescription: >-
        GetRemittances Lambda health: summed Errors above 0 over a 60 second
        period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: GetRemittances
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: getremittances-invocations
      AlarmDescription: >-
        GetRemittances Lambda health: summed Invocations above 2 over a 60
        second period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: GetRemittances
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: getremittances-duration
      AlarmDescription: >-
        GetRemittances Lambda health: average Duration at or above 10000
        milliseconds over a 900 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: GetRemittances
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: createremittance-errors
      AlarmDescription: >-
        CreateRemittance Lambda health: summed Errors above 0 over a 60 second
        period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: CreateRemittance
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: createremittance-invocations
      AlarmDescription: >-
        CreateRemittance Lambda health: summed Invocations above 2 over a 60
        second period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: CreateRemittance
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: createremittance-duration
      AlarmDescription: >-
        CreateRemittance Lambda health: average Duration at or above 10000
        milliseconds over a 900 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: CreateRemittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RDS metric alarms (existing instance referenced via DBInstanceIdentifier)
  # TreatMissingData intentionally left unset so the CloudWatch default (missing)
  # applies.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: dbcluster1-instance1-cpu-utilization
      AlarmDescription: >-
        dbcluster1-instance1 RDS health: average CPUUtilization at or above 70
        percent over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: dbcluster1-instance1-database-connections
      AlarmDescription: >-
        dbcluster1-instance1 RDS health: average DatabaseConnections at or
        above 100 over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: dbcluster1-instance1-deadlocks
      AlarmDescription: >-
        dbcluster1-instance1 RDS health: average Deadlocks at or above 10 over
        a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: dbcluster1-instance1-network-transmit-throughput
      AlarmDescription: >-
        dbcluster1-instance1 RDS health: average NetworkTransmitThroughput at
        or above 10485760 bytes over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: dbcluster1-instance1-network-receive-throughput
      AlarmDescription: >-
        dbcluster1-instance1 RDS health: average NetworkReceiveThroughput at
        or above 10485760 bytes over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: dbcluster1-instance1-queries
      AlarmDescription: >-
        dbcluster1-instance1 RDS health: average Queries at or above 100 over a
        300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: dbcluster1-instance1-disk-queue-depth
      AlarmDescription: >-
        dbcluster1-instance1 RDS health: average DiskQueueDepth at or above 50
        over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: dbcluster1-instance1-read-latency
      AlarmDescription: >-
        dbcluster1-instance1 RDS health: average ReadLatency at or above 0.1
        seconds over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: dbcluster1-instance1-write-latency
      AlarmDescription: >-
        dbcluster1-instance1 RDS health: average WriteLatency at or above 0.1
        seconds over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Composite alarms (OR aggregation of the underlying metric alarms)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Health
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Composite health of the existing Remittance API Gateway API. Trips when
        any of the 4XX error, 5XX error, or latency metric alarms is in ALARM
        state.
      AlarmRule: !Sub >-
        ALARM("${RemittanceApi4XXErrorAlarm.Arn}")
        OR ALARM("${RemittanceApi5XXErrorAlarm.Arn}")
        OR ALARM("${RemittanceApiLatencyAlarm.Arn}")
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Lambda Health
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Composite health of the existing GetRemittances and CreateRemittance
        Lambda functions. Trips when any of the errors or duration metric
        alarms is in ALARM state.
      AlarmRule: !Sub >-
        ALARM("${GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm.Arn}")
        OR ALARM("${CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm.Arn}")
        OR ALARM("${GetRemittancesDurationAlarm.Arn}")
        OR ALARM("${CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm.Arn}")
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RdsHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Health
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Composite health of the existing dbcluster1-instance1 RDS instance.
        Trips when any of the CPU utilization, database connections, deadlocks,
        network throughput, queries, disk queue depth, or read/write latency
        metric alarms is in ALARM state.
      AlarmRule: !Sub >-
        ALARM("${RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm.Arn}")
        OR ALARM("${RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm.Arn}")
        OR ALARM("${RdsDeadlocksAlarm.Arn}")
        OR ALARM("${RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm.Arn}")
        OR ALARM("${RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm.Arn}")
        OR ALARM("${RdsQueriesAlarm.Arn}")
        OR ALARM("${RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm.Arn}")
        OR ALARM("${RdsReadLatencyAlarm.Arn}")
        OR ALARM("${RdsWriteLatencyAlarm.Arn}")
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: QuickSight admin suite monitoring pipeline - Glue jobs, metric streams, Firehose delivery streams, and S3 output bucket.
Metadata:
  ScriptBucketNote: The ScriptBucketName parameter references a PREDEFINED external S3 bucket containing Glue scripts. If the script bucket must be created in this template instead, add an AWS::S3::Bucket resource and replace the ScriptBucketName parameter references with !Ref of that resource.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the PREDEFINED S3 bucket containing Glue scripts (must already exist).
    Default: my-predefined-script-bucket
  ScriptPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: scripts/admin-suite/

Resources:
  OutputBucketKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Enabled: true
      Description: Customer managed key for the QuickSight admin suite monitoring output bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  OutputBucketKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !GetAtt OutputBucketKmsKey.Arn

  OutputBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OutputBucketKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  OutputBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref OutputBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: SharedRoleAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt MonitoringPipelineRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Sid: FirehoseAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt FirehoseDeliveryRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  MonitoringPipelineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'admin-suite-monitoring-role-${AWS::AccountId}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightReadAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboard
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:DescribeFolder
                  - quicksight:DescribeFolderResolvedPermissions
                  - quicksight:DescribeTopic
                  - quicksight:DescribeTopicPermissions
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboardPermissions
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSetPermissions
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSourcePermissions
                  - quicksight:ListDashboards
                  - quicksight:ListDataSets
                  - quicksight:ListDataSources
                  - quicksight:ListFolders
                  - quicksight:ListFolderMembers
                  - quicksight:ListTopics
                  - quicksight:ListAnalyses
                  - quicksight:DescribeAnalysis
                  - quicksight:ListDashboardVersions
                  - quicksight:SearchDashboards
                  - quicksight:SearchDataSets
                  - quicksight:SearchDataSources
                  - quicksight:SearchFolders
                  - quicksight:SearchTopics
                  - quicksight:ListUsers
                  - quicksight:ListGroupMemberships
                  - quicksight:ListGroups
                  - quicksight:ListIngestions
                  - quicksight:DescribeIngestion
                  - quicksight:GetDashboardEmbedUrl
                  - quicksight:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: GlueOperations
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:GetJob
                  - glue:GetJobs
                  - glue:StartTrigger
                  - glue:GetTrigger
                  - glue:GetTriggers
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: S3OutputAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt OutputBucketKmsKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/*'
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetricStreams
                  - cloudwatch:StartMetricStreams
                  - cloudwatch:StopMetricStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: FirehoseAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:ListDeliveryStreams
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/qs-admin-suite-*'
        - PolicyName: IamAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                Resource: '*'

  PassRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: admin-suite-passrole-policy
      Roles:
        - !Ref MonitoringPipelineRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: !GetAtt FirehoseDeliveryRole.Arn

  FirehoseDeliveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'admin-suite-firehose-role-${AWS::AccountId}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FirehoseS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObjectAcl
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt OutputBucketKmsKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                Resource: '*'

  JobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Role: !GetAtt MonitoringPipelineRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}assets_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--enable-metrics': ''

  JobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt MonitoringPipelineRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}assets_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket

      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--enable-metrics': ''

  JobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:

      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}q_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  JobQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access

      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

      Command:

        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}q_access.py'

  JobDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job

      DefaultArguments:
        '--aws_region': !Ref 'AWS::Region'
        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--enable-metrics': ''

  JobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties

        '--account_id': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        '--output_bucket': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--enable-metrics': ''

  TriggerAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_assets_access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
