AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained SageMaker Domain (VPC-only) with dedicated IAM execution role, VPC, subnets, security group, VPC endpoints, KMS-encrypted default S3 bucket, and a single test user profile.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: test-domain
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Domain to create.
  TestUserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: test-user
    Description: Name of the single test user profile to create in the domain.

Resources:
  SageMakerVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  SubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet-az1'

  SubnetAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet-az2'

  DomainRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  SubnetAz1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetAz1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DomainRouteTable

  SubnetAz2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetAz2
      RouteTableId: !Ref DomainRouteTable

  DomainSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker VPC-only domain and VPC endpoints (no ingress, default all egress)
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sagemaker-sg'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref DomainRouteTable

  SageMakerApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sagemaker.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SubnetAz1
        - !Ref SubnetAz2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DomainSecurityGroup

  SageMakerRuntimeEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sagemaker.runtime'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SubnetAz1
        - !Ref SubnetAz2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DomainSecurityGroup

  StsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SubnetAz1
        - !Ref SubnetAz2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DomainSecurityGroup

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SubnetAz1
        - !Ref SubnetAz2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DomainSecurityGroup

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SubnetAz1
        - !Ref SubnetAz2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DomainSecurityGroup

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref SageMakerVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref SubnetAz1
        - !Ref SubnetAz2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref DomainSecurityGroup

  DefaultBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed KMS key for the SageMaker domain default bucket server-side encryption.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: KeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  DefaultBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DefaultBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  DefaultBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref DefaultBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ExecutionRoleListBucket
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !GetAtt DefaultBucket.Arn
          - Sid: ExecutionRoleObjectReadWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource: !Sub '${DefaultBucket.Arn}/*'

  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerJobPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: TrainingJobActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: TransformJobActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ProcessingJobActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AutoMLJobActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJobV2
                  - sagemaker:StopAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJobV2
                  - sagemaker:ListAutoMLJobs
                  - sagemaker:ListCandidatesForAutoMLJob
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: HyperParameterTuningJobActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: SageMakerExperimentLineagePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ExperimentActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:DeleteExperiment
                  - sagemaker:Search
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: TrialActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrial
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: TrialComponentActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrialComponent
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LineageActionsContextsArtifacts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateAction
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAction
                  - sagemaker:ListActions
                  - sagemaker:UpdateAction
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAction
                  - sagemaker:CreateContext
                  - sagemaker:DescribeContext
                  - sagemaker:ListContexts
                  - sagemaker:UpdateContext
                  - sagemaker:DeleteContext
                  - sagemaker:CreateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
                  - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
                  - sagemaker:UpdateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DeleteArtifact
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: SageMakerModelPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ModelActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ModelPackageActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ModelPackageGroupActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:PutModelPackageGroupPolicy
                  - sagemaker:GetModelPackageGroupPolicy
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroupPolicy
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: SageMakerStudioPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StudioAppAndSpaceActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  Saved CloudWatch Logs Insights queries for Claude Code application metrics
  scoped to the /aws/claude-code/metrics log group (created in this template
  and referenced via LogGroupNames). Conventions: user, sessionId,
  organization, model, requestId are identifiers; tokens, inputTokens,
  outputTokens are numeric counts (cost proxies applied downstream); cacheHit
  is 1 (hit) or 0 (miss); error, level, throttleType are error/throttle
  fields; rate-limit thresholds are 8000 tokens/min, 50 req/min.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group containing Claude Code metric events.

Resources:

  ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Real-Time Monitoring (RT)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  RtTokenUsageRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RT/Token-Rate-Per-User
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(tokens) and ispresent(user) | stats sum(tokens) as tokens_total by user | sort tokens_total desc

  RtRequestRatePerUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RT/Req-Rate-Per-User
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(user) and ispresent(requestId) | stats count_distinct(requestId) as requests by user | sort requests desc

  RtCurrentAvgTpm:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RT/Avg-TPM
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(tokens) | stats sum(tokens) as tokens_total, count() as events by bin(1min) | sort @bin desc

  RtCurrentAvgRpm:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RT/Avg-RPM
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(requestId) | stats count_distinct(requestId) as requests by bin(1min) | sort @bin desc

  RtRateLimitRisk:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/RT/Rate-Limit-Risk
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(user) and (ispresent(tokens) or ispresent(requestId)) | stats sum(tokens) as tokens_per_min, count_distinct(requestId) as requests_per_min by bin(1min), user | filter tokens_per_min > 8000 or requests_per_min > 50 | sort tokens_per_min desc

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User & Session Analytics (USA)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  UsaSessionLevelUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/USA/Session-Usage
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(sessionId) and ispresent(user) | stats sum(tokens) as tokens_total, count_distinct(requestId) as requests, min(@timestamp) as session_start, max(@timestamp) as session_end by sessionId, user | sort tokens_total desc

  UsaHourlyActivityTimeline:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/USA/Hourly-Timeline
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(user) | stats count() as events, sum(tokens) as tokens_total, count_distinct(user) as active_users by bin(1h) | sort @bin desc

  UsaErrorDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/USA/Error-Detection
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(error) or level = "ERROR" | stats count() as error_count by error, user | sort error_count desc

  UsaThrottlingDetection:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/USA/Throttling
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ismatch(error, "rate") or ispresent(throttleType) | stats count() as throttle_events by user, bin(5m) | sort @bin desc

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cost & Attribution (COST)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  CostByUser:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/COST/By-User
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(inputTokens) and ispresent(outputTokens) | stats sum(inputTokens) as input_tokens, sum(outputTokens) as output_tokens by user | sort input_tokens desc

  CostByModel:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/COST/By-Model
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(model) and ispresent(inputTokens) and ispresent(outputTokens) | stats sum(inputTokens) as input_tokens, sum(outputTokens) as output_tokens by model | sort input_tokens desc

  CostByOrg:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/COST/By-Org
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(organization) and ispresent(inputTokens) and ispresent(outputTokens) | stats sum(inputTokens) as input_tokens, sum(outputTokens) as output_tokens, count_distinct(user) as users by organization | sort input_tokens desc

  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Debugging & Analysis (DBG)
  # -------------------------------------------------------------------
  DbgModelEfficiency:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/DBG/Model-Efficiency
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(model) and ispresent(tokens) | stats avg(tokens) as avg_tokens_per_event, avg(durationMs) as avg_latency_ms, count_distinct(requestId) as requests by model | sort requests desc

  DbgCacheRatesOverall:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/DBG/Cache-Rate
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(cacheHit) | stats count() as total by cacheHit, model | sort total desc

  DbgCacheRatesOverTime:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/DBG/Cache-Rate-Time
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(cacheHit) | stats count() as events by bin(1h), cacheHit | sort @bin desc

  DbgCacheRatesBySession:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/DBG/Cache-Rate-Session
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(sessionId) and ispresent(cacheHit) | stats count() as events by sessionId, cacheHit | sort events desc

  DbgPeakUsageWindows:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/DBG/Peak-Windows
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(user) | stats count() as events, sum(tokens) as tokens_total, count_distinct(user) as active_users by bin(5m) | sort tokens_total desc | limit 20

  DbgSessionDeepDive:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/DBG/Session-Deep-Dive
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(sessionId) | sort @timestamp asc | limit 50

  DbgFieldExplorer:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/DBG/Field-Explorer
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter @message like /./ | sort @timestamp desc | limit 20

  DbgDailyUsageSummary:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    DependsOn: ClaudeCodeMetricsLogGroup
    Properties:
      Name: ClaudeCode/DBG/Daily-Summary
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: filter ispresent(user) | stats count() as events, sum(tokens) as tokens_total, count_distinct(user) as active_users, count_distinct(sessionId) as sessions, count_distinct(requestId) as requests by bin(1d) | sort @bin desc

Outputs:
  RtTokenUsageRatePerUser:
    Value: !Ref RtTokenUsageRatePerUser
  RtRequestRatePerUser:
    Value: !Ref RtRequestRatePerUser
  RtCurrentAvgTpm:
    Value: !Ref RtCurrentAvgTpm
  RtCurrentAvgRpm:
    Value: !Ref RtCurrentAvgRpm
  RtRateLimitRisk:
    Value: !Ref RtRateLimitRisk
  UsaSessionLevelUsage:
    Value: !Ref UsaSessionLevelUsage
  UsaHourlyActivityTimeline:
    Value: !Ref UsaHourlyActivityTimeline
  UsaErrorDetection:
    Value: !Ref UsaErrorDetection
  UsaThrottlingDetection:
    Value: !Ref UsaThrottlingDetection
  CostByUser:
    Value: !Ref CostByUser
  CostByModel:
    Value: !Ref CostByModel
  CostByOrg:
    Value: !Ref CostByOrg
  DbgModelEfficiency:
    Value: !Ref DbgModelEfficiency
  DbgCacheRatesOverall:
    Value: !Ref DbgCacheRatesOverall
  DbgCacheRatesOverTime:
    Value: !Ref DbgCacheRatesOverTime
  DbgCacheRatesBySession:
    Value: !Ref DbgCacheRatesBySession
  DbgPeakUsageWindows:
    Value: !Ref DbgPeakUsageWindows
  DbgSessionDeepDive:
    Value: !Ref DbgSessionDeepDive
  DbgFieldExplorer:
    Value: !Ref DbgFieldExplorer
  DbgDailyUsageSummary:
    Value: !Ref DbgDailyUsageSummary

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Self-contained stack creating the SuperCoolAPI AppSync GraphQL API (AWS_IAM auth,
  full CloudWatch request logging), a DynamoDB table (Table1) with on-demand billing,
  multiple DynamoDB data sources demonstrating different schema-valid intrinsic
  referencing approaches for table name and region, IAM roles/policies for table and
  index access (including Fn::GetAtt and Fn::Sub-constructed ARNs), a Todo GraphQL
  schema, and GetItem/PutItem resolvers.

Resources:

  AppSyncCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogsInline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - appsync:PushLogRecords
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/appsync/*:log-stream:*"

  AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBTable1ReadWrite
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt Table1.Arn
                  - !Sub "${Table1.Arn}/index/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${Table1}"

  Table1:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: Table1
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  SuperCoolAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SuperCoolAPI
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL
        ExcludeVerboseContent: false

  Table1GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          description: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

        type Mutation {
          addTodo(description: String!): Todo
        }

  Table1DataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1DynamoDBSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      Description: Data source referencing the table by Ref TableName and Ref region
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        AwsRegion: !Ref "AWS::Region"
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        Versioned: false

  Table1ArnDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1DynamoDBSourceBySub
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      Description: Data source referencing the table name via Fn::Sub shorthand, region via Ref
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        AwsRegion: !Ref "AWS::Region"
        TableName: !Sub "${Table1}"
        Versioned: false

  Table1SubArnDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1DynamoDBSourceByRefAndSubRegion
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      Description: Data source referencing the table by Ref TableName with region resolved via Fn::Sub
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        AwsRegion: !Sub "${AWS::Region}"
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        Versioned: false

  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: Table1GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt Table1DataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "GetItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  AddTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: Table1GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt Table1ArnDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($util.autoId())
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "description": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.description)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

Outputs:

  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: GraphQL endpoint URL for SuperCoolAPI
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.GraphQLUrl

  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: AppSync API ID for SuperCoolAPI
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId

  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: ARN of the SuperCoolAPI AppSync GraphQL API
    Value: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Multi-tier configurable VPC (public/private/restricted) with IGW, optional NAT, and VPC Flow Logs to CloudWatch Logs.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  NumberOfAzs:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 3
    Description: Number of Availability Zones to deploy into (1-3).
  Tier1Enabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable the first (public) tier.
  Tier1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: Public
  Tier1AutoAssignPublicIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Auto-assign public IPv4 addresses in Tier 1 subnets.
  Tier1Az1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  Tier1Az2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  Tier1Az3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  Tier2Enabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable the second (private) tier.
  Tier2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: Private
  Tier2Az1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  Tier2Az2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.12.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  Tier2Az3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.13.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  Tier3Enabled:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Enable the third (restricted) tier.
  Tier3Name:
    Type: String
    Default: Restricted
  Tier3Az1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.21.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  Tier3Az2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.22.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  Tier3Az3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.23.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  CreateInternetGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Create an Internet Gateway with a default route for Tier 1.
  CreateNatGateways:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Create NAT Gateway(s) for outbound access from Tier 2 and Tier 3.
  NatGatewayMode:
    Type: String
    Default: Single
    AllowedValues: [Single, PerAz]
    Description: Single shared NAT Gateway or one NAT Gateway per Availability Zone.
  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ACCEPT
    AllowedValues: [ACCEPT, ALL, REJECT]
  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    MinValue: 1
  PermissionsBoundaryArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^arn:aws:iam::\d{12}:policy/.+$
    Description: Optional permissions boundary ARN for the Flow Logs IAM role. Leave empty for none.

Conditions:
  Tier1Enabled: !Equals [!Ref Tier1Enabled, 'true']
  Tier2Enabled: !Equals [!Ref Tier2Enabled, 'true']
  Tier3EnabledCond: !Equals [!Ref Tier3Enabled, 'true']
  HasTwoAzs: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NumberOfAzs, 1]]
  HasThreeAzs: !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAzs, 3]
  CreateIgW: !Equals [!Ref CreateInternetGateway, 'true']
  CreateNat: !Equals [!Ref CreateNatGateways, 'true']
  NatPerAz: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayMode, 'PerAz']
  HasPermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, '']]
  Tier1AutoIpEnabled: !Equals [!Ref Tier1AutoAssignPublicIp, 'true']
  Tier1DefaultRouteEnabled: !And [Condition: CreateIgW, Condition: Tier1Enabled]
  Tier1Az2Enabled: !And [Condition: Tier1Enabled, Condition: HasTwoAzs]
  Tier1Az3Enabled: !And [Condition: Tier1Enabled, Condition: HasThreeAzs]
  Tier2Az2Enabled: !And [Condition: Tier2Enabled, Condition: HasTwoAzs]
  Tier2Az3Enabled: !And [Condition: Tier2Enabled, Condition: HasThreeAzs]
  Tier3Az2Enabled: !And [Condition: Tier3EnabledCond, Condition: HasTwoAzs]
  Tier3Az3Enabled: !And [Condition: Tier3EnabledCond, Condition: HasThreeAzs]
  NatEnabledWithTier1: !And [Condition: CreateNat, Condition: CreateIgW, Condition: Tier1Enabled]
  NatAz2Enabled: !And [Condition: NatEnabledWithTier1, Condition: NatPerAz, Condition: HasTwoAzs]
  NatAz3Enabled: !And [Condition: NatEnabledWithTier1, Condition: NatPerAz, Condition: HasThreeAzs]
  Tier2NatRouteEnabled: !And [Condition: Tier2Enabled, Condition: NatEnabledWithTier1]
  Tier3NatRouteEnabled: !And [Condition: Tier3EnabledCond, Condition: NatEnabledWithTier1]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: multi-tier-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateIgW
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: multi-tier-igw

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateIgW
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------- Tier 1 (Public) ----------
  Tier1RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: Tier1Enabled
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Tier1Name}-rt'

  Tier1DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: Tier1DefaultRouteEnabled
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref Tier1RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Tier1SubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: Tier1Enabled

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Shared VPC for EMR on EKS and a Celeborn shuffle service cluster.
  Creates a VPC across two AZs with two public and two private subnets, an
  Internet Gateway, a per-AZ NAT Gateway, S3 gateway endpoint, interface
  VPC endpoints for SSM/EC2/Logs/Monitoring/STS/EMR/KMS, and VPC Flow Logs
  (ALL traffic) encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key and delivered to
  a CloudWatch Logs group via a dedicated IAM role.
  Fully self-contained: every referenced resource is created in this stack.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: shared-vpc
    Description: Environment tag applied to all resources.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC. Subnet CIDRs below must fit inside this range.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR for public subnet 1 (AZ 1). Must not overlap other subnet CIDRs.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.16.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR for public subnet 2 (AZ 2). Must not overlap other subnet CIDRs.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.32.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR for private subnet 1 (AZ 1). Must not overlap other subnet CIDRs.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.48.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    Description: CIDR for private subnet 2 (AZ 2). Must not overlap other subnet CIDRs.

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internet Gateway and attachment
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public subnets (EKS load balancer discovery via kubernetes.io/role/elb).
  # "Public" semantics come from the IGW default route via the shared
  # public route table — NOT from auto-assign. MapPublicIpOnLaunch is
  # explicitly false so instances do not receive public IPs by default;
  # any resource that genuinely needs a public IP must request it
  # explicitly at the resource level (e.g., a bastion host).
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: "1"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets (EKS internal LB discovery via kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ""
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: "1"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways (one per AZ, in the public subnet of the same AZ).
  # NAT Gateways use their own Elastic IPs and do not rely on the
  # subnet auto-assign attribute.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGatewayEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGatewayEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-gateway-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route tables and routes
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-route-table"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-route-table-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-route-table-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 gateway endpoint — reachable from all route tables so S3 traffic
  # from every subnet bypasses the NAT Gateways.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-s3-gateway-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security group for interface endpoints.
  # HTTPS (443) allowed only from the VPC's own CIDR.
  # Egress rules are intentionally omitted — security groups are
  # stateful, so responses to allowed inbound flows return automatically.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: !Sub "HTTPS access from VPC CIDR only for interface endpoints (${AWS::StackName})"
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-interface-endpoints-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Interface VPC endpoints (private subnets, private DNS enabled)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NOTE: Full SSM Session Manager functionality from private subnets
  # additionally requires the com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages
  # (and optionally com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages) interface
  # endpoints. Add them here if Session Manager connectivity from the
  # private subnets is a requirement.
  SsmInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ssm-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  Ec2InterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ec2-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  LogsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-logs-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  MonitoringInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-monitoring-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  StsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sts-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EmrInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.elasticmapreduce"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-elasticmapreduce-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  KmsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-kms-endpoint"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Customer-managed KMS key for VPC Flow Logs encryption.
  # Root retains full control; CloudWatch Logs service is granted the
  # encryption actions constrained via the KMS encryption-context
  # condition key (kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn) — CloudWatch Logs
  # presents the log-group ARN as encryption context to KMS, not as a
  # plain aws:logs:arn condition key. ArnLike performs ARN-pattern
  # matching against the wildcard suffix, which StringEquals cannot do,
  # and the wildcard pattern avoids a circular dependency between this
  # key policy and the log group created below.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer-managed key for ${AWS::StackName} VPC Flow Logs encryption"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToEncryptFlowLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-kms-key"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs group receiving VPC Flow Logs.
  # Retained on stack deletion since it accumulates delivered log data.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}"
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dedicated IAM role for VPC Flow Logs.
  # Trust restricted to vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com only; permissions
  # scoped to the flow-log log group ARN and the KMS key ARN —
  # no wildcard-resource permissions.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-role"
      Description: !Sub "Delivery role for VPC Flow Logs of ${AWS::StackName} to CloudWatch Logs"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-policy"
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteFlowLogEventsToLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: GenerateDataKeyForLogGroupEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Log: ALL traffic, 60-second aggregation, delivered to the
  # CMK-encrypted CloudWatch Logs group above. DestinationOptions is not
  # set — it applies only to S3 destinations.
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    DependsOn: FlowLogsRole
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-log"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the shared VPC for EMR on EKS / Celeborn stacks.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-VpcId"

  VpcCidr:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: VPC with IPv4 and Amazon-provided IPv6 across three AZs, with optional public subnets.

Parameters:
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Default: greenfield-vpc
    Description: Name tag for the VPC.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.
  CreatePublicSubnets:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Whether to create public subnets, an Internet Gateway, and public routes.

Conditions:
  HasPublicSubnets: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnets, "true"]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcName

  VpcIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, 5]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-az1"

  PublicSubnet1Ipv6Cidr:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetCidrBlock
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, 5]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-az2"

  PublicSubnet2Ipv6Cidr:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetCidrBlock
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, 5]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-az3"

  PublicSubnet3Ipv6Cidr:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetCidrBlock
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw"

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt"

  PublicDefaultRouteV4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicDefaultRouteV6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, 5]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-az1"

  PrivateSubnet1Ipv6Cidr:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetCidrBlock
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, 5]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-az2"

  PrivateSubnet2Ipv6Cidr:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetCidrBlock
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref "AWS::Region"
      CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, 5]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-az3"

  PrivateSubnet3Ipv6Cidr:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetCidrBlock
    DependsOn: VpcIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt"

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: IDs of the public subnets
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: IDs of the private subnets
    Value: !Join [",", [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  IAM identities and permissions required to bootstrap and operate the
  Cluster API Provider for AWS (CAPA). Creates control plane, controllers,
  worker node, and EKS cluster roles, instance profiles, customer-managed
  policies, and a bootstrapper group/user. IAM only — no compute resources.

Resources:

  ControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "capa-control-plane-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "capa-control-plane-${AWS::Region}"

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "capa-control-plane-${AWS::Region}"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole

  ControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "capa-controllers-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:PrincipalTag/kubernetes.io/cluster/cluster-api-provider-aws: owned
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "capa-controllers-${AWS::Region}"

  WorkerNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "capa-worker-node-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "capa-worker-node-${AWS::Region}"

  WorkerNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "capa-worker-node-${AWS::Region}"
      Roles:
        - !Ref WorkerNodeRole

  EKSClusterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "capa-eks-cluster-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "capa-eks-cluster-${AWS::Region}"

  CloudProviderPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "capa-cloud-provider-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: "Least privilege permissions for the AWS cloud provider integration on control plane and worker nodes"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
        - !Ref WorkerNodeRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2InstanceReadAndTag
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceStatus
              - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: EC2NetworkingRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ELBv2Management
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetHealth
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
              - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
              - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
              - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
              - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AutoScalingManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
              - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
              - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
              - autoscaling:DescribeTags
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ECRPull
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: SecretsManagerRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
              - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
              - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:capa-*"
          - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/capa/*"

  ControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "capa-controllers-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: "Broad permissions for Cluster API controllers including EC2, ELB, Auto Scaling, EKS, service linked role creation and PassRole"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ControllersRole
        - !Ref ControlPlaneRole
      Groups:
        - !Ref BootstrapperGroup
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EC2FullNetworkingAndInstanceManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:Describe*
              - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
              - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:RunInstances
              - ec2:TerminateInstances
              - ec2:StartInstances
              - ec2:StopInstances
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
              - ec2:CreateSubnet
              - ec2:DeleteSubnet
              - ec2:CreateVpc
              - ec2:DeleteVpc
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:CreateRouteTable
              - ec2:DeleteRouteTable
              - ec2:AssociateRouteTable
              - ec2:DisassociateRouteTable
              - ec2:CreateInternetGateway
              - ec2:DeleteInternetGateway
              - ec2:AttachInternetGateway
              - ec2:DetachInternetGateway
              - ec2:CreateNatGateway
              - ec2:DeleteNatGateway
              - ec2:AllocateAddress
              - ec2:ReleaseAddress
              - ec2:AssociateAddress
              - ec2:DisassociateAddress
              - ec2:CreateVpcEndpoint
              - ec2:DeleteVpcEndpoints
              - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
              - ec2:GetConsoleOutput
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ELBManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AutoScalingLifecycle
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:CreateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:DeleteAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:SetDesiredCapacity
              - autoscaling:TerminateInstanceInAutoScalingGroup
              - autoscaling:CreateOrUpdateTags
              - autoscaling:DeleteTags
              - autoscaling:CreateLaunchConfiguration
              - autoscaling:DeleteLaunchConfiguration
              - autoscaling:Describe*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: EKSClusterAndNodegroupManagement
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:CreateAddon
              - eks:DeleteAddon
              - eks:UpdateAddon
              - eks:DescribeAddon
              - eks:ListAddons
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
              - eks:ListTagsForResource
              - eks:DescribeAddonVersions
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: ServiceLinkedRoleCreation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
              - iam:GetServiceLinkedRoleDeletionStatus
            Resource: "arn:aws:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/*"
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
                  - eks.amazonaws.com
                  - ec2.amazonaws.com
                  - autoscaling.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: PassRoleToTemplateRoles
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/capa-control-plane-${AWS::Region}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/capa-controllers-${AWS::Region}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/capa-worker-node-${AWS::Region}"
              - !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/capa-eks-cluster-${AWS::Region}"

  BootstrapperGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub "capa-bootstrapper-group-${AWS::Region}"

  BootstrapperUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Sub "capa-bootstrapper-${AWS::Region}"
      Groups:
        - !Ref BootstrapperGroup

Outputs:

  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the control plane role
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneRole.Arn
  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the controllers role
    Value: !GetAtt ControllersRole.Arn
  WorkerNodeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the worker node role
    Value: !GetAtt WorkerNodeRole.Arn
  EKSClusterRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS cluster role
    Value: !GetAtt EKSClusterRole.Arn
  ControlPlaneInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the control plane instance profile
    Value: !GetAtt ControlPlaneInstanceProfile.Arn

    Description: ARN of the worker node instance profile
    Value: !GetAtt WorkerNodeInstanceProfile.Arn

    Description: ARN of the bootstrapper user
    Value: !GetAtt BootstrapperUser.Arn
