AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Shared IAM roles and instance profiles for the Amazon EKS Quick Start stacks.
  Roles are prefixed with "eks-quickstart" and parameter values are published
  under the SSM path "/quickstart/amazon-eks".

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Lambda execution roles

  EksQuickstartCopyArtifactsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-copy-zip-artifacts
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-copy-artifacts
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::aws-quickstart-bucket/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::aws-quickstart-bucket

  EksQuickstartReadResourceInfoRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-read-resource-info
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-readonly-describe
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:List*
                  - iam:Get*
                  - iam:List*
                  - eks:Describe*
                  - eks:List*
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                  - autoscaling:Describe*
                  - cloudwatch:Describe*
                  - cloudwatch:Get*
                  - cloudwatch:List*
                Resource: "*"

  EksQuickstartVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-vpc
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  EksQuickstartDeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-delete-bucket-contents
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-delete-bucket-contents
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::aws-quickstart-bucket/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::aws-quickstart-bucket

  EksQuickstartCleanLoadBalancersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-clean-load-balancers
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-clean-load-balancers
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeRules
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteRule
                Resource: "*"

  EksQuickstartCleanSecurityGroupsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-clean-security-groups
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-clean-security-groups
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                Resource: "*"

  EksQuickstartCleanLambdasRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-clean-lambdas
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-clean-lambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:ListTags
                  - lambda:UntagResource
                Resource: "*"

  EksQuickstartCallerArnRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-caller-arn
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-caller-identity
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: "*"

  EksQuickstartRegisterResourceTypesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-register-resource-types
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-register-resource-types
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterResourceType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeResourceType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterResourceType
                  - cloudformation:ListResourceTypes
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeRegistrations
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                Resource: "*"

  EksQuickstartNodeSecurityGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-node-security-group
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-quickstart-node-security-group
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                Resource: "*"

  EksQuickstartFargateProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: eks-quickstart-fargate-profile
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Self-contained lab VPC with two web-tier and two application-tier subnets
  across two Availability Zones sharing a single route table, a web-tier
  security group allowing inbound HTTPS from within the VPC CIDR, an S3
  gateway endpoint with read-only access, and interface VPC endpoints for
  Kinesis Data Firehose and Kinesis Data Streams with private DNS enabled.

Resources:
  LabVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-vpc

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-web-subnet-az1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-web-subnet-az2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.11.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-app-subnet-az1
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.12.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: lab-app-subnet-az2
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  SharedRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref LabVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Shared per-account IAM prerequisites for EKS cluster deployments driven by
  CloudFormation custom resources backed by Lambda. All names derive from a
  single common name prefix.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: eks
    Description: Common prefix used to derive all role, policy, and instance profile names.
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$"
    ConstraintDescription: Prefix must contain only alphanumerics and hyphens.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: shared
    Description: Environment tag applied to all resources.
  Application:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-platform
    Description: Application tag applied to all resources.
  SsmConfigPath:
    Type: String
    Default: eks/config
    Description: SSM parameter path prefix the SSM resolver handler may read.

Resources:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. CR handler: copy deployment assets between S3 buckets
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  CopyAssetsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-copy-assets-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: copy-assets-s3
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-copy-assets-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. CR handler: read arbitrary AWS resource state
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ResourceReaderLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-resource-reader-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: resource-reader
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - eks:Describe*
                  - eks:List*
                  - ec2:Get*
                  - iam:Get*
                  - iam:List*
                  - ssm:Describe*
                  - acm:Describe*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                  - autoscaling:Describe*
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-resource-reader-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. CR handler: create the VPC-related IAM role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcRoleCreatorLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-vpc-role-creator-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-role-creator-iam
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:TagRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${NamePrefix}-*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-vpc-role-creator-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. CR handler: delete contents of S3 buckets
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  BucketCleanupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-bucket-cleanup-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: bucket-cleanup-s3
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-bucket-cleanup-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. CR handler: orphaned LB / SG / ENI cleanup
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  LbCleanupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-lb-cleanup-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lb-cleanup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeListeners
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-lb-cleanup-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. CR handler: clean up leftover Lambda functions
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaCleanupLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-lambda-cleanup-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: lambda-cleanup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:ListTags
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-lambda-cleanup-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. CR handler: look up calling identity
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  CallerIdentityLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-caller-identity-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: caller-identity
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-caller-identity-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 9. CR handler: register CloudFormation provider types
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  RegisterTypeLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-register-type-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: register-types
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeConfiguration
                Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-register-type-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 10. CR handler: resolve SSM parameters under config path
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  SsmResolverLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-ssm-resolver-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ssm-resolver
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${SsmConfigPath}/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-ssm-resolver-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 11. CR handler: create the CFN VPC service role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  CfnVpcRoleCreatorLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-cfn-vpc-role-creator-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cfn-vpc-role-creator-iam
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${NamePrefix}-*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-cr-cfn-vpc-role-creator-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 13. EKS control plane service role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  EksClusterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-eks-cluster-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - eks.amazonaws.com
                - eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSVPCResourceController"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-eks-cluster-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 14. Fargate profile execution role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  FargateProfileRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-fargate-profile-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSFargatePodExecutionRolePolicy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-fargate-profile-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 15/16. Node roles: shared inline policies
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  NodeCfnSignalPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-node-cfn-signal"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - cloudformation:SignalResource
            Resource: "*"

  EfsReadOnlyPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-node-efs-readonly"
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticfilesystem:ClientMount
              - elasticfilesystem:DescribeFileSystems
              - elasticfilesystem:DescribeMountTargets
            Resource: "*"

  ManagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-managed-node-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly"
        - !Ref NodeCfnSignalPolicy
        - !Ref EfsReadOnlyPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-managed-node-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  UnmanagedNodeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-unmanaged-node-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy"
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly"
        - !Ref NodeCfnSignalPolicy
        - !Ref EfsReadOnlyPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-unmanaged-node-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 17. Instance profiles
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ManagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-managed-node-instance-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref ManagedNodeRole

  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-unmanaged-node-instance-profile"
      Roles:
        - !Ref UnmanagedNodeRole

Outputs:
  EksClusterRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EKS control plane service role.
    Value: !GetAtt EksClusterRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-eks-cluster-role-arn"
  FargateProfileRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Fargate profile execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt FargateProfileRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-fargate-profile-role-arn"
  ManagedNodeInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the managed node instance profile.
    Value: !GetAtt ManagedNodeInstanceProfile.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-managed-node-instance-profile-arn"
  UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: ARN of the unmanaged node instance profile.
    Value: !GetAtt UnmanagedNodeInstanceProfile.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${NamePrefix}-unmanaged-node-instance-profile-arn"
  CopyAssetsLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the copy-assets Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt CopyAssetsLambdaRole.Arn
  ResourceReaderLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the resource-reader Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt ResourceReaderLambdaRole.Arn
  VpcRoleCreatorLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the VPC role creator Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt VpcRoleCreatorLambdaRole.Arn
  BucketCleanupLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the bucket cleanup Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt BucketCleanupLambdaRole.Arn
  LbCleanupLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the load balancer cleanup Lambda execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt LbCleanupLambdaRole.Arn
  LambdaCleanupLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda cleanup Lambda execution role.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SES SMTP IAM user, access key, SMTP credential conversion via Lambda custom resource, and SecureString storage in SSM Parameter Store.

Parameters:
  IamUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: SMTPUser
    AllowedPattern: '[\w+=,.@-]+'
    Description: Name of the IAM user permitted to send email via SES.
  KeyRotationVersion:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 999
    Description: Increment to force generation of a new access key and SMTP password.
  LambdaLogRetention:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention in days for the Lambda function log group.
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(|arn:aws:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:key/[a-zA-Z0-9-]+|arn:aws:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:alias/[a-zA-Z0-9/_-]+)$'
    Description: Optional customer-managed KMS key ARN used to encrypt the SSM parameters. Leave empty to use the AWS-managed aws/ssm key.

Conditions:
  UseCustomerManagedKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]

Resources:
  SesSendersGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub 'ses-smtp-senders-${IamUserName}'
      Path: /

  SesSendPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Allow sending email through SES only.
      Groups:
        - !Ref SesSendersGroup
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSesSend
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ses:SendEmail
              - ses:SendRawEmail
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/*'

  SesSmtpUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref IamUserName
      Path: /
      Groups:
        - !Ref SesSendersGroup

  SesSmtpAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref SesSmtpUser
      Serial: !Ref KeyRotationVersion

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'ses-smtp-converter-${IamUserName}-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SsmPutParameter
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PutDerivedSsmParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:PutParameter
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/ses/smtp/${IamUserName}/*'
              - Sid: DeleteDerivedSsmParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:DeleteParameter
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/ses/smtp/${IamUserName}/*'
              - !If
                - UseCustomerManagedKey

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/ses-smtp-converter-${IamUserName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LambdaLogRetention

  LambdaLogPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: LambdaLogs
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: WriteLambdaLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/ses-smtp-converter-${IamUserName}:*'

  SmtpConverterFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaLogPolicy
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'ses-smtp-converter-${IamUserName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import hmac
          import hashlib
          import json
          import os
          import urllib.request
          import boto3

          KEY_PREFIX = "AWS4"
          SECRET_KEY = "wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG+bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY"

          def signature(key, msg):
              return hmac.new(key, msg.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).digest()

          def convert_secret(secret_access_key, region):
              k_date = signature((KEY_PREFIX + SECRET_KEY).encode("utf-8"), region)
              k_region = signature(k_date, "email")
              k_service = signature(k_region, "smtp")
              k_smtp = signature(k_service, "aws4_request")
              return hmac.new(k_smtp, secret_access_key.encode("utf-8"), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()

          def send_response(event, context, status, data=None, reason=None):
              body = json.dumps({
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason or ("See CloudWatch Log Stream: " + context.log_stream_name),
                  "PhysicalResourceId": context.log_stream_name,
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "Data": data or {}
              }).encode("utf-8")
              req = urllib.request.Request(event["ResponseURL"], data=body,
                                           headers={"Content-Type": "", "Content-Length": str(len(body))},
                                           method="PUT")
              urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30)

          def handler(event, context):
              request_type = event["RequestType"]
              props = event["ResourceProperties"]
              username_param = props["UsernameParameterName"]
              password_param = props["PasswordParameterName"]
              kms_key = props.get("KmsKeyArn", "")
              ssm = boto3.client("ssm")
              try:
                  if request_type == "Delete":
                      for name in (username_param, password_param):
                          try:
                              ssm.delete_parameter(Name=name)
                          except ssm.exceptions.ParameterNotFound:
                              pass
                      send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS")
                      return
                  access_key_id = props["AccessKeyId"]
                  secret_access_key = props["SecretAccessKey"]
                  region = os.environ["AWS_REGION"]
                  smtp_username = access_key_id
                  smtp_password = convert_secret(secret_access_key, region)
                  kwargs = {"Type": "SecureString", "Overwrite": True}
                  if kms_key:
                      kwargs["KeyId"] = kms_key
                  ssm.put_parameter(Name=username_param, Value=smtp_username, **kwargs)
                  ssm.put_parameter(Name=password_param, Value=smtp_password, **kwargs)
                  send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS", {
                      "UsernameParameterName": username_param,
                      "PasswordParameterName": password_param
                  })
              except Exception as e:
                  send_response(event, context, "FAILED", reason=str(e))

  SmtpCredentialsCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn:
      - SesSmtpAccessKey
      - LambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SmtpConverterFunction.Arn
      AccessKeyId: !Ref SesSmtpAccessKey
      SecretAccessKey: !GetAtt SesSmtpAccessKey.SecretAccessKey
      UsernameParameterName: !Sub '/ses/smtp/${IamUserName}/username'
      PasswordParameterName: !Sub '/ses/smtp/${IamUserName}/password-${KeyRotationVersion}'
      KmsKeyArn: !Ref KmsKeyArn

Outputs:

    Description: Name of the SecureString parameter holding the SES SMTP username.
    Value: !Sub '/ses/smtp/${IamUserName}/username'
  SmtpPasswordParameterName:

    Value: !Sub '/ses/smtp/${IamUserName}/password-${KeyRotationVersion}'
  IamUserName:
    Description: IAM user name for SES SMTP sending.
    Value: !Ref SesSmtpUser

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v1.1.0, Sections 2.1-2.4 and 3. Multi-region
  CMK-encrypted CloudTrail trail with log file validation, retained SSE-KMS
  S3 bucket, CloudWatch Logs log group, encrypted SNS topic, and fourteen
  CIS metric filter/alarm pairs. See repo README for the AVD-AWS-0015
  disposition and post-deploy verification gate.

Parameters:
  NotificationEmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Description: Email address to receive CIS alarm notifications.
    Default: security@example.com
    AllowedPattern: "^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid email address.
  CloudTrailLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group for CloudTrail delivery.
    Default: cis-cloudtrail-logs
    AllowedPattern: "^[\\.\\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid CloudWatch Logs log group name.

Resources:
  CloudTrailKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for CloudTrail, S3 log bucket, and SNS topic encryption.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceArn: !Sub "arn:aws:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/cis-benchmark-trail"
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  CloudTrailKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cis-cloudtrail-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CloudTrailKmsKey

  CloudTrailBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "cloudtrail-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}-cis"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt CloudTrailKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: CloudTrailLogRetention
            Status: Enabled
            # Note: Glacier transitions are region-dependent; in regions without
            # Glacier support, remove the Transitions block before deploying.
            Transitions:
              - StorageClass: GLACIER
                TransitionInDays: 90
            ExpirationInDays: 365

  CloudTrailBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CloudTrailBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CloudTrailAclCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailBucket.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: CloudTrailWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub "${CloudTrailBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control

  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 365

  CloudTrailRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub "${CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn}:*"

  CloudTrailTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: CIS-CloudTrail-Alarms
      TopicName: !Sub "cis-cloudtrail-alarms-${AWS::Region}"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref CloudTrailKmsKey

  CloudTrailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmailAddress
      TopicArn: !Ref CloudTrailTopic

  AWSTrail:
    Type: AWS::CloudTrail::Trail
    DependsOn: CloudTrailBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      IsLogging: true
      IsMultiRegionTrail: true
      EnableLogFileValidation: true
      IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true
      KMSKeyId: alias/cis-cloudtrail-key
      S3BucketName: !Ref CloudTrailBucket
      CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
      CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailRole.Arn
      TrailName: cis-benchmark-trail

  # ---- 3.1 Unauthorized API calls ----
  MfUnauthorizedApiCalls:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: UnauthorizedApiCalls
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricValue: '1'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: LogGroupName
              Value: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
  AlarmUnauthorizedApiCalls:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedApiCalls
      AlarmDescription: Alarm for unauthorized API calls (CIS 3.1).
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: UnauthorizedApiCalls
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: LogGroupName
          Value: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CloudTrailTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref CloudTrailTopic

  # ---- 3.2 Console sign-in without MFA ----

      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref CloudTrailTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref CloudTrailTopic

  # ---- 3.3 Root account usage ----
  MfRootAccountUsage:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.userIdentity.type = "Root" && $.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS && $.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent" }'
      MetricTransformations:

          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark

  # ---- 3.4 IAM policy changes ----
  MfIamPolicyChanges:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{($.eventName=DeleteGroupPolicy)||($.eventName=DeleteRolePolicy)||($.eventName=DeleteUserPolicy)||($.eventName=PutGroupPolicy)||($.eventName=PutRolePolicy)||($.eventName=PutUserPolicy)||($.eventName=CreatePolicy)||($.eventName=DeletePolicy)||($.eventName=CreatePolicyVersion)||($.eventName=DeletePolicyVersion)||($.eventName=AttachRolePolicy)||($.eventName=DetachRolePolicy)||($.eventName=AttachUserPolicy)||($.eventName=DetachUserPolicy)||($.eventName=AttachGroupPolicy)||($.eventName=DetachGroupPolicy)}'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: IamPolicyChanges
          MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark

      Namespace: CISBenchmark

  MfConfigConfigChanges:

  MfSecurityGroupChanges:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: WebSocket API (API Gateway V2) backed by a Python Lambda for pushing live grant-processing job status updates to connected clients. Includes DynamoDB connection registry, dedicated CMKs for Lambda env encryption and API Gateway log encryption, account-level API Gateway CloudWatch logging role, and full stack outputs.

Resources:

  LambdaEnvKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting the grant WebSocket handler Lambda environment variables. Decryption access is delegated to IAM and enforced only for the handler role's scoped inline policy.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  LambdaEnvKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/grant-ws-lambda-env-${AWS::Region}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LambdaEnvKmsKey

  ApiLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting the API Gateway CloudWatch Logs log group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/grant-ws-*'

  ApiLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/grant-ws-apigw-logs-${AWS::Region}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ApiLogsKmsKey

  ConnectionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: grant-ws-connections
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt ApiLogsKmsKey.Arn

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: grant-ws-handler-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: grant-ws-handler-inline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBConnectionRegistry
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource: !GetAtt ConnectionsTable.Arn
              - Sid: KmsDecryptForEnv
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn

  GrantWebSocketHandler:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaExecutionRole
    Properties:
      FunctionName: grant-ws-handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 29
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CONNECTIONS_TABLE: !Ref ConnectionsTable
          STAGE: prod
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ["CONNECTIONS_TABLE"]
          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)

          apigw_management = None


          def _client(event):
              global apigw_management
              if apigw_management is None:
                  endpoint = "https://{domain}/{stage}".format(
                      domain=event["requestContext"]["domainName"],
                      stage=event["requestContext"]["stage"],
                  )
                  apigw_management = boto3.client(
                      "apigatewaymanagementapi", endpoint_url=endpoint
                  )
              return apigw_management


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              route = event.get("requestContext", {}).get("routeKey", "$default")
              connection_id = event["requestContext"]["connectionId"]

              if route == "$connect":
                  table.put_item(Item={"connectionId": connection_id})
                  return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Connected"}

              if route == "$disconnect":
                  table.delete_item(Key={"connectionId": connection_id})
                  return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Disconnected"}

              # $default and custom routes (e.g. sendMessage)
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get("body") or "{}")
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  body = {}

              action = body.get("action")
              if action == "sendMessage":
                  message = body.get("data", "No message provided")
                  client = _client(event)
                  connections = table.scan(ProjectionExpression="connectionId")
                  failed = []
                  for item in connections.get("Items", []):
                      try:
                          client.post_to_connection(
                              ConnectionId=item["connectionId"],
                              Data=json.dumps(
                                  {
                                      "type": "grantJobStatus",
                                      "from": connection_id,
                                      "message": message,
                                  }
                              ).encode("utf-8"),
                          )
                      except client.exceptions.GoneException:
                          failed.append(item["connectionId"])
                  for cid in failed:
                      table.delete_item(Key={"connectionId": cid})
                  return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Message sent"}

              # $default
              client = _client(event)
              try:
                  client.post_to_connection(
                      ConnectionId=connection_id,
                      Data=json.dumps({"type": "error", "message": "Unknown route"}).encode(
                          "utf-8"
                      ),
                  )
              except client.exceptions.GoneException:
                  table.delete_item(Key={"connectionId": connection_id})
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Unhandled route"}

  InvokePermissionConnect:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref GrantWebSocketHandler
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${Api.ApiId}/*/$connect'

  InvokePermissionDisconnect:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref GrantWebSocketHandler
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${Api.ApiId}/*/$disconnect'

  InvokePermissionDefault:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref GrantWebSocketHandler
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${Api.ApiId}/*/$default'

  InvokePermissionSendMessage:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref GrantWebSocketHandler
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${Api.ApiId}/*/sendMessage'

  ApiGatewayLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: grant-ws-apigw-logging-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLoggingRole.Arn

  ApiGatewayLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/apigateway/grant-ws-access-logs
      RetentionInDays: 90
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt ApiLogsKmsKey.Arn

  Api:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: grant-ws-api
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${GrantWebSocketHandler.Arn}/invocations'

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${GrantWebSocketHandler.Arn}/invocations'

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${GrantWebSocketHandler.Arn}/invocations'

  SendMessageIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${GrantWebSocketHandler.Arn}/invocations'

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      RouteKey: $connect
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ConnectIntegration}'

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      RouteKey: $default
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DefaultIntegration}'

  SendMessageRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      RouteKey: sendMessage
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${SendMessageIntegration}'

  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - SendMessageRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref Api
      StageName: prod
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayLogGroup.Arn
        Format: >-
          {"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status","connectionId":"$context.connectionId","integrationError":"$context.integration.error"}
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 500
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 200
        DetailedMetricsEnabled: true
        LoggingLevel: INFO
        DataTraceEnabled: false

Outputs:
  WebSocketUrl:
    Description: WebSocket connection URL for clients (wss)
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${Api.ApiId}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Stage}'
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: Secure WSS endpoint URL of the deployed stage
    Value: !Sub 'https://${Api.ApiId}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Stage}'
  WebSocketApiArn:
    Description: ARN of the WebSocket API
    Value: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${Api.ApiId}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  IAM-only template for a CodeDeploy + CodePipeline release pipeline demo.
  Creates one EC2 instance role and matching instance profile (broad
  administrative access for testing), one CodeDeploy service role (EC2
  describe access plus Auto Scaling lifecycle hook management), and one
  CodePipeline service role (S3 artifact access plus cross-service
  deployment orchestration and iam:PassRole).

Resources:

  EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ec2-instance-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ec2-instance-profile'
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole

  CodeDeployServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-codedeploy-service-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - codedeploy.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
                - codedeploy.us-west-2.amazonaws.com
                - codedeploy.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-codedeploy-ec2-asg'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: Ec2InstanceRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: AutoScalingLifecycleHookManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - autoscaling:CompleteLifecycleAction
                  - autoscaling:RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat
                  - autoscaling:PutLifecycleHook
                  - autoscaling:DeleteLifecycleHook
                  - autoscaling:DescribeLifecycleHooks
                  - autoscaling:DescribeLifecycleHookTypes
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
                  - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
                Resource: '*'

  CodePipelineServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-codepipeline-service-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codepipeline.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-artifacts'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ArtifactBucketLevelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AWS::AccountId}-*'
              - Sid: ArtifactObjectLevelAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${AWS::AccountId}-*/*'
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-orchestration'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AutoScalingOrchestration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingInstances
                  - autoscaling:DescribeScalingActivities
                  - autoscaling:DescribeInstanceRefreshes
                  - autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup
                  - autoscaling:SuspendProcesses
                  - autoscaling:ResumeProcesses
                  - autoscaling:EnterStandby

                  - autoscaling:StartInstanceRefresh

                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:EnableAlarmActions
                  - cloudwatch:DisableAlarmActions
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CodeDeployOrchestration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codedeploy:CreateDeployment
                  - codedeploy:GetApplication

                  - codedeploy:GetDeployment

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Serverless webhook handler: API Gateway REST API -> Lambda -> SNS for
  Stripe payment + Squarespace Commerce sales notifications to Slack.

Resources:
  WebhookRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: stripe-squarespace-webhooks
      Description: REST API for receiving Stripe webhook events.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  WebhooksResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt WebhookRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: webhooks

  WebhooksPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref WebhooksResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub
          - arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${FunctionArn}/invocations
          - FunctionArn: !GetAtt WebhookLambdaFunction.Arn

  ApiGatewayDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: WebhooksPostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookRestApi

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiGatewayDeployment
      StageName: prod
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          MetricsEnabled: true
          DataTraceEnabled: false

  SquarespaceApiTokenSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: stripe-squarespace/squarespace-api-token
      Description: >
        PLACEHOLDER at stack creation. After deployment, replace the 'token'
        value with the real Squarespace Commerce API token.
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"token":"PLACEHOLDER_REPLACE_AFTER_DEPLOY"}'
        GenerateStringKey: nonce
        PasswordLength: 24

  StripeWebhookSigningSecretSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: stripe-squarespace/stripe-webhook-signing-secret
      Description: >
        PLACEHOLDER at stack creation. After deployment, replace the 'token'
        value with the real Stripe webhook signing secret.
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"token":"PLACEHOLDER_REPLACE_AFTER_DEPLOY"}'
        GenerateStringKey: nonce
        PasswordLength: 24

  WebhookLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: stripe-squarespace-webhook-handler
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN: !Sub
            - '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${SecretArn}:SecretString:token}}'
            - SecretArn: !Ref SquarespaceApiTokenSecret
          STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET: !Sub
            - '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${SecretArn}:SecretString:token}}'
            - SecretArn: !Ref StripeWebhookSigningSecretSecret
          SALES_NOTIFICATION_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SalesNotificationsTopic
          SQUARESPACE_API_BASE_URL: https://api.squarespace.com
      Role: !GetAtt WebhookLambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import hashlib
          import hmac
          import os
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error
          import boto3

          SQUARESPACE_API_BASE_URL = os.environ["SQUARESPACE_API_BASE_URL"]
          SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN = os.environ["SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN"]
          STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET = os.environ["STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET"]
          SALES_NOTIFICATION_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ["SALES_NOTIFICATION_TOPIC_ARN"]

          SNS_CLIENT = boto3.client("sns")
          TOLERANCE_SECONDS = 300


          def _verify_stripe_signature(payload_bytes, headers):
              """Verify the Stripe webhook signature (Stripe-Signature header)."""
              signature_header = headers.get("Stripe-Signature", "")
              if not signature_header:
                  raise ValueError("Missing Stripe-Signature header")

              timestamp = None
              signatures = []
              for part in signature_header.split(","):
                  key_value = part.split("=", 1)
                  if len(key_value) != 2:
                      continue
                  key, value = key_value
                  if key == "t":
                      timestamp = value
                  elif key == "v1":
                      signatures.append(value)

              if timestamp is None or not signatures:
                  raise ValueError("Invalid Stripe-Signature header")

              # Replay protection: reject events older than TOLERANCE_SECONDS.
              signed_payload = f"{timestamp}.".encode() + payload_bytes
              expected = hmac.new(
                  STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET.encode(),
                  signed_payload,
                  hashlib.sha256,
              ).hexdigest()

              if not hmac.compare_digest(expected, signatures[0]):
                  raise ValueError("Stripe signature verification failed")

              return json.loads(payload_bytes)


          def _squarespace_request(path):
              """GET a Squarespace Commerce API endpoint and return parsed JSON."""
              url = f"{SQUARESPACE_API_BASE_URL}{path}"
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  url,
                  headers={
                      "Authorization": f"Bearer {SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN}",
                      "User-Agent": "webhook-handler-cfn",
                  },
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10) as response:
                  return json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))


          def _lookup_order(order_id):
              """Look up the Squarespace order and its inventory details."""
              order = _squarespace_request(f"/1.0/commerce/orders/{order_id}")
              inventory = []
              for line in order.get("lineItems", []):
                  variant_id = line.get("variantId")
                  if variant_id:
                      try:
                          variant = _squarespace_request(
                              f"/1.0/commerce/inventory/{variant_id}"
                          )
                          inventory.append(
                              {
                                  "sku": variant.get("sku", "unknown"),
                                  "quantity": variant.get("quantity", "n/a"),
                              }
                          )
                      except (urllib.error.HTTPError, urllib.error.URLError):
                          inventory.append({"sku": "lookup-failed", "quantity": "n/a"})
              return order, inventory


          def _format_notification(order, inventory, stripe_event):
              """Build a formatted Slack-bound notification message."""
              lines = [
                  ":moneybag: *New Sale Notification*",
                  f"*Stripe Event:* `{stripe_event.get('id', 'unknown')}` "
                  f"({stripe_event.get('type', 'unknown')})",
                  f"*Order Number:* {order.get('orderNumber', 'n/a')}",
                  f"*Customer:* {order.get('customerEmail', 'n/a')}",
                  f"*Total:* {order.get('grandTotal', {}).get('value', 'n/a')} "
                  f"{order.get('grandTotal', {}).get('currency', '')}",
                  "*Line Items / Inventory:*",
              ]
              for item in order.get("lineItems", []):
                  lines.append(f"  • {item.get('description', 'item')} "
                               f"x{item.get('quantity', 'n/a')}")
              for inv in inventory:
                  lines.append(f"  ↳ SKU {inv['sku']} — remaining stock: {inv['quantity']}")
              return "\n".join(lines)


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              body = event.get("body", "")
              if event.get("isBase64Encoded"):
                  import base64
                  body = base64.b64decode(body)
              else:
                  body = body.encode("utf-8")

              headers = {
                  k.lower(): v for k, v in (event.get("headers") or {}).items()
              }

              try:
                  stripe_event = _verify_stripe_signature(body, headers)
              except ValueError as exc:
                  return {"statusCode": 400, "body": json.dumps({"error": str(exc)})}

              # Extract the Squarespace order id from the Stripe event metadata.
              event_data = stripe_event.get("data", {}).get("object", {})
              metadata = event_data.get("metadata", {})
              order_id = metadata.get("squarespace_order_id") or event_data.get(
                  "client_reference_id"
              )
              if not order_id:
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 422,
                      "body": json.dumps(
                          {"error": "No Squarespace order id in Stripe event"}
                      ),
                  }

              try:
                  order, inventory = _lookup_order(order_id)
              except (urllib.error.HTTPError, urllib.error.URLError) as exc:
                  print(f"Squarespace lookup failed: {exc}")
                  return {
                      "statusCode": 502,
                      "body": json.dumps({"error": "Squarespace lookup failed"}),
                  }

              message = _format_notification(order, inventory, stripe_event)
              SNS_CLIENT.publish(
                  TopicArn=SALES_NOTIFICATION_TOPIC_ARN,
                  Subject="New Sale Notification",
                  Message=message,
              )

              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps({"status": "ok"})}
